/**
 * Tactical X-Band Air-to-Ground Network Digital Twin
 * Milestone: Scheduler Performance History Store
 *
 * Provides a bounded, immutable, read-only ring buffer for historical scheduler frames,
 * per-frame slot allocations, multi-class queue backlogs, and authoritative performance KPIs.
 * Enables historical inspection and trend visualization in the Scheduler workspace without
 * mutating live simulation state, rewinding the worker, or storing DEM elevation grids.
 */

export interface SchedulerSlotAllocation {
  readonly nodeId: number;
  readonly startMs: number;
  readonly durationMs: number;
  readonly durationS: number;
  readonly slotStartS: number;
  readonly capacityBits: number;
  readonly modcodName?: string;
  readonly spectralEfficiency?: number;
  readonly c2Bytes?: number;
  readonly voiceBytes?: number;
  readonly videoBytes?: number;
  readonly photoBytes?: number;
  readonly isPreOcclusionFlush: boolean;
}

export interface SchedulerNodeBacklog {
  readonly nodeId: number;
  readonly name?: string;
  readonly c2Bytes: number;
  readonly voiceBytes: number;
  readonly videoBytes: number;
  readonly photoBytes: number;
  readonly totalBacklogBytes: number;
  readonly c2Packets: number;
  readonly voicePackets: number;
  readonly videoPackets: number;
  readonly photoPackets: number;
  readonly snrDb?: number;
  readonly bitrateMbps?: number;
  readonly stateName?: string;
  readonly linkOutage?: boolean;
  readonly obstacleBlocked?: boolean;
}

export interface SchedulerKpiSnapshot {
  // Cumulative run-level totals
  readonly staticGoodputMb: number;
  readonly tacGoodputMb: number;
  readonly gainMultiplier: number;
  readonly staticWastePct: number;
  readonly tacWastePct: number;
  readonly staticDrops: number;
  readonly staticDropPct: number;
  readonly tacDrops: number;
  readonly tacDropPct: number;

  // Instantaneous superframe interval metrics
  readonly ulUtilizationPct: number;
  readonly staticUtilizationPct?: number;
  readonly tacUtilizationPct?: number;

  // Exact per-frame interval deltas (when exposed by worker)
  readonly activeGoodputFrameBits?: number;
  readonly staticGoodputFrameBits?: number;
  readonly tacGoodputFrameBits?: number;
  readonly activeWastedFrameBits?: number;
  readonly staticWastedFrameBits?: number;
  readonly tacWastedFrameBits?: number;
  readonly activeDropFramePkts?: number;
  readonly staticDropFramePkts?: number;
  readonly tacDropFramePkts?: number;
  readonly activeDropDelayFramePkts?: number;
  readonly activeDropOverflowFramePkts?: number;
  readonly staticDropDelayFramePkts?: number;
  readonly staticDropOverflowFramePkts?: number;
  readonly tacDropDelayFramePkts?: number;
  readonly tacDropOverflowFramePkts?: number;

  // Scenario state markers
  readonly node4PreShadowBacklogKb?: number;
  readonly staticNode4PreShadowBacklogKb?: number;
  readonly node4EvacStatus?: string;
  readonly staticSelectedBacklogKb?: number | null;
  readonly tacSelectedBacklogKb?: number | null;
}

/**
 * Immutable snapshot of a simulation frame's scheduler state and performance telemetry.
 * Contains no references to the mutable live simulation engine or full terrain DEM.
 */
export interface SchedulerFrameRecord {
  readonly frameIndex: number;
  readonly simulationTimeS: number;
  readonly schedulerMode: string;
  readonly selectedNodeId: number | null;
  readonly spatialRevision?: number;
  readonly activeAllocations: readonly SchedulerSlotAllocation[];
  readonly staticAllocations?: readonly SchedulerSlotAllocation[];
  readonly tacAllocations?: readonly SchedulerSlotAllocation[];
  readonly nodeBacklogs: readonly SchedulerNodeBacklog[];
  readonly kpi: SchedulerKpiSnapshot;
  readonly ctrlDurationMs?: number;
  readonly dlDurationMs?: number;
}

export interface SchedulerHistorySpan {
  readonly count: number;
  readonly capacity: number;
  readonly oldestFrame: number | null;
  readonly newestFrame: number | null;
  readonly oldestTimeS: number | null;
  readonly newestTimeS: number | null;
}

/**
 * Measures the approximate memory footprint of a single scheduler frame record in bytes.
 * Validates stored data shape and verifies DEM and full terrain structures are absent.
 */
export function estimateSchedulerRecordMemoryBytes(record: SchedulerFrameRecord): number {
  if (!record || typeof record !== 'object') return 0;

  // Base JS object envelope
  let bytes = 64;

  // Scalars: frameIndex, simulationTimeS, selectedNodeId
  bytes += (record.selectedNodeId !== null ? 3 : 2) * 8;
  bytes += (record.schedulerMode?.length ?? 0) * 2;

  // Active allocations array
  if (Array.isArray(record.activeAllocations)) {
    bytes += 32; // array envelope
    for (const alloc of record.activeAllocations) {
      bytes += 80; // numbers + booleans
      bytes += (alloc.modcodName?.length ?? 0) * 2;
    }
  }

  // Node backlogs array (16 nodes)
  if (Array.isArray(record.nodeBacklogs)) {
    bytes += 32;
    for (const nb of record.nodeBacklogs) {
      bytes += 96; // 10 numeric/boolean fields
      bytes += (nb.name?.length ?? 0) * 2;
      bytes += (nb.stateName?.length ?? 0) * 2;
    }
  }

  // KPI snapshot object
  if (record.kpi && typeof record.kpi === 'object') {
    bytes += 64;
    bytes += Object.keys(record.kpi).length * 8;
    bytes += (record.kpi.node4EvacStatus?.length ?? 0) * 2;
  }

  return bytes;
}

/**
 * Creates a defensive, deeply immutable snapshot of a scheduler frame record from incoming telemetry.
 */
export function createSchedulerRecordSnapshot(input: {
  frameIndex: number;
  simulationTimeS: number;
  schedulerMode: string;
  selectedNodeId: number | null;
  spatialRevision?: number;
  activeAllocations: readonly SchedulerSlotAllocation[];
  staticAllocations?: readonly SchedulerSlotAllocation[];
  tacAllocations?: readonly SchedulerSlotAllocation[];
  nodeBacklogs: readonly SchedulerNodeBacklog[];
  kpi: SchedulerKpiSnapshot;
  ctrlDurationMs?: number;
  dlDurationMs?: number;
}): SchedulerFrameRecord {
  // Defensive copy and freeze of active allocations
  const clonedActiveAllocations: SchedulerSlotAllocation[] = Array.isArray(input.activeAllocations)
    ? input.activeAllocations.map(a => Object.freeze({
        nodeId: a.nodeId,
        startMs: a.startMs,
        durationMs: a.durationMs,
        durationS: a.durationS,
        slotStartS: a.slotStartS,
        capacityBits: a.capacityBits,
        modcodName: a.modcodName,
        spectralEfficiency: a.spectralEfficiency,
        c2Bytes: a.c2Bytes,
        voiceBytes: a.voiceBytes,
        videoBytes: a.videoBytes,
        photoBytes: a.photoBytes,
        isPreOcclusionFlush: Boolean(a.isPreOcclusionFlush),
      }))
    : [];

  const clonedStaticAllocations: SchedulerSlotAllocation[] | undefined = Array.isArray(input.staticAllocations)
    ? input.staticAllocations.map(a => Object.freeze({ ...a }))
    : undefined;

  const clonedTacAllocations: SchedulerSlotAllocation[] | undefined = Array.isArray(input.tacAllocations)
    ? input.tacAllocations.map(a => Object.freeze({ ...a }))
    : undefined;

  // Defensive copy and freeze of node backlogs
  const clonedBacklogs: SchedulerNodeBacklog[] = Array.isArray(input.nodeBacklogs)
    ? input.nodeBacklogs.map(nb => Object.freeze({
        nodeId: nb.nodeId,
        name: nb.name,
        c2Bytes: nb.c2Bytes,
        voiceBytes: nb.voiceBytes,
        videoBytes: nb.videoBytes,
        photoBytes: nb.photoBytes,
        totalBacklogBytes: nb.totalBacklogBytes,
        c2Packets: nb.c2Packets,
        voicePackets: nb.voicePackets,
        videoPackets: nb.videoPackets,
        photoPackets: nb.photoPackets,
        snrDb: nb.snrDb,
        bitrateMbps: nb.bitrateMbps,
        stateName: nb.stateName,
        linkOutage: nb.linkOutage,
        obstacleBlocked: nb.obstacleBlocked,
      }))
    : [];

  const frozenKpi: SchedulerKpiSnapshot = Object.freeze({
    ...input.kpi,
  });

  const record: SchedulerFrameRecord = Object.freeze({
    frameIndex: input.frameIndex,
    simulationTimeS: input.simulationTimeS,
    schedulerMode: input.schedulerMode,
    selectedNodeId: input.selectedNodeId,
    spatialRevision: input.spatialRevision ?? 0,
    activeAllocations: Object.freeze(clonedActiveAllocations),
    staticAllocations: clonedStaticAllocations ? Object.freeze(clonedStaticAllocations) : undefined,
    tacAllocations: clonedTacAllocations ? Object.freeze(clonedTacAllocations) : undefined,
    nodeBacklogs: Object.freeze(clonedBacklogs),
    kpi: frozenKpi,
    ctrlDurationMs: input.ctrlDurationMs,
    dlDurationMs: input.dlDurationMs,
  });

  return record;
}

/**
 * Pre-allocated circular ring buffer for historical scheduler frames.
 * Enforces strict FIFO eviction in O(1) time without array reallocations.
 */
export class SchedulerHistoryBuffer {
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly buffer: (SchedulerFrameRecord | null)[];
  private head: number = 0;   // Monotonically increasing insertion counter
  private length: number = 0; // Current count: min(head, capacity)

  constructor(capacity = 3000) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(capacity) || capacity < 2) {
      throw new Error(`SchedulerHistoryBuffer capacity must be an integer >= 2, got ${capacity}`);
    }
    this.capacity = capacity;
    this.buffer = new Array<SchedulerFrameRecord | null>(capacity).fill(null);
  }

  public get maxCapacity(): number {
    return this.capacity;
  }

  public get size(): number {
    return this.length;
  }

  /**
   * Pushes a new scheduler frame record into the ring buffer. Evicts the oldest record in O(1) time when full.
   * If a frame-index regression (e.g. worker reset or restart) is detected, clears the buffer first
   * so lookups remain strictly monotonic. Replaces duplicate consecutive frames in-place.
   */
  public push(record: SchedulerFrameRecord): void {
    if (!record || typeof record.frameIndex !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(record.frameIndex)) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.length > 0) {
      const newest = this.getNewest();
      if (newest) {
        // Detect frame-index regression or worker restart
        if (record.frameIndex < newest.frameIndex) {
          this.clear();
        } else if (newest.frameIndex === record.frameIndex) {
          const slot = (this.head - 1 + this.capacity) % this.capacity;
          this.buffer[slot] = record;
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    const slot = this.head % this.capacity;
    this.buffer[slot] = record;
    this.head++;
    if (this.length < this.capacity) {
      this.length++;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Looks up a historical scheduler record by exact frame index.
   */
  public getByFrameIndex(frameIndex: number): SchedulerFrameRecord | null {
    if (this.length === 0 || !Number.isFinite(frameIndex)) return null;

    const oldest = this.getOldest();
    const newest = this.getNewest();
    if (!oldest || !newest) return null;
    if (frameIndex < oldest.frameIndex || frameIndex > newest.frameIndex) {
      return null;
    }

    // Search backward from newest
    const startOffset = this.head - 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.length; i++) {
      const slot = (startOffset - i) % this.capacity;
      const rec = this.buffer[slot];
      if (rec && rec.frameIndex === frameIndex) {
        return rec;
      }
      if (rec && rec.frameIndex < frameIndex) {
        break;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Returns the oldest available record currently in the buffer, or null if empty.
   */
  public getOldest(): SchedulerFrameRecord | null {
    if (this.length === 0) return null;
    const slot = (this.head - this.length) % this.capacity;
    return this.buffer[slot];
  }

  /**
   * Returns the newest available record currently in the buffer, or null if empty.
   */
  public getNewest(): SchedulerFrameRecord | null {
    if (this.length === 0) return null;
    const slot = (this.head - 1) % this.capacity;
    return this.buffer[slot];
  }

  /**
   * Checks whether a given frame index was once recorded but has since been evicted.
   */
  public isEvicted(frameIndex: number): boolean {
    if (this.length === 0 || !Number.isFinite(frameIndex)) return false;
    const oldest = this.getOldest();
    return oldest !== null && frameIndex < oldest.frameIndex;
  }

  /**
   * Returns a summary of current historical coverage.
   */
  public getSpan(): SchedulerHistorySpan {
    const oldest = this.getOldest();
    const newest = this.getNewest();
    return {
      count: this.length,
      capacity: this.capacity,
      oldestFrame: oldest ? oldest.frameIndex : null,
      newestFrame: newest ? newest.frameIndex : null,
      oldestTimeS: oldest ? oldest.simulationTimeS : null,
      newestTimeS: newest ? newest.simulationTimeS : null,

  }

  /**
   * Returns all retained records in chronological order.
   * Useful for trend chart rendering.
   */
  public getChronologicalRecords(): SchedulerFrameRecord[] {
    if (this.length === 0) return [];
    const result: SchedulerFrameRecord[] = [];
    const startSlot = (this.head - this.length) % this.capacity;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.length; i++) {
      const slot = (startSlot + i) % this.capacity;
      const rec = this.buffer[slot];
      if (rec) result.push(rec);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * Clears all records and resets pointers.
   */
  public clear(): void {
    this.buffer.fill(null);
    this.head = 0;
    this.length = 0;
  }

  /**
   * Measures total memory footprint in bytes.
   */
  public measureTotalMemoryBytes(): number {
    let total = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.length; i++) {
      const slot = (this.head - 1 - i) % this.capacity;
      const rec = this.buffer[slot];
      if (rec) {
        total += estimateSchedulerRecordMemoryBytes(rec);
      }
    }

  }
}

/**
 * State machine managing scheduler historical inspection vs live stream mode.
 * Enforces strictly read-only inspection and tracks simulation running/paused state.
 */
export class SchedulerHistoryController {
  private readonly buffer: SchedulerHistoryBuffer;
  private inspecting: boolean = false;
  private inspectedFrameIndex: number | null = null;
  private wasRunningBeforeHistorical: boolean = false;
  private isCurrentlyEvicted: boolean = false;

  constructor(buffer: SchedulerHistoryBuffer) {
    this.buffer = buffer;
  }

  public get historyBuffer(): SchedulerHistoryBuffer {
    return this.buffer;
  }

  public get isInspecting(): boolean {
    return this.inspecting;
  }

  public get currentInspectedFrame(): number | null {
    return this.inspectedFrameIndex;
  }

  public get wasRunningBefore(): boolean {
    return this.wasRunningBeforeHistorical;
  }

  public get isEvicted(): boolean {
    return this.isCurrentlyEvicted;
  }

  /**
   * Enters historical inspection mode.
   * If the simulation was actively running, flags shouldPause = true so the caller can pause the worker.
   */
  public enterHistorical(targetFrameIndex?: number, isCurrentlyRunning = false): {
    record: SchedulerFrameRecord | null;
    shouldPause: boolean;
  } {
    if (!this.inspecting) {
      this.inspecting = true;
      this.wasRunningBeforeHistorical = isCurrentlyRunning;
    }

    const newest = this.buffer.getNewest();
    const frameToInspect = typeof targetFrameIndex === 'number'
      ? targetFrameIndex
      : (newest ? newest.frameIndex : 0);

    const record = this.scrubTo(frameToInspect);

    return {
      record,
      shouldPause: isCurrentlyRunning,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Scrubs historical inspection to a target frame index.
   * If the requested frame was evicted or is unavailable, clamps to the nearest valid frame.
   */
  public scrubTo(frameIndex: number): SchedulerFrameRecord | null {
    this.inspecting = true;
    this.inspectedFrameIndex = frameIndex;

    const direct = this.buffer.getByFrameIndex(frameIndex);
    if (direct) {
      this.isCurrentlyEvicted = false;
      return direct;
    }

    // Check if evicted
    if (this.buffer.isEvicted(frameIndex)) {
      this.isCurrentlyEvicted = true;
      const oldest = this.buffer.getOldest();
      if (oldest) {
        this.inspectedFrameIndex = oldest.frameIndex;
        return oldest;
      }
    }

    // Clamp to newest if ahead
    const newest = this.buffer.getNewest();
    if (newest && frameIndex > newest.frameIndex) {
      this.isCurrentlyEvicted = false;
      this.inspectedFrameIndex = newest.frameIndex;
      return newest;
    }

    this.isCurrentlyEvicted = false;
    return newest ?? null;
  }

  /**
   * Exits historical inspection and returns to LIVE mode.
   */
  public exitHistorical(): { shouldResume: boolean } {
    const shouldResume = this.wasRunningBeforeHistorical;
    this.inspecting = false;
    this.inspectedFrameIndex = null;
    this.wasRunningBeforeHistorical = false;
    this.isCurrentlyEvicted = false;
    return { shouldResume };
  }

  /**
   * Returns the active record to render: currently inspected frame if in historical mode, or null in LIVE mode.
   */
  public getActiveHistoricalRecord(): SchedulerFrameRecord | null {
    if (!this.inspecting || this.inspectedFrameIndex === null) {
      return null;
    }
    return this.scrubTo(this.inspectedFrameIndex);
  }

  /**
   * Resets historical controller state.
   */
  public reset(): void {
    this.inspecting = false;
    this.inspectedFrameIndex = null;
    this.wasRunningBeforeHistorical = false;
    this.isCurrentlyEvicted = false;
    this.buffer.clear();
  }
}

/**
 * Empirically measures the approximate memory footprint of a single historical frame record in bytes.
 * Validates actual stored data shape rather than assuming static sizing.
 */
export function estimateRecordMemoryBytes(record: HistoricalFrameRecord): number {
  if (!record || typeof record !== 'object') return 0;

  // Base JS object overhead (~64 bytes for record envelope)
  let bytes = 64;

  // Scalar numbers and booleans (~8 bytes each)
  bytes += 10 * 8; // frameIndex, simulationTimeS, selectedNodeId, profileSerial, etc.
  bytes += (record.nodeName?.length ?? 0) * 2;

  // Position 3D arrays (3 floats + array overhead ~56 bytes)
  bytes += 56 * 2;

  // Obstruction summary
  bytes += 64 + (record.obstruction.terrainStatusText?.length ?? 0) * 2 +
    (record.obstruction.obstacleStatusText?.length ?? 0) * 2 +
    (record.obstruction.primaryBlockedObstacleId?.length ?? 0) * 2;

  // Link budget snapshot
  bytes += 64 + (record.linkBudget.modcodName?.length ?? 0) * 2;

  // Profile
  if (record.profile && typeof record.profile === 'object') {
    bytes += 128; // profile object overhead

    // Samples: 64 samples × ~72 bytes per sample (9 numeric properties + object)
    if (Array.isArray(record.profile.samples)) {
      bytes += record.profile.samples.length * 72;
    }

    // Obstacle intervals: ~64 bytes per interval + obstacleId string
    if (Array.isArray(record.profile.obstacleIntervals)) {
      for (const interval of record.profile.obstacleIntervals) {
        bytes += 64 + (interval.obstacleId?.length ?? 0) * 2;
      }
    }
  }

  // Legacy profile points if present: 4 numbers per point = 32 bytes + array overhead
  if (Array.isArray(record.profilePoints)) {
    bytes += record.profilePoints.length * 32;
  }

  return bytes;
}

/**
 * Creates a defensive, immutable snapshot of a historical frame record from incoming telemetry.
 */
export function createHistoricalRecordSnapshot(input: {
  frameIndex: number;
  simulationTimeS: number;
  selectedNodeId: number;
  nodeName: string;
  profileSerial?: number;
  spatialRevision?: number;
  groundNodePositionMslM: Position3D;
  acnPositionMslM: Position3D;
  profile: LinkProfile;
  obstruction: HistoricalObstructionSummary;
  linkBudget: HistoricalLinkBudgetSnapshot;
  profilePoints?: readonly [number, number, number, number][];
  groundNodeAglM?: number;
}): HistoricalFrameRecord {
  // Defensive copy of profile samples
  const clonedSamples: LinkProfileSample[] = Array.isArray(input.profile?.samples)
    ? input.profile.samples.map(s => Object.freeze({ ...s }))
    : [];

  // Defensive copy of obstacle intervals
  const clonedIntervals: LinkProfileObstacleInterval[] = Array.isArray(input.profile?.obstacleIntervals)
    ? input.profile.obstacleIntervals.map(i => Object.freeze({ ...i }))
    : [];

  const frozenProfile: LinkProfile = Object.freeze({
    selectedGroundNodeId: input.profile?.selectedGroundNodeId ?? input.selectedNodeId,
    nodeName: input.profile?.nodeName ?? input.nodeName,
    frameIndex: input.profile?.frameIndex ?? input.frameIndex,
    simulationTimeS: input.profile?.simulationTimeS ?? input.simulationTimeS,
    groundNodePositionMslM: Object.freeze([...(input.profile?.groundNodePositionMslM ?? input.groundNodePositionMslM)]) as unknown as Position3D,
    acnPositionMslM: Object.freeze([...(input.profile?.acnPositionMslM ?? input.acnPositionMslM)]) as unknown as Position3D,
    horizontalGroundDistanceM: input.profile?.horizontalGroundDistanceM ?? 0,
    slantDistanceM: input.profile?.slantDistanceM ?? 0,
    fresnelFraction: input.profile?.fresnelFraction ?? 0.6,
    terrainIsLos: input.profile?.terrainIsLos ?? input.obstruction.terrainIsLos,
    terrainMinimumClearanceM: input.profile?.terrainMinimumClearanceM ?? input.obstruction.minClearanceM,
    terrainCriticalFresnelRadiusM: input.profile?.terrainCriticalFresnelRadiusM ?? 0,
    diffractionLossDb: input.profile?.diffractionLossDb ?? input.obstruction.diffractionLossDb,
    obstacleBlocked: input.profile?.obstacleBlocked ?? input.obstruction.obstacleBlocked,
    obstacleIntervals: Object.freeze(clonedIntervals),
    samples: Object.freeze(clonedSamples),
    valid: input.profile?.valid ?? true,
  });

  const record: HistoricalFrameRecord = Object.freeze({
    frameIndex: input.frameIndex,
    simulationTimeS: input.simulationTimeS,
    selectedNodeId: input.selectedNodeId,
    nodeName: input.nodeName,
    profileSerial: input.profileSerial ?? 0,
    spatialRevision: input.spatialRevision ?? 0,
    groundNodePositionMslM: Object.freeze([...input.groundNodePositionMslM]) as unknown as Position3D,
    acnPositionMslM: Object.freeze([...input.acnPositionMslM]) as unknown as Position3D,
    profile: frozenProfile,
    obstruction: Object.freeze({ ...input.obstruction }),
    linkBudget: Object.freeze({ ...input.linkBudget }),
    profilePoints: input.profilePoints ? Object.freeze(input.profilePoints.map(p => Object.freeze([...p]) as unknown as [number, number, number, number])) : undefined,
    groundNodeAglM: input.groundNodeAglM,
  });

  return record;
}

/**

 * Enforces strict FIFO eviction in O(1) time without array reallocations.

export class SimulationHistoryBuffer {
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly buffer: (HistoricalFrameRecord | null)[];
  private head: number = 0;   // Monotonically increasing insertion counter
  private length: number = 0; // Current count: min(head, capacity)

  public push(record: HistoricalFrameRecord): void {

      return;
    }

    if (this.length > 0) {
      const newest = this.getNewest();
      if (newest) {

        if (record.frameIndex < newest.frameIndex) {
          this.clear();
        } else if (record.frameIndex === newest.frameIndex) {
          // Replace slot for consecutive duplicate frame index (e.g. paused refresh)
          const slot = (this.head - 1 + this.capacity) % this.capacity;
          this.buffer[slot] = record;

    const slot = this.head % this.capacity;
    this.buffer[slot] = record;
    this.head++;
    if (this.length < this.capacity) {

  public getByFrameIndex(frameIndex: number): HistoricalFrameRecord | null {
    if (this.length === 0 || !Number.isFinite(frameIndex)) return null;

    const oldest = this.getOldest();
    const newest = this.getNewest();
    if (!oldest || !newest) return null;
    if (frameIndex < oldest.frameIndex || frameIndex > newest.frameIndex) {
      return null;
    }

    // Search backward from newest (most queries target recent frames)
    const startOffset = this.head - 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.length; i++) {
      const slot = (startOffset - i) % this.capacity;
      const rec = this.buffer[slot];
      if (rec && rec.frameIndex === frameIndex) {
        return rec;
      }
      if (rec && rec.frameIndex < frameIndex) {
        // Frame sequence is strictly monotone increasing; if we passed below frameIndex, it is absent.
        break;
      }
    }
    return null;

  public getOldest(): HistoricalFrameRecord | null {

    const slot = (this.head - this.length) % this.capacity;
    return this.buffer[slot];

  public getNewest(): HistoricalFrameRecord | null {
    if (this.length === 0) return null;
    const slot = (this.head - 1) % this.capacity;
    return this.buffer[slot];
  }

   */
  public isEvicted(frameIndex: number): boolean {
    if (this.length === 0 || !Number.isFinite(frameIndex)) return false;
    const oldest = this.getOldest();
    return oldest !== null && frameIndex < oldest.frameIndex;

  public getSpan(): HistorySpan {
    const oldest = this.getOldest();
    const newest = this.getNewest();

      capacity: this.capacity,
      oldestFrame: oldest ? oldest.frameIndex : null,
      newestFrame: newest ? newest.frameIndex : null,

      newestTimeS: newest ? newest.simulationTimeS : null,

  public clear(): void {

  public measureTotalMemoryBytes(): number {

    for (let i = 0; i < this.length; i++) {
      const slot = (this.head - 1 - i) % this.capacity;
      const rec = this.buffer[slot];

/**
 * State machine managing historical inspection vs live stream mode.
 * Enforces the invariant that historical inspection is strictly read-only and
 * preserves prior simulation running/paused state across LIVE returns.
 */
export class SimulationHistoryController {
  private readonly buffer: SimulationHistoryBuffer;
  private inspecting: boolean = false;
  private inspectedFrameIndex: number | null = null;
  private wasRunningBeforeHistorical: boolean = false;
  private isCurrentlyEvicted: boolean = false;

  constructor(buffer: SimulationHistoryBuffer) {
    this.buffer = buffer;
  }

  public get historyBuffer(): SimulationHistoryBuffer {
    return this.buffer;
  }

  public get isInspecting(): boolean {
    return this.inspecting;
  }

  public get currentInspectedFrame(): number | null {
    return this.inspectedFrameIndex;
  }

  public get wasRunningBefore(): boolean {
    return this.wasRunningBeforeHistorical;
  }

  public get isEvicted(): boolean {
    return this.isCurrentlyEvicted;
  }

  /**
   * Enters historical inspection mode.
   * If the simulation was actively running, flags shouldPause = true so the caller
   * can pause the worker, and remembers that it was running so returning to LIVE resumes.
   */
  public enterHistorical(targetFrameIndex?: number, isCurrentlyRunning = false): {
    record: HistoricalFrameRecord | null;
    shouldPause: boolean;
  } {
    if (!this.inspecting) {
      this.inspecting = true;
      this.wasRunningBeforeHistorical = isCurrentlyRunning;
    }

    const newest = this.buffer.getNewest();
    const frameToInspect = typeof targetFrameIndex === 'number'
      ? targetFrameIndex
      : (newest ? newest.frameIndex : 0);

    const record = this.scrubTo(frameToInspect);

    return {
      record,
      shouldPause: isCurrentlyRunning,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Scrubs historical inspection to a target frame index.
   * If the requested frame was evicted or is unavailable, clamps to the nearest valid frame
   * and sets isCurrentlyEvicted = true.
   */
  public scrubTo(frameIndex: number): HistoricalFrameRecord | null {
    this.inspecting = true;
    this.inspectedFrameIndex = frameIndex;

    const direct = this.buffer.getByFrameIndex(frameIndex);
    if (direct) {
      this.isCurrentlyEvicted = false;
      return direct;
    }

    // Check if evicted
    if (this.buffer.isEvicted(frameIndex)) {
      this.isCurrentlyEvicted = true;
      const oldest = this.buffer.getOldest();
      if (oldest) {
        this.inspectedFrameIndex = oldest.frameIndex;
        return oldest;
      }
    }

    // Clamp to newest if target is ahead
    const newest = this.buffer.getNewest();
    if (newest && frameIndex > newest.frameIndex) {
      this.isCurrentlyEvicted = false;
      this.inspectedFrameIndex = newest.frameIndex;
      return newest;
    }

    this.isCurrentlyEvicted = false;
    return newest ?? null;
  }

  /**
   * Exits historical inspection and returns to LIVE mode.
   * Tells the caller whether the simulation should resume based on its prior running state.
   */
  public exitHistorical(): { shouldResume: boolean } {
    const shouldResume = this.wasRunningBeforeHistorical;
    this.inspecting = false;
    this.inspectedFrameIndex = null;
    this.wasRunningBeforeHistorical = false;
    this.isCurrentlyEvicted = false;
    return { shouldResume };
  }

  /**
   * Returns the active record to render: the currently inspected historical frame if in
   * historical mode, or null if in LIVE mode.
   */
  public getActiveHistoricalRecord(): HistoricalFrameRecord | null {
    if (!this.inspecting || this.inspectedFrameIndex === null) {
      return null;
    }
    return this.scrubTo(this.inspectedFrameIndex);
  }

  /**
   * Resets historical controller state when the entire simulation is reset.
   */
  public reset(): void {
    this.inspecting = false;
    this.inspectedFrameIndex = null;
    this.wasRunningBeforeHistorical = false;
    this.isCurrentlyEvicted = false;
    this.buffer.clear();
  }

    readonly subtitle: string;
  };
  readonly dimensionsTag?: {
    readonly x: number;
    readonly y: number;
    readonly w: number;
    readonly h: number;
    readonly text: string;
  };
}

/**
 * Maps world Cartesian coordinates (metres from origin) to 2D Canvas screen coordinates.
 */
export function worldToRadarScreen(
  xM: number,
  yM: number,
  geometry: RadarGeometry,
  pan: PanOffset
): { x: number; y: number } {
  return {
    x: geometry.centerX + (xM - pan.xM) * geometry.scale,
    y: geometry.centerY - (yM - pan.yM) * geometry.scale,
  };
}

/**
 * Maps 2D Canvas screen coordinates back to world Cartesian coordinates (metres from origin).
 */
export function radarScreenToWorld(
  px: number,
  py: number,
  geometry: RadarGeometry,
  pan: PanOffset
): { xM: number; yM: number } {
  return {
    xM: (px - geometry.centerX) / geometry.scale + pan.xM,
    yM: (geometry.centerY - py) / geometry.scale + pan.yM,
  };
}

/**
 * Computes authoritative screen bounds for terrain rendering.
 * In real DEM mode: uses genuine geographic bounds (+/-91.84 km E-W, +/-110.93 km N-S, aspect ratio ~1.208).
 * In synthetic mode: uses square full-theater regional domain (+/-600 km, aspect ratio 1.0).
 */
export function computeTerrainScreenBounds(
  bounds: TerrainBoundsTelemetry | null,
  fallbackRadiusM: number,
  geometry: RadarGeometry,
  pan: PanOffset
): TerrainScreenBounds {
  let minX: number, maxX: number, minY: number, maxY: number;
  let isRealMode = false;
  let isValidCoverage = false;

  if (bounds && typeof bounds === 'object') {
    minX = bounds.minX;
    maxX = bounds.maxX;
    minY = bounds.minY;
    maxY = bounds.maxY;
    isRealMode = bounds.terrainMode === 'real';
    isValidCoverage = bounds.isValidCoverage;
  } else {
    minX = -fallbackRadiusM;
    maxX = fallbackRadiusM;
    minY = -fallbackRadiusM;
    maxY = fallbackRadiusM;
    isRealMode = false;
    isValidCoverage = true;
  }

  // Top-Left is North-West (minX, maxY) because +Y is North (up) and Canvas screen Y is down.
  const tl = worldToRadarScreen(minX, maxY, geometry, pan);
  // Bottom-Right is South-East (maxX, minY).
  const br = worldToRadarScreen(maxX, minY, geometry, pan);

  const width = br.x - tl.x;
  const height = br.y - tl.y;
  const aspectRatio = width > 0 ? height / width : 1.0;

  return {
    tl,
    br,
    width,
    height,
    aspectRatio,
    isRealMode,
    isValidCoverage,
    minX,
    maxX,
    minY,
    maxY,
  };
}

/**
 * Processes worker-provided 2D packed RGB grid into raw ImageData byte array.
 * Converts packed 0 or invalid samples into completely transparent pixels (alpha = 0),
 * preventing unmapped or missing terrain from being painted as opaque black elevation.
 */
export function processHillshadeImageData(
  data: readonly (readonly number[])[],
  targetImgData: Uint8ClampedArray | number[]
): { validPixels: number; transparentPixels: number } {
  let validPixels = 0;
  let transparentPixels = 0;
  let p = 0;

  const numRows = data.length;
  for (let r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
    const row = data[r];
    const numCols = row.length;
    for (let c = 0; c < numCols; c++) {
      const v = row[c];
      if (typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0) {
        const red = (v >> 16) & 255;
        const green = (v >> 8) & 255;
        const blue = v & 255;
        targetImgData[p++] = Math.min(255, red);
        targetImgData[p++] = Math.min(255, green);
        targetImgData[p++] = Math.min(255, blue);
        targetImgData[p++] = 255; // Fully opaque for valid terrain
        validPixels++;
      } else {
        // Transparent for unmapped, out-of-coverage, or NaN samples
        targetImgData[p++] = 0;
        targetImgData[p++] = 0;
        targetImgData[p++] = 0;
        targetImgData[p++] = 0; // Fully transparent
        transparentPixels++;
      }
    }
  }

  return { validPixels, transparentPixels };
}

/**
 * Computes tactical coverage boundary geometry including brackets, reticles, and labels.
 * Returns null if not in real DEM mode or coverage is not valid.
 */
export function computeDemBoundaryGeometry(
  screenBounds: TerrainScreenBounds,
  canvasWidth: number,
  canvasHeight: number,
  bounds: TerrainBoundsTelemetry | null
): DemBoundaryGeometry | null {
  if (!screenBounds.isRealMode) {
    return null;
  }

  const { tl, br, width, height, maxX, maxY } = screenBounds;
  const rect = { x: tl.x, y: tl.y, w: width, h: height };

  const cornerLen = Math.min(16, Math.max(6, Math.min(width, height) * 0.08));

  const brackets = {
    tl: [
      [tl.x, tl.y + cornerLen],
      [tl.x, tl.y],
      [tl.x + cornerLen, tl.y],
    ] as const,
    tr: [
      [br.x - cornerLen, tl.y],
      [br.x, tl.y],
      [br.x, tl.y + cornerLen],
    ] as const,
    bl: [
      [tl.x, br.y - cornerLen],
      [tl.x, br.y],
      [tl.x + cornerLen, br.y],
    ] as const,
    br: [
      [br.x - cornerLen, br.y],
      [br.x, br.y],
      [br.x, br.y - cornerLen],
    ] as const,
  };

  const title = 'SATELLITE DEM COVERAGE';
  const rasterW = bounds?.rasterWidth ?? REAL_LADAKH_DEM_METADATA.rasterWidth;
  const rasterH = bounds?.rasterHeight ?? REAL_LADAKH_DEM_METADATA.rasterHeight;
  const tileLabel = bounds?.tileName ?? 'LADAKH';
  const subtitle = `${tileLabel} (${rasterW}×${rasterH})`;

  const badgeW = 148;
  const badgeH = 26;
  const badgeX = Math.max(10, Math.min(canvasWidth - badgeW - 10, tl.x + 8));
  const badgeY = Math.max(10, Math.min(canvasHeight - badgeH - 10, tl.y + 8));

  const badge = {
    x: badgeX,
    y: badgeY,
    w: badgeW,
    h: badgeH,
    title,
    subtitle,
  };

  let dimensionsTag: DemBoundaryGeometry['dimensionsTag'] = undefined;
  if (br.x >= 90 && br.y >= 30 && br.x <= canvasWidth + 50 && br.y <= canvasHeight + 50) {
    const text = `±${(maxX / 1000).toFixed(1)} km E-W × ±${(maxY / 1000).toFixed(1)} km N-S`;
    const dimW = 160;
    const dimH = 15;
    const dimX = Math.max(10, Math.min(canvasWidth - dimW - 10, br.x - dimW - 8));
    const dimY = Math.max(20, Math.min(canvasHeight - dimH - 8, br.y - dimH - 6));
    dimensionsTag = {
      x: dimX,
      y: dimY,
      w: dimW,
      h: dimH,
      text,
    };
  }

  return {
    rect,
    brackets,
    badge,
    dimensionsTag,
  };
}

/**
 * Renders the tactical satellite DEM coverage boundary and labels onto the 2D canvas context.
 */
export function renderDemCoverageBoundary(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  geom: DemBoundaryGeometry,
  monoFont: string
): void {
  ctx.save();

  // 1. Dashed coverage boundary
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.65)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.setLineDash([8, 5]);
  ctx.strokeRect(geom.rect.x, geom.rect.y, geom.rect.w, geom.rect.h);
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // 2. Solid corner brackets
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.90)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;

  for (const b of [geom.brackets.tl, geom.brackets.tr, geom.brackets.bl, geom.brackets.br]) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(b[0][0], b[0][1]);
    ctx.lineTo(b[1][0], b[1][1]);
    ctx.lineTo(b[2][0], b[2][1]);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // 3. Identification badge
  const b = geom.badge;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(11, 14, 20, 0.88)';
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.50)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
  ctx.strokeRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);

  ctx.font = `bold 9px ${monoFont}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.95)';
  ctx.fillText(b.title, b.x + 7, b.y + 11);

  ctx.font = `8px ${monoFont}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.85)';
  ctx.fillText(b.subtitle, b.x + 7, b.y + 21);

  // 4. Subtle dimensions tag at bottom-right
  if (geom.dimensionsTag) {
    const d = geom.dimensionsTag;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(11, 14, 20, 0.85)';
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
    ctx.strokeRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);

    ctx.font = `8px ${monoFont}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.90)';
    ctx.fillText(d.text, d.x + 4, d.y + 11);
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

import { MAX_ACN_WAYPOINTS } from '../core/config';

export type TrajectoryMode = 'ellipse' | 'waypoints';
export interface WaypointPoint { xM: number; yM: number; }
export interface EllipseDraft {
  mode: 'ellipse'; centerXm: number; centerYm: number;
  radiusAM: number; radiusBM: number; rotationDeg: number;
}
export interface WaypointDraft { mode: 'waypoints'; points: WaypointPoint[]; }
export type TrajectoryDraft = EllipseDraft | WaypointDraft;

export function parseEditorNumber(value: string): number {
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  return trimmed === '' ? Number.NaN : Number(trimmed);
}

/** Node targets win overlaps; waypoint selection remains available outside a node hitbox. */
export function canvasPointerTarget(nodeDistancePx: number, waypointDistancePx: number, nodeRadiusPx = 16, waypointRadiusPx = 12): 'node' | 'waypoint' | null {
  if (nodeDistancePx <= nodeRadiusPx) return 'node';
  if (waypointDistancePx <= waypointRadiusPx) return 'waypoint';
  return null;
}

export function cloneTrajectoryDraft(draft: TrajectoryDraft): TrajectoryDraft {
  return draft.mode === 'ellipse' ? { ...draft } : { mode: 'waypoints', points: draft.points.map(point => ({ ...point })) };
}

/** UI-only draft state; committed state changes only from authoritative worker telemetry. */
export class TrajectoryEditorState {
  private readonly committed = new Map<TrajectoryMode, TrajectoryDraft>();
  private readonly drafts = new Map<TrajectoryMode, TrajectoryDraft>();
  public activeMode: TrajectoryMode = 'ellipse';
  public selectedWaypoint = -1;
  private inputError: string | null = null;

  constructor() {
    const ellipse: EllipseDraft = { mode: 'ellipse', centerXm: 0, centerYm: 0, radiusAM: 20000, radiusBM: 10000, rotationDeg: 35 };
    const waypoints: WaypointDraft = { mode: 'waypoints', points: [] };
    this.committed.set('ellipse', ellipse);
    this.committed.set('waypoints', waypoints);
    this.drafts.set('ellipse', cloneTrajectoryDraft(ellipse));
    this.drafts.set('waypoints', cloneTrajectoryDraft(waypoints));
  }

  public get preview(): TrajectoryDraft { return cloneTrajectoryDraft(this.drafts.get(this.activeMode)!); }
  public get committedActive(): TrajectoryDraft { return cloneTrajectoryDraft(this.committed.get(this.activeMode)!); }
  public get dirty(): boolean { return JSON.stringify(this.preview) !== JSON.stringify(this.committedActive); }

  public setMode(mode: TrajectoryMode): void {
    this.activeMode = mode;
    this.inputError = null;
    if (mode === 'waypoints') {
      const draft = this.preview as WaypointDraft;
      this.selectedWaypoint = Math.min(this.selectedWaypoint, draft.points.length - 1);
    } else this.selectedWaypoint = -1;
  }

  public editEllipse(update: Partial<Omit<EllipseDraft, 'mode'>>): void {
    if (this.activeMode !== 'ellipse') throw new Error('Ellipse controls are inactive.');
    this.inputError = null;
    this.drafts.set('ellipse', { ...(this.preview as EllipseDraft), ...update });
  }

  public addWaypoint(point: WaypointPoint): number {
    if (this.activeMode !== 'waypoints') throw new Error('Waypoint controls are inactive.');
    this.assertWaypoint(point);
    this.inputError = null;
    const draft = this.preview as WaypointDraft;
    if (draft.points.length >= MAX_ACN_WAYPOINTS) throw new Error(`Maximum ${MAX_ACN_WAYPOINTS} waypoints reached.`);
    this.drafts.set('waypoints', { mode: 'waypoints', points: [...draft.points, { ...point }] });
    this.selectedWaypoint = draft.points.length;
    return this.selectedWaypoint;
  }

  public moveWaypoint(index: number, point: WaypointPoint): void {
    const draft = this.preview as WaypointDraft;
    if (this.activeMode !== 'waypoints' || !Number.isInteger(index) || !draft.points[index]) throw new Error('Select a waypoint to move.');
    this.assertWaypoint(point);
    this.inputError = null;
    const points = draft.points.map((item, i) => i === index ? { ...point } : item);
    this.drafts.set('waypoints', { mode: 'waypoints', points });
    this.selectedWaypoint = index;
  }

  public removeSelectedWaypoint(): void {
    const draft = this.preview as WaypointDraft;
    if (this.activeMode !== 'waypoints' || this.selectedWaypoint < 0 || !draft.points[this.selectedWaypoint]) throw new Error('Select a waypoint to remove.');
    if (draft.points.length <= 3) throw new Error('A closed waypoint path needs at least three points.');
    this.inputError = null;
    const points = draft.points.filter((_, i) => i !== this.selectedWaypoint);
    this.selectedWaypoint = Math.min(this.selectedWaypoint, points.length - 1);
    this.drafts.set('waypoints', { mode: 'waypoints', points });
  }

  public selectWaypoint(index: number): void {
    const draft = this.preview as WaypointDraft;
    this.inputError = null;
    this.selectedWaypoint = Number.isInteger(index) && index >= 0 && index < draft.points.length ? index : -1;
  }

  public validatePreview(): string | null {
    if (this.inputError) return this.inputError;
    const draft = this.preview;
    if (draft.mode === 'ellipse') {
      const values = [draft.centerXm, draft.centerYm, draft.radiusAM, draft.radiusBM, draft.rotationDeg];
      if (!values.every(Number.isFinite)) return 'Ellipse values must be finite numbers.';
      if (Math.abs(draft.centerXm) > 600000 || Math.abs(draft.centerYm) > 600000) return 'Ellipse center must be within ±600,000 m.';
      if (draft.radiusAM <= 0 || draft.radiusAM > 600000 || draft.radiusBM <= 0 || draft.radiusBM > 600000) return 'Ellipse axes must be greater than 0 and at most 600,000 m.';
      if (Math.abs(draft.rotationDeg) > 360) return 'Rotation must be within ±360 degrees.';
      return null;
    }
    if (draft.points.length < 3) return 'Add at least three waypoints to close the route.';
    if (draft.points.length > MAX_ACN_WAYPOINTS) return `A route can contain at most ${MAX_ACN_WAYPOINTS} waypoints.`;
    for (const point of draft.points) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(point.xM) || !Number.isFinite(point.yM)) return 'Waypoint coordinates must be finite numbers.';
      if (Math.abs(point.xM) > 600000 || Math.abs(point.yM) > 600000) return 'Waypoint coordinates must be within ±600,000 m.';
    }
    return null;
  }

  public setInputError(message: string | null): void { this.inputError = message; }

  private assertWaypoint(point: WaypointPoint): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(point.xM) || !Number.isFinite(point.yM)) throw new Error('Waypoint coordinates must be finite numbers.');
    if (Math.abs(point.xM) > 600000 || Math.abs(point.yM) > 600000) throw new Error('Waypoint coordinates must be within ±600,000 m.');
  }

  public cancel(): void {
    this.inputError = null;
    this.drafts.set(this.activeMode, cloneTrajectoryDraft(this.committed.get(this.activeMode)!));
    this.selectedWaypoint = -1;
  }

  public syncCommitted(config: any, forceDraft = false): void {
    if (config?.trajectory_mode === 'ellipse') {
      const draft: EllipseDraft = {
        mode: 'ellipse', centerXm: config.center_x_m, centerYm: config.center_y_m,
        radiusAM: config.orbit_a_m, radiusBM: config.orbit_b_m, rotationDeg: config.orbit_rotation_deg,
      };
      const existing = this.committed.get('ellipse')!;
      const draftIsClean = JSON.stringify(this.drafts.get('ellipse')) === JSON.stringify(existing);
      this.committed.set('ellipse', draft);
      if (forceDraft || draftIsClean) this.drafts.set('ellipse', cloneTrajectoryDraft(draft));
    } else if (config?.trajectory_mode === 'waypoints' && Array.isArray(config.waypoints)) {
      const draft: WaypointDraft = { mode: 'waypoints', points: config.waypoints.map((point: any) => ({ xM: point.x_m, yM: point.y_m })) };
      const existing = this.committed.get('waypoints')!;
      const draftIsClean = JSON.stringify(this.drafts.get('waypoints')) === JSON.stringify(existing);
      this.committed.set('waypoints', draft);
      if (forceDraft || draftIsClean) this.drafts.set('waypoints', cloneTrajectoryDraft(draft));
    }
  }
}

  constructor(config: ThreeRendererConfig) {
    this.container = config.container;

    if (config.canvas) {
      this.canvas = config.canvas;
    } else {
      this.canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      this.canvas.className = 'three-viewport-canvas';
      this.canvas.style.position = 'absolute';
      this.canvas.style.inset = '0';
      this.canvas.style.width = '100%';

    const initialWidth = Math.max(10, this.container.clientWidth || 800);
    const initialHeight = Math.max(10, this.container.clientHeight || 600);
    this.camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, initialWidth / initialHeight, 100, 2500000);

    // Apply default tactical camera preset
    this.applyCameraPreset(CAMERA_PRESETS.TACTICAL);

    // Initialize interactive OrbitControls for tactical 3D map navigation (M6.2.3-A)
    try {
      this.controls = new OrbitControls(this.camera, this.canvas);
      this.controls.target.copy(CAMERA_PRESETS.TACTICAL.target);
      this.controls.enableDamping = true;
      this.controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;
      this.controls.screenSpacePanning = true;
      this.controls.minDistance = 3000.0;     // 3 km minimum zoom prevents surface penetration
      this.controls.maxDistance = 300000.0;   // 300 km maximum zoom keeps theater visible
      this.controls.maxPolarAngle = Math.PI / 2 - 0.05; // ~87 deg strictly prevents orbiting below horizon
      this.controls.minPolarAngle = 0.05;     // prevents gimbal singularity at direct nadir
      this.controls.mouseButtons = {
        LEFT: THREE.MOUSE.ROTATE,
        MIDDLE: THREE.MOUSE.PAN,
        RIGHT: THREE.MOUSE.PAN,
      };
      this.controls.enabled = (this.viewMode === '3d');
      this.controls.update();
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[ThreeSceneManager] Failed to initialize OrbitControls:', err);
      this.controls = null;
    }

    // 3. Initialize worldGroup with approved coordinate rotation: -PI/2 around X
    // Inside worldGroup:
    //   +X = East (m)
    //   +Y = North (m)
    //   +Z = Altitude MSL (m)
    this.worldGroup = new THREE.Group();
    this.worldGroup.name = 'worldGroup';
    this.worldGroup.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    this.scene.add(this.worldGroup);

    // 4. Lighting setup (Three.js root space)
    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xdbeafe, 0.65);
    ambientLight.name = 'ambientLight';
    this.scene.add(ambientLight);

    const sunLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.25);
    sunLight.name = 'sunLight';
    // Sun shining from South-East at high elevation
    sunLight.position.set(50000, 120000, 80000);
    this.scene.add(sunLight);

    // 5. M6.2.3 Tactical 3D Entities Subsystem (ACN, Terminals, Trajectory, Links)
    this.tacticalEntityManager = new TacticalEntityManager();
    this.worldGroup.add(this.tacticalEntityManager.rootGroup);
    this.raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();

    // 6. M6.2.1 Placeholder visual indicators (NO fake terrain)
    this.placeholderGroup = new THREE.Group();
    this.placeholderGroup.name = 'm621PlaceholderGroup';
    this.setupPlaceholderVisuals();
    this.worldGroup.add(this.placeholderGroup);

    // 7. Setup listeners & observers
    this.setupContextListeners();
    this.setupResizeObservation();
    this.setupPointerListeners();

    // Initial sizing
    this.handleResize(initialWidth, initialHeight);
  }

  /**
   * Constructs explicit non-physical visual orientation aids for M6.2.1.
   * Clearly shows coordinate axes and DEM geographic footprint without generating fake elevation.
   */
  private setupPlaceholderVisuals(): void {
    // Coordinate axes inside worldGroup (+X East in red, +Y North in green, +Z Up in cyan)
    // Length: 25 km axes
    const axisLen = 25000;
    const axesHelper = new THREE.AxesHelper(axisLen);
    axesHelper.name = 'tacticalAxesHelper';
    this.placeholderGroup.add(axesHelper);

    // Demarcation bounding rectangle of authentic Ladakh DEM:
    // X: +/- 91,839.98 m, Y: +/- 110,931.45 m, rendered at base datum Z = 1,700 m MSL
    const halfW = 91839.98;
    const halfH = 110931.45;
    const datumZ = 1700.0;

    const points = [
      new THREE.Vector3(-halfW, -halfH, datumZ),
      new THREE.Vector3(halfW, -halfH, datumZ),
      new THREE.Vector3(halfW, halfH, datumZ),
      new THREE.Vector3(-halfW, halfH, datumZ),
      new THREE.Vector3(-halfW, -halfH, datumZ),
    ];
    const boundaryGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points);
    const boundaryMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
      color: 0x38bdf8,
      linewidth: 1.5,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.75,
    });
    const boundaryLine = new THREE.Line(boundaryGeo, boundaryMat);
    boundaryLine.name = 'demFootprintOutline';
    this.placeholderGroup.add(boundaryLine);

    // Origin reticle crosshair at (0, 0, datumZ)
    const crossSize = 10000;
    const crossPoints = [
      new THREE.Vector3(-crossSize, 0, datumZ),
      new THREE.Vector3(crossSize, 0, datumZ),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -crossSize, datumZ),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, crossSize, datumZ),
    ];
    const crossGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(crossPoints);
    const crossMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
      color: 0x0ea5e9,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.5,
    });
    const crossSegments = new THREE.LineSegments(crossGeo, crossMat);
    crossSegments.name = 'originCrosshairs';
    this.placeholderGroup.add(crossSegments);
  }

  /**
   * Applies a standard camera preset (position, target, up vector, fov)
   */
  public applyCameraPreset(preset: CameraPresetConfig): void {
    this.camera.position.copy(preset.position);
    this.camera.up.copy(preset.up);
    if (preset.fovDeg !== undefined && preset.fovDeg !== this.camera.fov) {
      this.camera.fov = preset.fovDeg;
    }
    this.camera.lookAt(preset.target);
    this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }

  /**
   * WebGL Context loss and restoration safety
   */
  private setupContextListeners(): void {
    const onContextLost = (event: Event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      console.warn('[ThreeSceneManager] WebGL context lost. Halting render loop.');
      this.isContextLost = true;
      this.stopAnimationLoop();
    };

    const onContextRestored = () => {
      console.log('[ThreeSceneManager] WebGL context restored. Re-syncing state.');
      this.isContextLost = false;
      this.handleResize();
      if (this.viewMode === '3d') {
        this.startAnimationLoop();
      }
    };

    this.canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', onContextLost, false);
    this.canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextrestored', onContextRestored, false);
  }

  /**
   * Resize observation setup
   */
  private setupResizeObservation(): void {
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
      this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (entry.target === this.container) {
            const { width, height } = entry.contentRect;
            if (width > 0 && height > 0) {
              this.handleResize(width, height);
            }
          }
        }
      });
      this.resizeObserver.observe(this.container);
    }

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      this.windowResizeListener = () => {
        if (this.container.clientWidth > 0 && this.container.clientHeight > 0) {
          this.handleResize(this.container.clientWidth, this.container.clientHeight);
        }
      };
      window.addEventListener('resize', this.windowResizeListener, { passive: true });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Pointer interaction setup for 3D camera controls and node selection.
   * Differentiates drags (orbit/pan) from genuine clicks (terminal selection)
   * using an explicit 5 px movement threshold.
   */
  private setupPointerListeners(): void {
    if (this.canvas && typeof this.canvas.addEventListener === 'function') {
      this.canvasPointerDownListener = (e: MouseEvent | PointerEvent) => {
        this.pointerDownPos = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
        this.isPointerDragging = false;
      };

      this.canvasPointerMoveListener = (e: MouseEvent | PointerEvent) => {
        if (this.pointerDownPos) {
          const dx = e.clientX - this.pointerDownPos.x;
          const dy = e.clientY - this.pointerDownPos.y;
          if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) >= ThreeSceneManager.DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX) {
            this.isPointerDragging = true;
          }
        }
      };

      this.canvasPointerUpListener = (_e: MouseEvent | PointerEvent) => {
        this.pointerDownPos = null;
      };

      this.canvasWheelListener = (_e: WheelEvent) => {
        this.isPointerDragging = true;
      };

      this.canvasClickListener = (e: MouseEvent) => {
        if (this.viewMode !== '3d') return;
        if (this.isPointerDragging) {
          // Camera orbit/pan drag or wheel zoom occurred; suppress terminal picking
          this.isPointerDragging = false;
          return;
        }
        const rect = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return;
        const ndcX = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
        const ndcY = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
        this.handlePointerClick(ndcX, ndcY);
      };

      this.canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', this.canvasPointerDownListener);
      this.canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', this.canvasPointerMoveListener);
      this.canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', this.canvasPointerUpListener);
      this.canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', this.canvasPointerDownListener);
      this.canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', this.canvasPointerMoveListener);
      this.canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', this.canvasPointerUpListener);
      this.canvas.addEventListener('wheel', this.canvasWheelListener, { passive: true });
      this.canvas.addEventListener('click', this.canvasClickListener);

      const doc = this.canvas.ownerDocument || (typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document : null);
      if (doc && typeof doc.addEventListener === 'function') {
        doc.addEventListener('pointermove', this.canvasPointerMoveListener);
        doc.addEventListener('pointerup', this.canvasPointerUpListener);
        doc.addEventListener('mousemove', this.canvasPointerMoveListener);
        doc.addEventListener('mouseup', this.canvasPointerUpListener);
      }
    }
  }

  public isDragging(): boolean {
    return this.isPointerDragging;
  }

  public getControls(): OrbitControls | null {
    return this.controls;
  }

  /**
   * Resets the 3D camera to the tactical overview or specified preset,
   * synchronizing OrbitControls target and camera matrix.
   */
  public resetCamera(preset: CameraPresetConfig = CAMERA_PRESETS.TACTICAL): void {
    this.applyCameraPreset(preset);
    if (this.controls) {
      this.controls.target.copy(preset.target);
      this.controls.update();
    }
    if (this.viewMode === '3d' && !this.isRunning && !this.isContextLost) {
      this.render();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Centers the 3D camera and OrbitControls target on specific terrain bounds.
   */
  public centerOnBounds(bounds: {
    minX: number;
    maxX: number;
    minY: number;
    maxY: number;
    minElevationM?: number;
    maxElevationM?: number;
  }): void {
    const cx = (bounds.minX + bounds.maxX) / 2;
    const cy = (bounds.minY + bounds.maxY) / 2;
    const spanX = Math.max(1000, bounds.maxX - bounds.minX);
    const spanY = Math.max(1000, bounds.maxY - bounds.minY);
    const midElev = ((bounds.minElevationM ?? 0) + (bounds.maxElevationM ?? 5000)) / 2;

    const aspect = Math.max(0.1, this.camera.aspect || 1.0);
    const fovRad = (this.camera.fov * Math.PI) / 180;
    const tanHalfFov = Math.tan(fovRad / 2);

    // Calculate view distance to comfortably fit both X and Y with 20% margin
    const distForY = (spanY * 0.6) / tanHalfFov;
    const distForX = (spanX * 0.6) / (tanHalfFov * aspect);
    const viewDist = Math.max(distForX, distForY, 25000);

    // Position camera south of center at ~30 deg pitch
    const pitchRad = (30 * Math.PI) / 180;
    const distY = Math.max(20000, viewDist * Math.sin(pitchRad));
    const distZ = Math.max(30000, viewDist * Math.cos(pitchRad));

    const target = new THREE.Vector3(cx, midElev, -cy);
    const position = new THREE.Vector3(cx, midElev + distY, -cy + distZ);

    this.camera.position.copy(position);
    this.camera.lookAt(target);
    if (this.controls) {
      this.controls.target.copy(target);
      this.controls.update();
    }
    if (this.viewMode === '3d' && !this.isRunning && !this.isContextLost) {
      this.render();
    }
  }

  public handlePointerClick(ndcX: number, ndcY: number): number | null {
    this.raycaster.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(ndcX, ndcY), this.camera);
    const targets = this.tacticalEntityManager.getSelectableObjects();
    const candidateObjects: THREE.Object3D[] = targets.filter(isObjectVisibleInHierarchy);
    if (this.terrainMesh && this.terrainMesh.visible && isObjectVisibleInHierarchy(this.terrainMesh)) {
      candidateObjects.push(this.terrainMesh);
    }

    const hits = this.raycaster.intersectObjects(candidateObjects, false);
    if (hits.length === 0) return null;

    // Find nearest target hit that is visible in hierarchy and represents ACN or terminal
    const nearestTargetHit = hits.find(
      (h) =>
        isObjectVisibleInHierarchy(h.object) &&
        (typeof h.object.userData?.nodeId === 'number' || h.object.userData?.isAcn === true)
    );
    if (!nearestTargetHit) {
      // Ray intersected terrain or non-terminal objects; never select terrain
      return null;
    }

    const nearestTerrainHit = hits.find((h) => h.object === this.terrainMesh);
    if (nearestTerrainHit && nearestTerrainHit.distance < nearestTargetHit.distance) {
      // Intervening mountain ridge is closer to camera along ray -> terminal is occluded
      return null;
    }

    // ACN selection
    if (
      nearestTargetHit.object.userData?.isAcn === true ||
      nearestTargetHit.object.userData?.nodeId === -1
    ) {
      this.tacticalEntityManager.triggerNodeSelected(-1);
      return -1;
    }

    const nodeId = nearestTargetHit.object.userData?.nodeId;
    if (typeof nodeId === 'number' && nodeId >= 0 && nodeId < 16) {
      if (this.tacticalEntityManager.isNodeContactOccluded(nodeId)) {
        return null;
      }
      this.tacticalEntityManager.triggerNodeSelected(nodeId);
      return nodeId;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Ingests 50 Hz frame telemetry from worker and updates all 3D tactical entities
   */
  public updateTelemetry(frame: any): void {
    this.tacticalEntityManager.updateFromTelemetry(frame);
    if (this.viewMode === '3d' && !this.isRunning && !this.isContextLost) {
      this.render();
    }
  }

  public setSelectedNode(nodeId: number): void {
    this.tacticalEntityManager.setSelectedNode(nodeId);
    if (this.viewMode === '3d' && !this.isRunning && !this.isContextLost) {
      this.render();
    }
  }

  public onNodeSelected(callback: (nodeId: number) => void): void {
    this.tacticalEntityManager.onNodeSelected(callback);
  }

  /**
   * Handles container resize and adjusts camera aspect and WebGL viewport
   */
  public handleResize(width?: number, height?: number): void {
    const w = width ?? this.container.clientWidth;
    const h = height ?? this.container.clientHeight;

    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

    this.camera.aspect = w / h;
    this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    this.renderer.setSize(w, h, false);

    // If active in 3D, trigger a render frame immediately
    if (this.viewMode === '3d' && !this.isRunning && !this.isContextLost) {
      this.render();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Switches view between '2d' and '3d'.
   * When switching to '2d', Three.js render loop is stopped completely (0% CPU/GPU overhead).
   * When switching to '3d', container is unhidden, resized, and render loop starts cleanly without duplicates.
   */
  public setViewMode(mode: StageViewMode): void {
    if (this.viewMode === mode) return;

    this.viewMode = mode;

    if (mode === '3d') {
      this.container.style.display = 'block';
      this.container.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      if (this.controls) {
        this.controls.enabled = true;
      }
      this.handleResize();
      this.startAnimationLoop();
    } else {
      if (this.controls) {
        this.controls.enabled = false;
      }
      this.stopAnimationLoop();
      this.container.style.display = 'none';
      this.container.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    }
  }

  public getViewMode(): StageViewMode {
    return this.viewMode;
  }

  /**
   * Starts the single authoritative animation loop.
   * Guarantees no duplicate RAF loops can run simultaneously.
   */
  public startAnimationLoop(): void {
    if (this.isRunning || this.isContextLost) return;

    this.isRunning = true;
    this.lastFrameTimestampMs = typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : Date.now();
    this.lastFpsCalcTimestampMs = this.lastFrameTimestampMs;
    this.frameCount = 0;

    const tick = (timestampMs: number) => {
      if (!this.isRunning) {
        this.rafId = null;
        return;
      }

      this.currentFrameTimeMs = timestampMs - this.lastFrameTimestampMs;
      this.lastFrameTimestampMs = timestampMs;

      // Track FPS rolling calculation
      this.frameCount++;
      const timeSinceLastFps = timestampMs - this.lastFpsCalcTimestampMs;
      if (timeSinceLastFps >= 1000) {
        this.currentFps = Math.round((this.frameCount * 1000.0) / timeSinceLastFps);
        this.frameCount = 0;
        this.lastFpsCalcTimestampMs = timestampMs;
      }

      // Update interactive camera controls with damping
      if (this.controls && this.controls.enabled) {
        this.controls.update();
      }

      // Execute render
      this.render();

      // Schedule next frame
      if (typeof requestAnimationFrame !== 'undefined') {
        this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      }
    };

    if (typeof requestAnimationFrame !== 'undefined') {
      this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Stops the animation loop completely, eliminating idle CPU and GPU load.
   */
  public stopAnimationLoop(): void {
    this.isRunning = false;
    if (this.rafId !== null) {
      if (typeof cancelAnimationFrame !== 'undefined') {
        cancelAnimationFrame(this.rafId);
      }
      this.rafId = null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Executes a single render pass
   */
  public render(): void {
    if (this.isContextLost) return;
    const w = Math.max(10, this.container.clientWidth || 800);
    const h = Math.max(10, this.container.clientHeight || 600);
    if (this.tacticalEntityManager) {
      this.tacticalEntityManager.updateLOD(this.camera, w, h, this.terrainMesh ?? undefined);
    }
    this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
    this.totalRenderCount++;
  }

  /**
   * Telemetry and performance metrics
   */
  public getMetrics(): ThreeSceneMetrics {
    return {
      fps: this.currentFps,
      frameTimeMs: this.currentFrameTimeMs,
      renderCount: this.totalRenderCount,
      isRunning: this.isRunning,
      isContextLost: this.isContextLost,
      viewMode: this.viewMode,
      terrainResolution: this.terrainResolution,
      terrainVertexCount: this.terrainMesh?.geometry.getAttribute('position')?.count ?? 0,
      terrainTriangleCount: this.terrainMesh?.geometry.getIndex()
        ? this.terrainMesh.geometry.getIndex()!.count / 3
        : 0,
      drawCalls: this.renderer?.info?.render?.calls ?? 0,
      entityCount: 17, // 1 ACN + 16 Ground Terminals
    };
  }

  /**
   * Ingests DEM mesh data from the worker, caches it, and constructs 3D terrain geometry.
   * Cached statically; does NOT re-allocate on per-frame telemetry.
   */
  public loadTerrainMeshData(data: TerrainMeshDataPayload): void {
    this.cachedTerrainData = data;
    this.rebuildTerrain();
  }

  public setTerrainResolution(resolution: TerrainMeshResolution): void {
    if (this.terrainResolution === resolution) return;
    this.terrainResolution = resolution;
    if (this.cachedTerrainData) {
      this.rebuildTerrain();
    }
  }

  public getTerrainResolution(): TerrainMeshResolution {
    return this.terrainResolution;
  }

  public getCachedTerrainData(): TerrainMeshDataPayload | null {
    return this.cachedTerrainData;
  }

  public getTerrainMesh(): THREE.Mesh | null {
    return this.terrainMesh;
  }

  /**
   * Applies the authentic hillshade raster from the worker onto the 3D terrain surface.
   */
  public setHillshadeCanvas(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): void {
    if (!canvas) return;
    if (this.hillshadeTexture) {
      this.hillshadeTexture.dispose();
      this.hillshadeTexture = null;
    }

    try {
      this.hillshadeTexture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      this.hillshadeTexture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      this.hillshadeTexture.magFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
      this.hillshadeTexture.minFilter = THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
      this.hillshadeTexture.generateMipmaps = true;

      if (this.terrainMesh && this.terrainMesh.material instanceof THREE.MeshStandardMaterial) {
        this.terrainMesh.material.map = this.hillshadeTexture;
        this.terrainMesh.material.color.setHex(0xffffff);
        this.terrainMesh.material.needsUpdate = true;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[ThreeSceneManager] Failed to bind hillshade texture to 3D terrain:', err);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Safely disposes active terrain geometry, skirts, and datum grids without touching other scene objects.
   */
  public disposeTerrain(): void {
    if (this.terrainMesh) {
      this.worldGroup.remove(this.terrainMesh);
      this.terrainMesh.geometry.dispose();
      if (this.terrainMesh.material instanceof THREE.Material) {
        this.terrainMesh.material.dispose();
      }
      this.terrainMesh = null;
    }

    if (this.skirtMesh) {
      this.worldGroup.remove(this.skirtMesh);
      this.skirtMesh.geometry.dispose();
      if (this.skirtMesh.material instanceof THREE.Material) {
        this.skirtMesh.material.dispose();
      }
      this.skirtMesh = null;
    }

    if (this.datumGrid) {
      this.worldGroup.remove(this.datumGrid);
      this.datumGrid.traverse((obj) => {
        if (obj instanceof THREE.Line || obj instanceof THREE.LineSegments) {
          obj.geometry.dispose();
          if (obj.material instanceof THREE.Material) {
            obj.material.dispose();
          }
        }
      });
      this.datumGrid = null;
    }

    if (this.tacticalEntityManager) {
      this.tacticalEntityManager.invalidateOcclusionCache();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Reconstructs 3D terrain mesh, perimeter skirts, and datum grid from cached data.
   */
  private rebuildTerrain(): void {
    if (!this.cachedTerrainData) return;

    this.disposeTerrain();

    // Hide M6.2.1 placeholder group now that authentic terrain is loaded
    this.placeholderGroup.visible = false;

    // 1. Build terrain geometry set (native 512 or balanced 256)
    const set = buildTerrainGeometrySet(this.cachedTerrainData, this.terrainResolution);

    // 2. Terrain mesh material with authentic shading
    const terrainMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      map: this.hillshadeTexture || null,
      color: this.hillshadeTexture ? 0xffffff : 0x1e293b,
      roughness: 0.85,
      metalness: 0.1,
      flatShading: false,
    });

    this.terrainMesh = new THREE.Mesh(set.meshGeometry, terrainMaterial);
    this.terrainMesh.name = `terrainMesh_${this.terrainResolution}`;
    this.worldGroup.add(this.terrainMesh);

    // 3. Perimeter skirts (real DEM only down to 1,700m MSL)
    if (set.skirtGeometry) {
      const skirtMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x0f172a,
        roughness: 0.95,
        metalness: 0.05,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
      });

      this.skirtMesh = new THREE.Mesh(set.skirtGeometry, skirtMaterial);
      this.skirtMesh.name = `terrainSkirt_${this.terrainResolution}`;
      this.worldGroup.add(this.skirtMesh);
    }

    // 4. Abstract tactical datum grid covering 1,200 km theater
    this.datumGrid = buildTacticalDatumGrid(
      APPROVED_SKIRT_BASE_MSL_M,
      600000.0,
      this.cachedTerrainData.bounds
    );
    this.worldGroup.add(this.datumGrid);

    // If 3D is active, trigger an immediate render
    if (this.viewMode === '3d' && !this.isRunning && !this.isContextLost) {
      this.render();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Disposes all Three.js GPU resources, event listeners, and observers cleanly.
   */
  public dispose(): void {
    this.stopAnimationLoop();
    this.disposeTerrain();

    if (this.controls) {
      this.controls.dispose();
      (this.controls as any) = null;
    }

    const doc = this.canvas?.ownerDocument || (typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document : null);
    if (doc && typeof doc.removeEventListener === 'function') {
      if (this.canvasPointerMoveListener) {
        doc.removeEventListener('pointermove', this.canvasPointerMoveListener);
        doc.removeEventListener('mousemove', this.canvasPointerMoveListener);
      }
      if (this.canvasPointerUpListener) {
        doc.removeEventListener('pointerup', this.canvasPointerUpListener);
        doc.removeEventListener('mouseup', this.canvasPointerUpListener);
      }
    }

    if (this.canvas && typeof this.canvas.removeEventListener === 'function') {
      if (this.canvasClickListener) {
        this.canvas.removeEventListener('click', this.canvasClickListener);
        this.canvasClickListener = null;
      }
      if (this.canvasPointerDownListener) {
        this.canvas.removeEventListener('pointerdown', this.canvasPointerDownListener);
        this.canvas.removeEventListener('mousedown', this.canvasPointerDownListener);
        this.canvasPointerDownListener = null;
      }
      if (this.canvasPointerMoveListener) {
        this.canvas.removeEventListener('pointermove', this.canvasPointerMoveListener);
        this.canvas.removeEventListener('mousemove', this.canvasPointerMoveListener);
        this.canvasPointerMoveListener = null;
      }
      if (this.canvasPointerUpListener) {
        this.canvas.removeEventListener('pointerup', this.canvasPointerUpListener);
        this.canvas.removeEventListener('mouseup', this.canvasPointerUpListener);
        this.canvasPointerUpListener = null;
      }
      if (this.canvasWheelListener) {
        this.canvas.removeEventListener('wheel', this.canvasWheelListener);
        this.canvasWheelListener = null;
      }
    }

    if (this.tacticalEntityManager) {
      this.tacticalEntityManager.dispose();
    }

    if (this.hillshadeTexture) {
      this.hillshadeTexture.dispose();
      this.hillshadeTexture = null;
    }

    if (this.resizeObserver) {
      this.resizeObserver.disconnect();
      this.resizeObserver = null;
    }

    if (this.windowResizeListener && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', this.windowResizeListener);
      this.windowResizeListener = null;
    }

    // Traverse and dispose geometries, materials, and textures
    this.scene.traverse((object) => {
      if (!(object instanceof THREE.Mesh || object instanceof THREE.Line || object instanceof THREE.LineSegments || object instanceof THREE.Points)) {
        return;
      }

      if (object.geometry) {
        object.geometry.dispose();
      }

      if (object.material) {
        if (Array.isArray(object.material)) {
          object.material.forEach((mat) => mat.dispose());
        } else {
          object.material.dispose();
        }
      }
    });

    this.renderer.dispose();
    if (this.canvas.parentElement && !this.container.contains(this.canvas)) {
      this.canvas.remove();
    }
  }
}

function createTacticalCanvas(w: number, h: number): HTMLCanvasElement | any {
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && typeof document.createElement === 'function') {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = w;
    canvas.height = h;
    return canvas;
  }
  // Headless Node.js / SSR mock fallback
  return {
    width: w,
    height: h,
    getContext: (type: string) => {
      if (type === '2d') {
        return new Proxy({}, { get: () => (..._args: any[]) => ({}) });
      }
      return null;
    },
  };
}

function createAcnChevronTexture(): THREE.CanvasTexture {
  const canvas = createTacticalCanvas(128, 128);
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  if (ctx) {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 128, 128);

    // Outer tactical surveillance ring
    ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.lineTo(110, 88);         // Right wingtip

    ctx.lineTo(64, 76);          // Fuselage keel
    ctx.lineTo(40, 96);          // Left trailing notch
    ctx.lineTo(18, 88);          // Left wingtip

function createCallsignTexture(label: string, borderCss: string): THREE.CanvasTexture {
  const canvas = createTacticalCanvas(256, 96);
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  if (ctx) {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 256, 96);

    // Rounded rectangle pill
    const x = 8, y = 12, w = 240, h = 72, r = 16;
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (typeof ctx.roundRect === 'function') {
      ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
    } else {
      ctx.rect(x, y, w, h);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8, 12, 16, 0.88)';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = borderCss;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Callsign typography
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = borderCss;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(label, 128, 48);
  }

  const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  texture.magFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  texture.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  return texture;
}
