      { nodeId: 1, isOperational: true, isBlocked: false, isObstacleBlocked: false, isOutage: false, isDegraded: false, linkStatus: 'CONNECTED', isSelected: false, isTransmitting: false, isWastingAirtime: false, queueBacklogBytes: 0 },
      { nodeId: 2, isOperational: true, isBlocked: false, isObstacleBlocked: false, isOutage: false, isDegraded: false, linkStatus: 'CONNECTED', isSelected: false, isTransmitting: false, isWastingAirtime: false, queueBacklogBytes: 0 },
    ],
  });

  // 1. Time = 50 ms (subframe offset = 1.0 ms -> within [0, 1.5 ms) CTRL sync subframe)
  const recCtrl = createRecordingCanvasContext();
  visualizer.render(recCtrl.ctx, {
    snapshot: snap,
    acnScreenPos: acnPos,
    nodeScreenPositions: nodePositions,
    speed: 1.0,
    isPaused: false,
    visualTimeMs: 50,
  });

  // ACN renders SYNC TX [ACN → ALL] badge
  const syncBadge = recCtrl.filledTexts.find(t => t.text === 'SYNC TX [ACN → ALL]');
  assert.ok(syncBadge !== undefined, 'ACN must render SYNC TX [ACN → ALL] badge during CTRL subframe');
  assert.equal(syncBadge!.fillStyle, '#38bdf8', 'SYNC badge must use cyan theme');
  // HUD reports CTRL SYNC [ACN → ALL]
  assert.ok(recCtrl.filledTexts.some(t => t.text.includes('CTRL SYNC [ACN → ALL]')), 'HUD must report CTRL SYNC');
  // Wavefront circles radiate from ACN
  const ctrlWaves = recCtrl.arcs.filter(a => Math.abs(a.x - acnPos.x) < 1 && Math.abs(a.y - acnPos.y) < 1);
  assert.ok(ctrlWaves.length >= 2, 'ACN must radiate expanding sync wavefront rings');
  // ZERO per-node application packet rects drawn
  const ctrlPackets = recCtrl.rects.filter(r => r.w === 8 && r.h === 3.6);
  assert.equal(ctrlPackets.length, 0, 'No individual application packets may be fabricated for broadcast sync');

  // 2. Time = 200 ms (subframe offset = 4.0 ms -> within [1.5, 6.0 ms) DL broadcast subframe)
  const recDl = createRecordingCanvasContext();
  visualizer.render(recDl.ctx, {
    snapshot: snap,
    acnScreenPos: acnPos,
    nodeScreenPositions: nodePositions,
    speed: 1.0,
    isPaused: false,
    visualTimeMs: 200,
  });

  // ACN renders DL TX [ACN → ALL] badge
  const dlBadge = recDl.filledTexts.find(t => t.text === 'DL TX [ACN → ALL]');
  assert.ok(dlBadge !== undefined, 'ACN must render DL TX [ACN → ALL] badge during DL subframe');
  assert.equal(dlBadge!.fillStyle, '#fbbf24', 'DL badge must use amber theme');
  // HUD reports DL BROADCAST [ACN → ALL]
  assert.ok(recDl.filledTexts.some(t => t.text.includes('DL BROADCAST [ACN → ALL]')), 'HUD must report DL BROADCAST');
  // Wavefront circles radiate from ACN in solid amber
  const dlWaves = recDl.arcs.filter(a => Math.abs(a.x - acnPos.x) < 1 && Math.abs(a.y - acnPos.y) < 1);
  assert.ok(dlWaves.length >= 3, 'ACN must radiate expanding DL broadcast wavefront rings');
  // ZERO per-node application packet rects drawn (broadcast signal wave, not per-node queues)
  const dlPackets = recDl.rects.filter(r => r.w === 8 && r.h === 3.6);
  assert.equal(dlPackets.length, 0, 'No per-node application packets may be fabricated for downlink broadcast');

  console.log('  -> PASS: Downlink broadcast waves, CTRL separation, and zero fabricated recipients verified.');
}

// Test 67: Stage 3 Transmission Outcomes, Queue Expiry, and Playback Isolation
{
  console.log('\n[67/67] Verifying Stage 3 transmission outcomes, queue expiry vs in-flight loss, and playback isolation...');

  const visualizer = new DataCommVisualizer();

  // 1. Static TDMA wasted airtime into severed link terminates at barrier without reaching ACN
  const acnPos = { x: 600, y: 100 };
  const nodePos = new Map<number, Point2D>([[3, { x: 100, y: 500 }]]);
  const staticWasteSnap = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: visualizer.getSessionId(),
    frameIndex: 10,
    simulationTimeS: 0.20,
    schedulerMode: 'static',
    superframeDurationMs: 20.0,
    ctrlDurationMs: 1.0,
    dlDurationMs: 3.0,
    allocations: [{ nodeId: 3, startMs: 4.0, durationMs: 1.0, capacityBits: 5000, isPreOcclusionFlush: false }],
    nodes: [{ nodeId: 3, isOperational: false, isBlocked: true, isObstacleBlocked: true, isOutage: false, isDegraded: false, linkStatus: 'BLOCKED_OBSTACLE', isSelected: false, isTransmitting: false, isWastingAirtime: true, queueBacklogBytes: 5000 }],
  });

  const recWaste = createRecordingCanvasContext();
  visualizer.render(recWaste.ctx, {
    snapshot: staticWasteSnap,
    acnScreenPos: acnPos,
    nodeScreenPositions: nodePos,
    speed: 1.0,
    isPaused: false,
    visualTimeMs: 225, // 4.5 ms
  });

  // Node 3 displays TX [WASTE]
  assert.ok(recWaste.filledTexts.some(t => t.text === 'TX [WASTE]'), 'Severed link in Static TDMA must render TX [WASTE]');
  // ACN must NOT display RX because transmission was obstructed before reaching ACN
  assert.ok(!recWaste.filledTexts.some(t => t.text.startsWith('RX')), 'ACN must NOT show RX on severed link');
  // HUD reports WASTED AIRTIME // SEVERED
  assert.ok(recWaste.filledTexts.some(t => t.text.includes('WASTED AIRTIME // SEVERED')), 'HUD must report WASTED AIRTIME // SEVERED');

  // 2. Playback Reset Clears State Cleanly
  visualizer.reset();
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveSnapshot(), null, 'Reset must clear activeSnapshot');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCurrentSubframeOffsetMs(), 0.0, 'Reset must return subframe offset to 0');

  console.log('  -> PASS: Outcomes truthful; queue expiry decoupled from RF loss; playback isolation verified.');
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Test 68: Stage 4 One STEP Physical Simulation & Pause Invariants (Req 1, 2)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
{
  console.log('\n[68/73] Verifying Stage 4 One STEP advances exactly 1 frame/20ms & worker remains paused...');

  const sim = new SimulationWorkerManager();
  let emittedFrame: any = null;
  (sim as any).emitHostMessage = (msg: any) => {
    if (msg && msg.type === 'TELEMETRY_FRAME') {
      emittedFrame = msg.frame;
    }
  };

  // 1. Initial pause
  sim.handleMessage({ type: 'SIM_CONTROL', action: 'pause' });
  const tBefore = sim.simTimeS;
  const fBefore = sim.frameIndex;
  assert.equal(sim.isPaused, true, 'Worker must be initialized in paused state');

  // 2. Issue single STEP command
  const res = sim.handleMessage({ type: 'SIM_CONTROL', action: 'step' });
  assert.equal(res.accepted, true, 'Worker must accept SIM_CONTROL step');

  // 3. Verify exactly 20 ms and 1 frame advancement
  const dt = sim.simTimeS - tBefore;
  assert.ok(Math.abs(dt - 0.020) < 1e-6, `STEP must advance simTimeS by exactly 0.020s (20 ms), observed ${dt}s`);
  assert.equal(sim.frameIndex - fBefore, 1, 'STEP must advance frameIndex by exactly 1');

  // 4. Verify worker remains physically paused
  assert.equal(sim.isPaused, true, 'Worker must remain physically paused after STEP');
  assert.ok(emittedFrame !== null, 'Worker must emit TELEMETRY_FRAME on step');
  assert.equal(emittedFrame.paused, true, 'Emitted telemetry frame must report paused=true');

  console.log('  -> PASS: One STEP advances exactly one frame and 20ms; worker remains physically paused.');
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Test 69: Stage 4 Stepped Playback Lifecycle, Single-Cycle Advancement, and Completion Holding (Req 3, 4, 5, 8)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
{
  console.log('\n[69/73] Verifying Stage 4 stepped visual playback lifecycle and completion holding...');

  const visualizer = new DataCommVisualizer();
  let completeNotified = false;
  visualizer.setOnSteppedCycleComplete(() => {
    completeNotified = true;
  });

  // 1. Verify canStep is initially true
  assert.equal(visualizer.canStep(), true, 'canStep must be true when idle');

  // 2. Request STEP
  const reqId = visualizer.requestStep();
  assert.ok(reqId !== null && reqId > 0, 'requestStep must return valid request ID');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getPlaybackMode(), 'stepped');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'waiting_for_telemetry');

  // 3. Construct stepped snapshot
  const stepSnap = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: visualizer.getSessionId(),
    frameIndex: 1,
    simulationTimeS: 0.02,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    superframeDurationMs: 20.0,
    ctrlDurationMs: 1.0,
    dlDurationMs: 3.0,
    allocations: [
      { nodeId: 4, startMs: 4.0, durationMs: 8.0, capacityBits: 20000, isPreOcclusionFlush: false },
    ],
    nodes: [
      { nodeId: 4, isOperational: true, isBlocked: false, isObstacleBlocked: false, isOutage: false, isDegraded: false, linkStatus: 'CONNECTED', isSelected: true, isTransmitting: true, isWastingAirtime: false, queueBacklogBytes: 5000 },
    ],
  });

  // 4. Latch stepped snapshot
  const latched = visualizer.latchSteppedSnapshot(stepSnap, reqId!);
  assert.equal(latched, true, 'latchSteppedSnapshot must accept snapshot for matching request ID');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'playing');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveSnapshot(), stepSnap);

  // 5. Advance visual playback while worker is physically paused (isPaused: true passed to render)
  const mockCtx = createMockCanvasContext();
  const nodePos = new Map([[4, { x: 200, y: 300 }]]);

  // Initial render at t=0
  visualizer.render(mockCtx, {
    snapshot: stepSnap,
    acnScreenPos: { x: 500, y: 200 },
    nodeScreenPositions: nodePos,
    speed: 1.0,
    isPaused: true, // Physical worker is paused!
  });
  assert.ok(Math.abs(visualizer.getCurrentSubframeOffsetMs() - 0.0) < 0.05, 'Initial subframe offset must be near 0 ms');

  // Advance by 200 ms of visual time (subframe offset = 4.0 ms -> start of Node 4 UL slot)
  visualizer.advancePlayback(200, 1.0, false);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(visualizer.getCurrentSubframeOffsetMs() - 4.0) < 0.05, 'Subframe offset at 200ms must be ~4.0 ms');
  const slotAt4 = visualizer.getActiveSlotState();
  assert.equal(slotAt4?.phase, 'UPLINK_SLOT');
  assert.equal(slotAt4?.scheduledNodeId, 4);

  // Advance by another 400 ms of visual time (subframe offset = 12.0 ms -> end of Node 4 slot, into GUARD)
  visualizer.advancePlayback(400, 1.0, false);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(visualizer.getCurrentSubframeOffsetMs() - 12.0) < 0.05, 'Subframe offset at 600ms must be ~12.0 ms');
  const slotAt12 = visualizer.getActiveSlotState();
  assert.equal(slotAt12?.phase, 'IDLE_RECLAIMED'); // Tac-TAD dynamic unallocated airtime

  // Advance remaining 400 ms to reach 1,000 ms (1x visual cycle complete)
  visualizer.advancePlayback(400, 1.0, false);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'complete', 'Lifecycle must transition to complete at end of cycle');
  assert.equal(completeNotified, true, 'onSteppedCycleComplete callback must be invoked');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCurrentSubframeOffsetMs(), 20.0, 'Subframe offset must be exactly 20.0 ms at completion');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs(), 1000.0, 'Elapsed visual time must clamp at cycle duration');

  // 6. Verify completion holds final phase without automatic rollover
  visualizer.advancePlayback(500, 1.0, false); // Extra 500ms rendered
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'complete', 'Lifecycle must remain complete');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCurrentSubframeOffsetMs(), 20.0, 'Subframe offset must remain held at 20.0 ms (no rollover to 0ms!)');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs(), 1000.0, 'Elapsed time must remain clamped at 1000ms');

  // 7. Verify STEP becomes available again after completion
  assert.equal(visualizer.canStep(), true, 'canStep must return true when cycle is complete and holding final phase');

  console.log('  -> PASS: Stepped visual superframe plays once, holds final phase, and enables next STEP.');
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Test 70: Stage 4 Overlapping Request Prevention and Overwrite Protection (Req 6, 7)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
{
  console.log('\n[70/73] Verifying Stage 4 overlapping step request prevention and overwrite protection...');

  const visualizer = new DataCommVisualizer();

  // 1. STEP rejected while awaiting telemetry
  const req1 = visualizer.requestStep();
  assert.ok(req1 !== null);
  assert.equal(visualizer.canStep(), false, 'canStep must be false while awaiting telemetry');
  const reqOverlapping1 = visualizer.requestStep();
  assert.equal(reqOverlapping1, null, 'requestStep must be rejected (null) while awaiting telemetry');

  // 2. Latch snapshot -> now playing
  const stepSnap1 = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: visualizer.getSessionId(),
    frameIndex: 10,
    simulationTimeS: 0.20,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    allocations: [],
    nodes: [],
  });
  visualizer.latchSteppedSnapshot(stepSnap1, req1!);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'playing');

  // 3. STEP rejected while stepped playback is active
  assert.equal(visualizer.canStep(), false, 'canStep must be false while stepped playback is active');
  const reqOverlapping2 = visualizer.requestStep();
  assert.equal(reqOverlapping2, null, 'requestStep must be rejected (null) while playing');

  // 4. Overwrite protection: incoming newer live telemetry must NOT overwrite active stepped snapshot
  const newerLiveSnap = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: visualizer.getSessionId(),
    frameIndex: 11,
    simulationTimeS: 0.22,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    allocations: [],
    nodes: [],
  });
  visualizer.ingestSnapshot(newerLiveSnap);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveSnapshot(), stepSnap1, 'Active stepped snapshot must NOT be overwritten by live telemetry');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getPendingSnapshot(), null, 'Pending snapshot must remain null during stepped playback');

  console.log('  -> PASS: Overlapping STEP requests strictly rejected; active stepped snapshot cannot be overwritten.');
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Test 71: Stage 4 Pause / Resume Decoupling and Continuous Restoration (Req 9, 10)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
{
  console.log('\n[71/73] Verifying Stage 4 pause/resume decoupling and continuous restoration...');

  const visualizer = new DataCommVisualizer();

  // 1. Start stepped playback
  const reqId = visualizer.requestStep();
  const snap = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: visualizer.getSessionId(),
    frameIndex: 1,
    simulationTimeS: 0.02,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    allocations: [],
    nodes: [],
  });
  visualizer.latchSteppedSnapshot(snap, reqId!);
  visualizer.advancePlayback(300, 1.0, false);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs(), 300);

  // 2. Explicit visual pause freezes visual clock
  visualizer.setVisualPaused(true);
  assert.equal(visualizer.isVisualPaused(), true);

  // Advance time while visual clock is paused
  visualizer.advancePlayback(200, 1.0, true);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs(), 300, 'Visual elapsed time must not advance while visual clock is paused');

  // Unpause visual clock
  visualizer.setVisualPaused(false);
  visualizer.advancePlayback(200, 1.0, false);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs(), 500, 'Visual playback must resume from exact frozen position');

  // 3. RESUME returns to continuous operation correctly
  visualizer.resumeContinuous();
  assert.equal(visualizer.getPlaybackMode(), 'continuous');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'idle');
  assert.equal(visualizer.isVisualPaused(), false);

  // In continuous mode, live snapshots promote and roll over normally
  const snapCont = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: visualizer.getSessionId(),
    frameIndex: 2,
    simulationTimeS: 0.04,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    allocations: [],
    nodes: [],
  });
  visualizer.ingestSnapshot(snapCont);
  visualizer.advancePlayback(600, 1.0, false); // 500 + 600 = 1100 -> rolls over past 1000
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveSnapshot(), snapCont, 'Continuous mode promotes pending snapshot at rollover');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs(), 100, 'Elapsed time wraps with modulo in continuous mode');

  console.log('  -> PASS: PAUSE freezes visual clock; RESUME cleanly restores continuous operation.');
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Test 72: Stage 4 Playback Speed Independence & Progress Preservation (Req 11, 12)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
{
  console.log('\n[72/73] Verifying Stage 4 playback speed changes preserve visual progress without advancing physical time...');

  const visualizer = new DataCommVisualizer();
  const reqId = visualizer.requestStep();
  const snap = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: visualizer.getSessionId(),
    frameIndex: 5,
    simulationTimeS: 0.10,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    superframeDurationMs: 20.0,
    allocations: [],
    nodes: [],
  });
  visualizer.latchSteppedSnapshot(snap, reqId!);

  // Play to 400 ms at 1x speed (progress = 400 / 1000 = 0.40; subframe offset = 0.40 * 20 = 8.0 ms)
  visualizer.advancePlayback(400, 1.0, false);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs(), 400);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(visualizer.getCurrentSubframeOffsetMs() - 8.0) < 1e-4);

  // 1. Shift to 2x speed (cycle duration becomes 500 ms)
  visualizer.advancePlayback(0, 2.0, false);
  // Normalized progress 0.40 must be preserved: 0.40 * 500 ms = 200 ms
  assert.ok(Math.abs(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs() - 200) < 1e-4, 'Elapsed time must scale to 200 ms at 2x speed');
  assert.ok(Math.abs(visualizer.getCurrentSubframeOffsetMs() - 8.0) < 1e-4, 'Subframe offset must remain exactly 8.0 ms');

  // 2. Shift to 0.5x speed (cycle duration becomes 2,000 ms)
  visualizer.advancePlayback(0, 0.5, false);
  // Normalized progress 0.40 must be preserved: 0.40 * 2000 ms = 800 ms
  assert.ok(Math.abs(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs() - 800) < 1e-4, 'Elapsed time must scale to 800 ms at 0.5x speed');
  assert.ok(Math.abs(visualizer.getCurrentSubframeOffsetMs() - 8.0) < 1e-4, 'Subframe offset must remain exactly 8.0 ms');

  // 3. Physical time invariants
  assert.equal(snap.simulationTimeS, 0.10, 'Snapshot simulation time must remain untouched by visual speed changes');
  assert.equal(snap.frameIndex, 5, 'Snapshot frame index must remain untouched by visual speed changes');

  console.log('  -> PASS: Speed changes strictly preserve normalized progress; physical time unchanged.');
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Test 73: Stage 4 Reset Determinism, Session Invalidation & Historical Isolation (Req 13, 14, 15, 16, 17)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
{
  console.log('\n[73/73] Verifying Stage 4 reset determinism, session invalidation, and historical isolation...');

  const visualizer = new DataCommVisualizer();

  // 1. RESET clears all state
  const oldSessionId = visualizer.getSessionId();
  visualizer.requestStep();
  const snap1 = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: oldSessionId,
    frameIndex: 1,
    simulationTimeS: 0.02,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    allocations: [],
    nodes: [],
  });
  visualizer.latchSteppedSnapshot(snap1);

  // Invoke reset
  visualizer.reset();
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveSnapshot(), null, 'Reset must clear activeSnapshot');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getPendingSnapshot(), null, 'Reset must clear pendingSnapshot');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getPlaybackMode(), 'continuous', 'Reset must restore continuous playback mode');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'idle', 'Reset must restore idle stepped lifecycle');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedRequestId(), 0, 'Reset must clear stepped request ID');
  assert.equal(visualizer.isVisualPaused(), false, 'Reset must clear visual pause flag');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs(), 0.0, 'Reset must zero elapsed visual time');
  assert.equal(visualizer.canStep(), true, 'canStep must be true after reset');
  assert.ok(visualizer.getSessionId() > oldSessionId, 'Reset must increment sessionId');

  // 2. Stale telemetry from older session cannot revive playback
  const staleSnap = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: oldSessionId, // Stale old session!
    frameIndex: 10,
    simulationTimeS: 0.20,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    allocations: [],
    nodes: [],
  });
  visualizer.ingestSnapshot(staleSnap);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveSnapshot(), null, 'Stale snapshot from old session must be rejected');

  // 3. Historical scrubbing clears stepped lifecycle & return-to-live is clean
  visualizer.requestStep();
  assert.equal(visualizer.getPlaybackMode(), 'stepped');
  visualizer.enterHistorical();
  assert.equal(visualizer.getPlaybackMode(), 'historical', 'enterHistorical must set historical mode');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'idle', 'enterHistorical must clear stepped lifecycle');
  assert.equal(visualizer.canStep(), false, 'canStep must be false in historical mode');

  // Latch historical snapshot
  const histSnap = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'historical',
    sessionId: visualizer.getSessionId(),
    frameIndex: 5,
    simulationTimeS: 0.10,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    allocations: [],
    nodes: [],
  });
  visualizer.ingestSnapshot(histSnap);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveSnapshot(), histSnap, 'Historical snapshot latched');

  // Return to live
  visualizer.exitHistorical(true); // exited while paused
  assert.equal(visualizer.getPlaybackMode(), 'continuous', 'exitHistorical must return to continuous mode');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'idle');
  assert.equal(visualizer.canStep(), true, 'canStep must be available upon return to live');

  console.log('  -> PASS: Reset clears all states & invalidates stale sessions; historical isolation verified.');
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Test 74: Stage 4 Corrective Fix 1: Reliable STEP Telemetry Correlation
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
{
  console.log('\n[74/76] Verifying Stage 4 Fix 1: Reliable STEP telemetry correlation & race immunity...');

  // 1. Worker correlation: echoes step_request_id on the stepped frame only
  const sim = new SimulationWorkerManager();
  let emittedFrame: any = null;
  (sim as any).emitHostMessage = (msg: any) => {
    if (msg && msg.type === 'TELEMETRY_FRAME') {
      emittedFrame = msg.frame;
    }
  };

  sim.handleMessage({ type: 'SIM_CONTROL', action: 'pause' });
  const stepRes = sim.handleMessage({ type: 'SIM_CONTROL', action: 'step', step_request_id: 101 });
  assert.equal(stepRes.accepted, true);
  assert.ok(emittedFrame !== null, 'Worker must emit TELEMETRY_FRAME on step');
  assert.equal(emittedFrame.step_request_id, 101, 'Emitted frame must echo step_request_id=101');
  assert.equal((sim as any).activeStepRequestId, undefined, 'Worker must clear activeStepRequestId after tick');

  // 2. UI correlation: DataCommVisualizer requestStep assigns ID and waits
  const visualizer = new DataCommVisualizer();
  const req1 = visualizer.requestStep();
  assert.equal(req1, 1, 'First requestStep must return ID 1');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveStepRequestId(), 1, 'Active step request ID must be 1');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'waiting_for_telemetry');

  // 3. Race condition: un-correlated continuous frame arrives while waiting -> MUST BE IGNORED
  const continuousSnap = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: visualizer.getSessionId(),
    frameIndex: 5,
    simulationTimeS: 0.10,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    // No stepRequestId (emitted before worker processed step)
    allocations: [],
    nodes: [],
  });
  visualizer.ingestSnapshot(continuousSnap);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveSnapshot(), null, 'Continuous frame without stepRequestId must NOT be latched');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'waiting_for_telemetry', 'Lifecycle must remain waiting_for_telemetry');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveStepRequestId(), 1, 'Active step request ID must remain 1');

  // 4. Stale or mismatched frame arrives -> MUST BE IGNORED
  const mismatchedSnap = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: visualizer.getSessionId(),
    frameIndex: 6,
    simulationTimeS: 0.12,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    stepRequestId: 999, // Mismatched ID!
    allocations: [],
    nodes: [],
  });
  visualizer.ingestSnapshot(mismatchedSnap);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveSnapshot(), null, 'Frame with mismatched stepRequestId must NOT be latched');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'waiting_for_telemetry');

  // 5. Correlated stepped frame arrives -> MUST BE LATCHED
  const correlatedSnap = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: visualizer.getSessionId(),
    frameIndex: 7,
    simulationTimeS: 0.14,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    stepRequestId: 1, // Matches activeStepRequestId!
    allocations: [],
    nodes: [],
  });
  visualizer.ingestSnapshot(correlatedSnap);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveSnapshot(), correlatedSnap, 'Matching stepped snapshot must be latched');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'playing', 'Lifecycle must transition to playing');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveStepRequestId(), null, 'Active step request ID must be cleared after latch');

  // 6. Reset invalidates outstanding STEP expectation
  const req2 = visualizer.requestStep();
  // Play finished or complete

  const req3 = visualizer.requestStep();

  visualizer.reset();
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveStepRequestId(), null, 'Reset must clear activeStepRequestId');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'idle');

  const staleAfterReset = createSuperframeSnapshot({

    stepRequestId: req3,
    allocations: [],
    nodes: [],
  });
  visualizer.ingestSnapshot(staleAfterReset);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'idle', 'Stale stepped frame cannot revive stepped lifecycle after reset');

  const req4 = visualizer.requestStep();
  assert.ok(req4 !== null);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveStepRequestId(), req4);

  assert.equal(visualizer.getActiveStepRequestId(), null, 'enterHistorical must clear activeStepRequestId');

// Test 75: Stage 4 Corrective Fix 2: PAUSE / RESUME Semantics During Stepped Playback
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
{
  console.log('\n[75/76] Verifying Stage 4 Fix 2: PAUSE/RESUME decoupling during stepped playback & holding...');

  const visualizer = new DataCommVisualizer();
  const reqId = visualizer.requestStep();
  const snap = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: visualizer.getSessionId(),
    frameIndex: 1,
    simulationTimeS: 0.02,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    stepRequestId: reqId!,
    allocations: [{ nodeId: 4, startMs: 4.0, durationMs: 8.0, capacityBits: 20000, isPreOcclusionFlush: false }],
    nodes: [{ nodeId: 4, isOperational: true, isBlocked: false, isObstacleBlocked: false, isOutage: false, isDegraded: false, linkStatus: 'CONNECTED', isSelected: true, isTransmitting: true, isWastingAirtime: false, queueBacklogBytes: 5000 }],
  });
  visualizer.ingestSnapshot(snap);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'playing');

  // 1. Advance to 250 ms (25% of visual cycle)
  visualizer.advancePlayback(250, 1.0, false);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs(), 250);

  // 2. User clicks PAUSE during stepped playing: visual clock freezes, worker is already paused
  visualizer.setVisualPaused(true);
  assert.equal(visualizer.isVisualPaused(), true, 'Visual clock must report paused');

  // Advance time while visual clock is paused -> MUST NOT ADVANCE
  visualizer.advancePlayback(300, 1.0, visualizer.isVisualPaused());
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs(), 250, 'Cycle elapsed time must freeze during visual pause');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'playing', 'Lifecycle remains playing (not complete)');

  // 3. Speed changes while stepped visual clock is paused -> MUST NOT UNPAUSE
  visualizer.advancePlayback(0, 2.0, visualizer.isVisualPaused());
  assert.equal(visualizer.isVisualPaused(), true, 'Visual clock must remain paused after speed change');
  // Rescaled to 2x speed: 25% of 500 ms = 125 ms
  assert.ok(Math.abs(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs() - 125) < 1e-4);

  // 4. User clicks RESUME while stepped playing + visual paused -> visual clock unfreezes, worker remains paused
  visualizer.setVisualPaused(false);
  assert.equal(visualizer.isVisualPaused(), false, 'Visual clock must unpause');
  visualizer.advancePlayback(125, 2.0, visualizer.isVisualPaused());
  assert.ok(Math.abs(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs() - 250) < 1e-4, 'Playback resumes from exact paused position');

  // 5. Complete visual cycle (remaining 250 ms at 2x)
  visualizer.advancePlayback(250, 2.0, visualizer.isVisualPaused());
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'complete', 'Lifecycle reaches complete');
  assert.ok(Math.abs(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs() - 500) < 1e-4, 'Elapsed visual time clamps at cycle end');

  // 6. Holding terminal state: additional time does not roll over
  visualizer.advancePlayback(300, 2.0, false);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'complete');
  assert.ok(Math.abs(visualizer.getCycleElapsedVisualMs() - 500) < 1e-4);

  // 7. Explicit RESUME SIM action: returns cleanly to continuous mode
  visualizer.resumeContinuous();
  assert.equal(visualizer.getPlaybackMode(), 'continuous', 'resumeContinuous restores continuous playback');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'idle', 'Lifecycle returns to idle');
  assert.equal(visualizer.isVisualPaused(), false, 'Visual pause is cleared');
  assert.equal(visualizer.canStep(), true, 'canStep is available in continuous mode');

  console.log('  -> PASS: PAUSE/RESUME decoupling during stepped playback & holding verified.');
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Test 76: Stage 4 Corrective Fix 3: Half-Open Semantics at Frame Completion & HUD

{
  console.log('\n[76/76] Verifying Stage 4 Fix 3: Strict half-open semantics [start, end) at completion & HUD...');

  // 1. Allocation ending at exactly 20.0 ms: strict half-open interval [16.0, 20.0) ms
  const timelineWithAlloc = resolveSuperframeTimeline({
    superframeDurationMs: 20.0,
    ctrlDurationMs: 1.0,
    dlDurationMs: 3.0,
    schedulerMode: 'static',
    allocations: [
      { nodeId: 5, startMs: 16.0, durationMs: 4.0, capacityBits: 25000, isPreOcclusionFlush: false },
    ],
  });

  // At t = 19.999999 ms: allocation [16.0, 20.0) ms is strictly active!
  const activeAt19 = timelineWithAlloc.resolveAt(19.999999);
  assert.equal(activeAt19.phase, 'UPLINK_SLOT', 'Active at 19.999999 ms must be UPLINK_SLOT');
  assert.equal(activeAt19.scheduledNodeId, 5, 'Scheduled node at 19.999999 ms must be Node 5');
  assert.equal(activeAt19.slotStartMs, 16.0, 'Slot start must be 16.0 ms');
  assert.equal(activeAt19.slotEndMs, 20.0, 'Slot end must be 20.0 ms');
  assert.equal(activeAt19.direction, 'UL');
  assert.ok(activeAt19.capacityBits > 0);

  // At t = 20.0 ms: frame has concluded! Strict [16.0, 20.0) means slot ended.
  // Must NOT claim ongoing active uplink transmission!
  const completeAt20 = timelineWithAlloc.resolveAt(20.0);
  assert.notEqual(completeAt20.phase, 'UPLINK_SLOT', 'At t=20.0 ms, phase must NOT be UPLINK_SLOT');
  assert.equal(completeAt20.scheduledNodeId, null, 'At t=20.0 ms, scheduledNodeId must be null');
  assert.equal(completeAt20.direction, 'NONE', 'At t=20.0 ms, direction must be NONE');
  assert.equal(completeAt20.capacityBits, 0, 'At t=20.0 ms, capacityBits must be 0');
  assert.equal(completeAt20.phase, 'GUARD', 'At t=20.0 ms, Static TDMA terminal phase is GUARD');
  assert.equal(completeAt20.slotStartMs, 20.0, 'At t=20.0 ms, terminal slotStartMs is 20.0 ms (does not match [16, 20))');
  assert.equal(completeAt20.slotDurationMs, 0.0, 'At t=20.0 ms, terminal slotDurationMs is 0.0 ms');

  // 2. Exact test for segment [12.0, 20.0) in Tac-TAD:
  // Node 1 allocated [4.0, 12.0) ms -> Tac-TAD reclaimed airtime tail is [12.0, 20.0) ms
  const timeline12to20 = resolveSuperframeTimeline({
    superframeDurationMs: 20.0,
    ctrlDurationMs: 1.0,
    dlDurationMs: 3.0,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    allocations: [
      { nodeId: 1, startMs: 4.0, durationMs: 8.0, capacityBits: 20000, isPreOcclusionFlush: false },
    ],
  });

  // Query at 19.999999 ms -> MUST match final segment [12.0, 20.0)
  const at19_9 = timeline12to20.resolveAt(19.999999);
  assert.equal(at19_9.phase, 'IDLE_RECLAIMED', 'At 19.999999 ms, must match reclaimed tail [12.0, 20.0)');
  assert.equal(at19_9.scheduledNodeId, null);
  assert.equal(at19_9.slotStartMs, 12.0, 'At 19.999999 ms, segment start must be 12.0 ms');
  assert.equal(at19_9.slotDurationMs, 8.0, 'At 19.999999 ms, segment duration must be 8.0 ms');
  assert.equal(at19_9.slotEndMs, 20.0, 'At 19.999999 ms, segment end must be 20.0 ms');

  // Query at 20.0 ms -> MUST NOT match [12.0, 20.0) (concluded at 20.0 ms)
  const at20_0 = timeline12to20.resolveAt(20.0);
  assert.equal(at20_0.phase, 'IDLE_RECLAIMED', 'At 20.0 ms, terminal state holds IDLE_RECLAIMED');
  assert.equal(at20_0.scheduledNodeId, null);
  assert.equal(at20_0.direction, 'NONE');
  assert.equal(at20_0.capacityBits, 0);
  assert.equal(at20_0.slotStartMs, 20.0, 'At 20.0 ms, does NOT match [12.0, 20.0) (slotStartMs=20.0)');
  assert.equal(at20_0.slotDurationMs, 0.0, 'At 20.0 ms, does NOT match [12.0, 20.0) (slotDurationMs=0.0)');

  // 3. Superframe ending with Tac-TAD reclaimed airtime: [14.0, 20.0) ms IDLE_RECLAIMED
  const timelineTac = resolveSuperframeTimeline({
    superframeDurationMs: 20.0,
    ctrlDurationMs: 1.0,
    dlDurationMs: 3.0,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    allocations: [
      { nodeId: 4, startMs: 4.0, durationMs: 10.0, capacityBits: 30000, isPreOcclusionFlush: false },
    ],
  });

  const tacAt19 = timelineTac.resolveAt(19.999999);
  assert.equal(tacAt19.phase, 'IDLE_RECLAIMED', 'At 19.999999 ms, matches reclaimed tail [14.0, 20.0)');
  assert.equal(tacAt19.slotStartMs, 14.0);
  assert.equal(tacAt19.slotEndMs, 20.0);

  const tacAt20 = timelineTac.resolveAt(20.0);
  assert.equal(tacAt20.phase, 'IDLE_RECLAIMED', 'At t=20.0 ms, Tac-TAD holds IDLE_RECLAIMED cleanly');
  assert.equal(tacAt20.scheduledNodeId, null, 'No scheduled node during reclaimed airtime');
  assert.equal(tacAt20.direction, 'NONE');
  assert.equal(tacAt20.capacityBits, 0);
  assert.equal(tacAt20.slotStartMs, 20.0, 'At 20.0 ms, does NOT match [14.0, 20.0) (slotStartMs=20.0)');
  assert.equal(tacAt20.slotDurationMs, 0.0);

  // 3. HUD indicator rendering in stepped complete state
  const visualizer = new DataCommVisualizer();
  const reqId = visualizer.requestStep();
  const snap = createSuperframeSnapshot({
    source: 'live',
    sessionId: visualizer.getSessionId(),
    frameIndex: 12,
    simulationTimeS: 0.24,
    schedulerMode: 'tac_tad',
    stepRequestId: reqId!,
    allocations: [
      { nodeId: 5, startMs: 16.0, durationMs: 4.0, capacityBits: 25000, isPreOcclusionFlush: false },
    ],
    nodes: [
      { nodeId: 5, isOperational: true, isBlocked: false, isObstacleBlocked: false, isOutage: false, isDegraded: false, linkStatus: 'CONNECTED', isSelected: true, isTransmitting: true, isWastingAirtime: false, queueBacklogBytes: 5000 },
    ],
  });
  visualizer.ingestSnapshot(snap);

  // Play to exact completion (1,000 ms at 1x)
  visualizer.advancePlayback(1000, 1.0, false);
  assert.equal(visualizer.getSteppedLifecycle(), 'complete');
  assert.equal(visualizer.getCurrentSubframeOffsetMs(), 20.0);

  // Render on mock canvas and capture HUD text
  const renderedText: string[] = [];
  const mockCtx = createMockCanvasContext();
  mockCtx.fillText = (text: string) => {
    renderedText.push(text);
  };

  const nodePos = new Map([[5, { x: 300, y: 300 }]]);
  visualizer.render(mockCtx, {
    snapshot: snap,
    acnScreenPos: { x: 500, y: 200 },
    nodeScreenPositions: nodePos,
    speed: 1.0,
    isPaused: true,
  });

  const hudText = renderedText.find((t) => t.includes('STEP COMPLETE') || t.includes('STEPPED'));
  assert.ok(hudText !== undefined, 'HUD must display STEP COMPLETE indicator');
  assert.ok(hudText!.includes('STEP COMPLETE // HOLDING'), `HUD must indicate holding final state, got: ${hudText}`);
  assert.ok(hudText!.includes('20.0ms'), `HUD must show 20.0ms terminal offset, got: ${hudText}`);

  console.log('  -> PASS: Strict half-open semantics [start, end) at completion & HUD verified.');
}

    assert.ok(Math.abs(recovered.yM - y) < 1e-7, `World->Geo->World roundtrip Y failed at (${x}, ${y})`);
  }
  console.log('  -> PASS: Geographic transformations match exact boundary parallels and round-trip cleanly.');

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 6. Coverage Boundary Tests (isWithinDemCoverage)
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('\n[6/7] Checking boundary detection (isWithinDemCoverage)...');
  // Inside points
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(0, 0), true);
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(50000, 50000), true);
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(-meta.halfWidthM, 0), true);
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(meta.halfWidthM, 0), true);
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(0, -meta.halfHeightM), true);
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(0, meta.halfHeightM), true);

  // Outside points
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(meta.halfWidthM + 0.1, 0), false, '+X just beyond boundary');
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(-meta.halfWidthM - 0.1, 0), false, '-X just beyond boundary');
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(0, meta.halfHeightM + 0.1), false, '+Y just beyond boundary');
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(0, -meta.halfHeightM - 0.1), false, '-Y just beyond boundary');
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(150000, 0), false, 'Far East 150 km');
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(0, 200000), false, 'Far North 200 km');
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(600000, 600000), false, 'Old theater boundary (600 km)');

  // Invalid numbers
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(Number.NaN, 0), false, 'NaN must be outside');
  assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(0, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY), false, 'Infinity must be outside');
  console.log('  -> PASS: Boundary checks strictly enforce the genuine DEM extent without extrapolation.');

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 7. Scale Invariance (No Stretched Step)
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('\n[7/7] Checking metric scale invariance...');
  // A step of exactly 10,000 metres East must advance exactly 10,000 / groundResolutionXM columns
  const p0 = terrain.worldToDemPixel(0, 0);
  const pEast10k = terrain.worldToDemPixel(10000.0, 0);
  const colDelta = pEast10k.col - p0.col;
  const expectedColDelta = 10000.0 / meta.groundResolutionXM;
  assert.ok(Math.abs(colDelta - expectedColDelta) < 1e-12, '10 km East step matches exact groundResolutionXM');

  // A step of exactly 10,000 metres North must advance exactly -10,000 / groundResolutionYM rows
  const pNorth10k = terrain.worldToDemPixel(0, 10000.0);
  const rowDelta = pNorth10k.row - p0.row;
  const expectedRowDelta = -10000.0 / meta.groundResolutionYM; // Decreasing row = North
  assert.ok(Math.abs(rowDelta - expectedRowDelta) < 1e-12, '10 km North step matches exact groundResolutionYM');
  console.log(`  -> PASS: 10 km East = ${colDelta.toFixed(4)} cols (${meta.groundResolutionXM.toFixed(2)} m/px).`);
  console.log(`  -> PASS: 10 km North = ${Math.abs(rowDelta).toFixed(4)} rows (${meta.groundResolutionYM.toFixed(2)} m/px).`);

  // ==========================================================================
  // M6.1 TASK 2: REAL DEM INTERPOLATION & OUT-OF-COVERAGE BEHAVIOR
  // ==========================================================================
  console.log('\n================================================================================');
  console.log('  M6.1 TASK 2: REAL DEM INTERPOLATION & COVERAGE VERIFICATION');
  console.log('================================================================================');

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 8. Load Authentic Satellite DEM Binary
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('\n[8/16] Loading authentic satellite DEM binary (Float32Array)...');
  const demPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'public/terrain/real_ladakh_dem.bin');
  assert.ok(fs.existsSync(demPath), `DEM binary must exist at ${demPath}`);
  const demBuffer = fs.readFileSync(demPath);
  const expectedByteLength = 512 * 512 * 4;
  assert.equal(demBuffer.byteLength, expectedByteLength, `DEM binary must be exactly ${expectedByteLength} bytes (1,048,576 B)`);

  const realDemArray = new Float32Array(demBuffer.buffer, demBuffer.byteOffset, 512 * 512);
  terrain.loadCustomDem(realDemArray);
  assert.equal(terrain.hasRealDem, true, 'hasRealDem must be true after loading DEM');
  assert.equal(terrain.terrainMode, 'real', 'terrainMode must be real');
  console.log(`  -> PASS: Loaded 512x512 Float32 matrix (${realDemArray.length} samples, ${(expectedByteLength / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB).`);

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 9. Exact Center Elevation Sample Verification
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('\n[9/16] Checking center elevation sample at origin (0, 0)...');
  // Origin (0, 0) maps to continuous pixel (255.5, 255.5).
  // Bilinear interpolation between [255, 255], [255, 256], [256, 255], [256, 256]:
  // [255, 255] = 3297.34375, [255, 256] = 3386.43115, [256, 255] = 3293.70337, [256, 256] = 3403.71143
  // Expected center = 3345.2974243164062 m MSL
  const centerElev = terrain.getElevation(0, 0);
  const centerDemElev = terrain.getDemElevation(0, 0);
  const expectedCenterElev = 3345.2974243164062;
  assert.ok(Math.abs(centerElev - expectedCenterElev) < 1e-4, `Center getElevation must match bilinear interpolation (${expectedCenterElev} m), got ${centerElev}`);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(centerDemElev - expectedCenterElev) < 1e-4, `Center getDemElevation must match bilinear interpolation, got ${centerDemElev}`);

  const elev256 = terrain.getElevation(w256.xM, w256.yM);

  assert.ok(Math.abs(elev256 - rawPixel256) < 1e-4, `Pixel [256, 256] elevation must match raw sample (${rawPixel256} m), got ${elev256}`);
  console.log(`  -> PASS: Center (0, 0) -> ${centerElev.toFixed(2)} m MSL; Pixel (256, 256) -> ${elev256.toFixed(2)} m MSL.`);

  // 10. Four Corner Ground-Truth Elevations Matching Raw Float32 Binary
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('\n[10/16] Checking 4 corner ground-truth elevations against raw binary Float32...');
  // NW Corner: (-halfWidthM, +halfHeightM) -> Pixel [0, 0] = 4149.1005859375 m MSL
  const rawNW = realDemArray[0 * 512 + 0];
  const nwElev = terrain.getElevation(-meta.halfWidthM, meta.halfHeightM);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(nwElev - rawNW) < 1e-4, `NW corner elevation must match raw DEM (${rawNW} m), got ${nwElev}`);

  // NE Corner: (+halfWidthM, +halfHeightM) -> Pixel [0, 511] = 5364.8603515625 m MSL
  const rawNE = realDemArray[0 * 512 + 511];
  const neElev = terrain.getElevation(meta.halfWidthM, meta.halfHeightM);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(neElev - rawNE) < 1e-4, `NE corner elevation must match raw DEM (${rawNE} m), got ${neElev}`);

  // SW Corner: (-halfWidthM, -halfHeightM) -> Pixel [511, 0] = 3182.5400390625 m MSL
  const rawSW = realDemArray[511 * 512 + 0];
  const swElev = terrain.getElevation(-meta.halfWidthM, -meta.halfHeightM);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(swElev - rawSW) < 1e-4, `SW corner elevation must match raw DEM (${rawSW} m), got ${swElev}`);

  const rawSE = realDemArray[511 * 512 + 511];
  const seElev = terrain.getElevation(meta.halfWidthM, -meta.halfHeightM);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(seElev - rawSE) < 1e-4, `SE corner elevation must match raw DEM (${rawSE} m), got ${seElev}`);

  console.log(`  -> PASS: NW (-91.8km, +110.9km) = ${nwElev.toFixed(2)} m MSL (raw: ${rawNW.toFixed(2)} m)`);

  console.log(`  -> PASS: SW (-91.8km, -110.9km) = ${swElev.toFixed(2)} m MSL (raw: ${rawSW.toFixed(2)} m)`);
  console.log(`  -> PASS: SE (+91.8km, -110.9km) = ${seElev.toFixed(2)} m MSL (raw: ${rawSE.toFixed(2)} m)`);

  // 11. Fractional Coordinate Bilinear Interpolation
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  // Arbitrary continuous pixel: (col = 100.25, row = 200.75)
  const fracCol = 100.25;
  const fracRow = 200.75;
  const fracWorld = terrain.demPixelToWorld(fracCol, fracRow);

  // Manual bilinear calculation on raw matrix
  const c0 = 100, c1 = 101, fc = 0.25;
  const r0 = 200, r1 = 201, fr = 0.75;
  const v00 = realDemArray[r0 * 512 + c0];
  const v01 = realDemArray[r0 * 512 + c1];
  const v10 = realDemArray[r1 * 512 + c0];
  const v11 = realDemArray[r1 * 512 + c1];
  const manualTop = v00 * (1.0 - fc) + v01 * fc;
  const manualBot = v10 * (1.0 - fc) + v11 * fc;
  const expectedFrac = manualTop * (1.0 - fr) + manualBot * fr;

  const actualFrac = terrain.getElevation(fracWorld.xM, fracWorld.yM);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(actualFrac - expectedFrac) < 1e-5, `Bilinear elevation at (${fracCol}, ${fracRow}) must match manual formula (${expectedFrac} m), got ${actualFrac}`);
  console.log(`  -> PASS: Fractional pixel (100.25, 200.75) -> ${actualFrac.toFixed(3)} m MSL (exact match with manual 4-point bilinear).`);

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  const outCoords = [
    [150000.0, 0.0, 'Far East (+150 km)'],
    [-150000.0, 0.0, 'Far West (-150 km)'],
    [0.0, 200000.0, 'Far North (+200 km)'],
    [0.0, -200000.0, 'Far South (-200 km)'],
    [600000.0, 600000.0, 'Old theater boundary (+600 km, +600 km)'],

    [100000.0, 120000.0, 'Outside both X and Y'],
  ];

  for (const [x, y, label] of outCoords) {
    const elev = terrain.getElevation(x as number, y as number);

    assert.ok(Number.isNaN(elev), `getElevation at ${label} (${x}, ${y}) must return Number.NaN, got ${elev}`);
    assert.ok(Number.isNaN(demElev), `getDemElevation at ${label} (${x}, ${y}) must return Number.NaN, got ${demElev}`);
    assert.equal(terrain.isWithinDemCoverage(x as number, y as number), false, `isWithinDemCoverage must be false for ${label}`);
  }
  console.log(`  -> PASS: All ${outCoords.length} out-of-coverage queries return Number.NaN without neutral floor substitution or clamping.`);

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 13. Exact Boundary vs Just-Outside Boundary Step
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('\n[13/16] Checking exact boundary vs just-outside boundary step (+/- 0.1 m)...');
  // Exactly on boundary -> Valid finite elevation
  assert.ok(Number.isFinite(terrain.getElevation(meta.halfWidthM, 0.0)), '+X boundary must be finite');
  assert.ok(Number.isFinite(terrain.getElevation(-meta.halfWidthM, 0.0)), '-X boundary must be finite');
  assert.ok(Number.isFinite(terrain.getElevation(0.0, meta.halfHeightM)), '+Y boundary must be finite');
  assert.ok(Number.isFinite(terrain.getElevation(0.0, -meta.halfHeightM)), '-Y boundary must be finite');

  // Exactly 0.1 m outside boundary -> Number.NaN
  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(terrain.getElevation(meta.halfWidthM + 0.1, 0.0)), '+X + 0.1m must return NaN');
  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(terrain.getElevation(-meta.halfWidthM - 0.1, 0.0)), '-X - 0.1m must return NaN');
  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(terrain.getElevation(0.0, meta.halfHeightM + 0.1)), '+Y + 0.1m must return NaN');
  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(terrain.getElevation(0.0, -meta.halfHeightM - 0.1)), '-Y - 0.1m must return NaN');
  console.log('  -> PASS: Sharp transition at +/- 0.1 m boundary verified across all 4 edges.');

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 14. Non-Finite Coordinate Handling (NaN, Infinity)
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('\n[14/16] Checking non-finite coordinate handling (NaN, Infinity)...');
  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(terrain.getElevation(Number.NaN, 0.0)), 'NaN X must return NaN');
  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(terrain.getElevation(0.0, Number.NaN)), 'NaN Y must return NaN');
  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(terrain.getElevation(Number.NaN, Number.NaN)), 'NaN X and Y must return NaN');
  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(terrain.getElevation(Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, 0.0)), '+Infinity X must return NaN');
  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(terrain.getElevation(0.0, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)), '-Infinity Y must return NaN');
  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(terrain.getElevation(Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)), '+/-Infinity must return NaN');

  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(terrain.getDemElevation(Number.NaN, 0.0)), 'getDemElevation NaN X must return NaN');
  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(terrain.getDemElevation(Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, 0.0)), 'getDemElevation Infinity X must return NaN');
  console.log('  -> PASS: Non-finite inputs handled safely without throwing or propagating unhandled values.');

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 15. Scale Invariance in Elevation Space
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('\n[15/16] Checking 1-pixel step scale invariance in elevation sampling...');
  // Advancing 1 ground resolution step in X should advance exactly 1 column in index space
  const testCol = 150;
  const testRow = 250;
  const w1 = terrain.demPixelToWorld(testCol, testRow);
  const w2 = terrain.demPixelToWorld(testCol + 1, testRow);
  const dx = w2.xM - w1.xM;
  assert.ok(Math.abs(dx - meta.groundResolutionXM) < 1e-9, 'World X step equals groundResolutionXM');

  const elev1 = terrain.getElevation(w1.xM, w1.yM);
  const elev2 = terrain.getElevation(w2.xM, w2.yM);
  const rawSample1 = realDemArray[testRow * 512 + testCol];
  const rawSample2 = realDemArray[testRow * 512 + (testCol + 1)];
  assert.ok(Math.abs(elev1 - rawSample1) < 1e-4, 'Sample 1 matches raw DEM sample');
  assert.ok(Math.abs(elev2 - rawSample2) < 1e-4, 'Sample 2 matches raw DEM sample');
  console.log(`  -> PASS: 1-pixel shift (${dx.toFixed(2)} m) advances exactly 1 column from ${elev1.toFixed(1)} m to ${elev2.toFixed(1)} m MSL.`);

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 16. Preservation of Procedural Synthetic Mode Across Full 1,200 km Theater
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('\n[16/16] Checking procedural synthetic mode preservation across 1,200 km theater...');
  terrain.setTerrainMode('synthetic');
  assert.equal(terrain.terrainMode, 'synthetic', 'terrainMode must be synthetic');

  const synthCoords = [
    [0.0, 0.0, 'Origin'],
    [12000.0, 8000.0, 'Tactical node area (+12km, +8km)'],
    [300000.0, 200000.0, 'Regional outer (+300km, +200km)'],
    [-500000.0, -400000.0, 'Far boundary (-500km, -400km)'],
    [600000.0, 600000.0, 'Theater edge (+600km, +600km)'],
    [-600000.0, -600000.0, 'Theater edge (-600km, -600km)'],
  ];

  for (const [x, y, label] of synthCoords) {
    const sElev = terrain.getElevation(x as number, y as number);
    assert.ok(Number.isFinite(sElev), `Synthetic mode at ${label} (${x}, ${y}) must be finite, got ${sElev}`);
    assert.ok(sElev >= 2800.0 && sElev <= 5900.0, `Synthetic elevation must be within [2800, 5900] m, got ${sElev}`);
  }
  console.log(`  -> PASS: Procedural synthetic mode retains full-bleed coverage across entire 1,200 km domain.`);

  console.log('\n================================================================================');
  console.log('  [SUCCESS] ALL 16 M6.1 TASK 1 & TASK 2 VERIFICATION TESTS PASSED WITH 100% PRECISION.');
  console.log('================================================================================\n');
}

/**
 * src/tests/verifyDeterminismTrace.ts
 *
 * Authoritative Determinism and State-Hash Trace Verification Suite (M0.1).
 *
 * Implements Tests T1 through T6:
 * T1: Same-seed replay in fresh instances, synthetic terrain (100 frames, 100% exact match).
 * T2: Same-seed replay in fresh instances, real DEM (100 frames, 100% exact match).
 * T3: Different seeds in synthetic mode (verifies seed-dependent RNG/traffic variation).
 * T4: Real-DEM seed behavior (documents topological shadowing effect on RNG consumption).

 * T6: Tick-path hygiene (verifies trace collection does not mutate state or inject wall-clock inputs).
 */

console.log('='.repeat(92));

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
console.log('\n[T1] Verifying same-seed reproducibility (Synthetic DEM, 100 frames)...');
const t1RunA = generateSimulationTrace({ seed: 42, frames: 100, terrainMode: 'synthetic' });
const t1RunB = generateSimulationTrace({ seed: 42, frames: 100, terrainMode: 'synthetic' });

assert.equal(t1RunA.trace.length, 101, 'T1: Trace must contain 101 entries (frame 0 + 100 steps)');
assert.equal(t1RunB.trace.length, 101, 'T1: Trace must contain 101 entries (frame 0 + 100 steps)');

  );
}

const tmpT1B = resolve(process.cwd(), 'benchmark_results/generated/temp_trace_t1_b.json');
execFileSync(process.execPath, [viteNodeBin, benchmarkScript, '--frames', '100', '--seeds', '42', '--terrain-mode', 'synthetic', '--trace', '--trace-out', tmpT1A], { stdio: 'pipe' });
execFileSync(process.execPath, [viteNodeBin, benchmarkScript, '--frames', '100', '--seeds', '42', '--terrain-mode', 'synthetic', '--trace', '--trace-out', tmpT1B], { stdio: 'pipe' });
assert.equal(readFileSync(tmpT1A, 'utf8'), readFileSync(tmpT1B, 'utf8'), 'T1: Independent process traces must be bit-for-bit identical');
try { unlinkSync(tmpT1A); unlinkSync(tmpT1B); } catch (_) {}

const t2RunB = generateSimulationTrace({ seed: 7, frames: 100, terrainMode: 'real', realDemBuffer, terrainAssetChecksum: demChecksum });

// Cross-process replay validation in two independent Node.js processes
const tmpT2A = resolve(process.cwd(), 'benchmark_results/generated/temp_trace_t2_a.json');

execFileSync(process.execPath, [viteNodeBin, benchmarkScript, '--frames', '100', '--seeds', '7', '--terrain-mode', 'real', '--trace', '--trace-out', tmpT2A], { stdio: 'pipe' });
execFileSync(process.execPath, [viteNodeBin, benchmarkScript, '--frames', '100', '--seeds', '7', '--terrain-mode', 'real', '--trace', '--trace-out', tmpT2B], { stdio: 'pipe' });
assert.equal(readFileSync(tmpT2A, 'utf8'), readFileSync(tmpT2B, 'utf8'), 'T2: Independent process real DEM traces must be bit-for-bit identical');
try { unlinkSync(tmpT2A); unlinkSync(tmpT2B); } catch (_) {}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// T3: Different seeds in synthetic mode (verify seed-dependent divergence)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
console.log('\n[T3] Verifying seed-dependent RNG & traffic sensitivity (Synthetic DEM)...');
const t3Seed1 = generateSimulationTrace({ seed: 1, frames: 100, terrainMode: 'synthetic' });
const t3Seed2 = generateSimulationTrace({ seed: 2, frames: 100, terrainMode: 'synthetic' });

// Frame 0 initialization: both instances have 0 packets enqueued at t=0 before traffic gen,
// but their PRNG generators hold different seed offsets.

let foundDivergence = false;

for (let i = 1; i <= 100; i++) {
  if (t3Seed1.trace[i].state_sha256 !== t3Seed2.trace[i].state_sha256) {
    foundDivergence = true;
    divergenceFrame = i;
    break;
  }
}
assert.ok(foundDivergence, 'T3: Different seeds in synthetic mode must produce diverging simulation states');
console.log(`  -> PASS: Synthetic runs with seed 1 vs seed 2 diverged at frame ${divergenceFrame} as expected.`);

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

const t4Seed1 = generateSimulationTrace({ seed: 1, frames: 50, terrainMode: 'real', realDemBuffer, terrainAssetChecksum: demChecksum });
const t4Seed2 = generateSimulationTrace({ seed: 2, frames: 50, terrainMode: 'real', realDemBuffer, terrainAssetChecksum: demChecksum });

// In the default Ladakh DEM placement, 15 out of 16 terminals are in hard terrain shadow.

// We verify that both runs execute without NaN errors and record their behavior.
assert.equal(t4Seed1.trace.length, 51);
assert.equal(t4Seed2.trace.length, 51);
console.log('  -> PASS: Real-DEM executions with multiple seeds completed with valid, finite canonical hashes.');

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

const mgrBase = new SimulationWorkerManager(100_000);
mgrBase.terrainEngine.setTerrainMode('synthetic');
mgrBase.isPaused = true;

const mgrAltered = new SimulationWorkerManager(100_000);
mgrAltered.terrainEngine.setTerrainMode('synthetic');
mgrAltered.isPaused = true;

// Run 10 identical frames
for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
  mgrBase.tickSimulation();
  mgrAltered.tickSimulation();
  assert.equal(
    computeCanonicalStateHash(mgrBase),

    `T5: Pre-mutation state must match at frame ${i + 1}`
  );
}

 * 4. Node duplication (NODE_DUPLICATE) with spatial offset, copied role/AGL/traffic profiles,
 *    and fully independent queues, packets, and PRNG seeds.
 * 5. Runtime node updates (NODE_UPDATE) for callsign, role, coordinates, AGL, and traffic options.
 * 6. Zero-node safe operation (N = 0) with no division-by-zero, empty allocations, and safe telemetry.
 * 7. Population scaling up to 128 active nodes and strict rejection of the 129th node.
 * 8. Spatial Lock enforcement across spatial node mutations.
 * 9. Input validation and atomic rejection without partial state corruption.
 * 10. Dynamic scheduler airtime allocation across variable population sizes (N = 1..128).

 * 12. UI Command builders and input validation helpers in src/ui/nodeInventory.ts.

    assert.strictEqual(delRes.accepted, false);

    const dupRes = mgr.handleMessage({ type: 'NODE_DUPLICATE', source_node_id: 0 });
    assert.strictEqual(dupRes.accepted, false);
    assert.strictEqual(dupRes.reason, 'Spatial lock is enabled; spatial state was not changed.');

    assert.strictEqual(updSpatial.accepted, false);
    assert.strictEqual(updSpatial.reason, 'Spatial lock is enabled; spatial state was not changed.');

    const updCallsign = mgr.handleMessage({ type: 'NODE_UPDATE', node_id: 0, callsign: 'RIFLE-0' });

  {
    const mgr = new SimulationWorkerManager();

    const badX = mgr.handleMessage({ type: 'NODE_ADD', x_m: 700000.0, y_m: 0.0 });
    assert.strictEqual(badX.accepted, false);
    assert.ok(badX.reason?.includes('theater bounds'));

    assert.strictEqual(badAgl.accepted, false);
    assert.ok(badAgl.reason?.includes('agl_m between 0 and 1000'));

    // Invalid role
    const badRole = mgr.handleMessage({ type: 'NODE_ADD', role: 'satellite' as any });
    assert.strictEqual(badRole.accepted, false);
    assert.ok(badRole.reason?.includes("role must be 'soldier' or 'mcp'"));

    const badCallsign = mgr.handleMessage({ type: 'NODE_ADD', callsign: '   ' });
    assert.strictEqual(badCallsign.accepted, false);
    assert.ok(badCallsign.reason?.includes('callsign must be a non-empty string'));

    // Deleting non-existent node
    const badDel = mgr.handleMessage({ type: 'NODE_DELETE', node_id: 999 });
    assert.strictEqual(badDel.accepted, false);
    assert.ok(badDel.reason?.includes('node_id must identify an active registered ground node'));

    assert.strictEqual(mgr.nodeRegistry.size, 16, 'Node count must remain unchanged after rejected operations');

  logSection('Test 10: Dynamic Scheduling Across Variable Population Sizes');
  {
    const staticSched = new LegacyStaticScheduler();

    // Check sizes: N = 1, 5, 16, 32, 128
    const testSizes = [1, 5, 16, 32, 128];
    for (const N of testSizes) {
      const mgr = new SimulationWorkerManager();
      // Adjust manager to N nodes
      if (N < 16) {
        for (let i = N; i < 16; i++) mgr.handleMessage({ type: 'NODE_DELETE', node_id: i });
      } else if (N > 16) {
        for (let i = 16; i < N; i++) mgr.handleMessage({ type: 'NODE_ADD', x_m: i * 10, y_m: i * 10 });
      }

      assert.strictEqual(mgr.nodesStatic.length, N);
      const rep = staticSched.scheduleFrame(0, 0.0, mgr.nodesStatic, mgr.linkStatuses, mgr.predStates);
      assert.strictEqual(rep.allocations.length, N, `Static TDMA must allocate exactly ${N} slots`);

      const expectedSlotS = (tUl - N * TAU_GUARD_S) / N;
      const actualSlotS = rep.allocations[0].durationS;
      assert.ok(
        Math.abs(actualSlotS - expectedSlotS) < 1e-9,
        `Slot duration for N=${N} must equal (tUl - N*tauGuard)/N`
      );

      // Verify total airtime does not exceed tUl
      const totalAirtime = rep.allocations.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.durationS + TAU_GUARD_S, 0);
      assert.ok(totalAirtime <= tUl + 1e-9, `Total scheduled airtime for N=${N} must not exceed available`);
    }

    logTest(10, 'Static TDMA and dynamic schedulers cleanly scale slot durations across N = 1, 5, 16, 32, 128.');
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Test 11: 16-Node Baseline Invariant Preservation & Reset
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  logSection('Test 11: 16-Node Baseline Preservation and Clean Simulation Reset');
  {
    const mgr = new SimulationWorkerManager(0);
    assert.strictEqual(mgr.nodeRegistry.size, 16);

    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
      const e = mgr.nodeRegistry.getByNodeId(i)!;

/**
 * src/tests/verifyHgtMosaic.ts
 *
 * Dedicated verification suite for Multi-Tile HGT Folder Loading,
 * Mosaic Stitching, Patch Streaming, and Camera Centring:
 *
 * 1.  Parsing multiple HGT filenames.
 * 2.  Identifying neighbouring tiles & connected component clustering.
 * 3.  Correct geographic placement of each tile in local Equirectangular projection.
 * 4.  Correct stitching of two neighbouring tiles (horizontal & vertical).
 * 5.  Correct stitching of four neighbouring tiles (2x2 contiguous mosaic).
 * 6.  Shared boundary handling & duplicate edge sample determinism.
 * 7.  Void samples at tile boundaries & missing tile handling (NaN fill).
 * 8.  Single-file camera centring without coordinate changes.
 * 9.  Patch selection and maximum active tile limits.
 * 10. Tile unloading, cache reuse & LRU eviction.
 * 11. Elevation queries across tile boundaries in TerrainEngine.
 * 12. Existing PNG terrain compatibility.
 * 13. Existing single-HGT upload compatibility.
 * 14. Worker terrain obstruction and Fresnel clearance integration across stitched mosaic.

import {
  buildTileCatalog,
  clusterNeighbouringTiles,
  selectActivePatch,
  stitchHgtTiles,
  DecodedTileCache,
  DecodedTile,
  SrtmCatalogTile,

import {
  parseHgtBuffer,

  SRTM3_BYTE_LENGTH,
  SRTM1_SAMPLE_COUNT,
  SRTM1_BYTE_LENGTH,
  SRTM_VOID_VALUE,
  HGT_METERS_PER_DEG_LAT,
  HGT_METERS_PER_DEG_LON,
  THEATER_ORIGIN_LAT_DEG,
  THEATER_ORIGIN_LON_DEG,
} from '../core/hgtParser';
import { TerrainEngine, REAL_LADAKH_DEM_METADATA } from '../core/terrain';
import { RFConfig, EnvironmentConfig } from '../core/config';
import { SimulationWorkerManager } from '../worker/simWorker';

function assert(condition: boolean, message: string): void {
  if (!condition) {
    throw new Error(`Assertion failed: ${message}`);
  }
}

function assertClose(actual: number, expected: number, tol = 1e-4, msg = ''): void {
  const diff = Math.abs(actual - expected);
  if (diff > tol) {
    throw new Error(`Assertion failed: expected ${expected} ± ${tol}, got ${actual}. ${msg}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Creates a synthetic decoded tile with a predictable mathematical elevation surface.
 * Lat: [minLat, minLat+1], Lon: [minLon, minLon+1].
 */
function createSyntheticDecodedTile(
  tileName: string,
  minLat: number,
  minLon: number,
  sampleCount = 1201,
  elevationFn?: (latDeg: number, lonDeg: number) => number
): DecodedTile {
  const elevations = new Float32Array(sampleCount * sampleCount);
  let minElev = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  let maxElev = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  let voidCount = 0;

  const fn =
    elevationFn ??
    ((lat, lon) => {
      // Smooth continuous surface based on absolute lat/lon
      return 3000 + (lat - 34.0) * 500 + (lon - 76.0) * 300;
    });

  for (let r = 0; r < sampleCount; r++) {
    // Row 0 is maxLat, Row sampleCount-1 is minLat
    const lat = (minLat + 1.0) - (r / (sampleCount - 1)) * 1.0;
    for (let c = 0; c < sampleCount; c++) {
      // Col 0 is minLon, Col sampleCount-1 is maxLon
      const lon = minLon + (c / (sampleCount - 1)) * 1.0;
      const elev = fn(lat, lon);
      elevations[r * sampleCount + c] = elev;
      if (Number.isFinite(elev)) {
        if (elev < minElev) minElev = elev;
        if (elev > maxElev) maxElev = elev;
      } else {
        voidCount++;
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    tileName,
    minLatDeg: minLat,
    maxLatDeg: minLat + 1.0,
    minLonDeg: minLon,
    maxLonDeg: minLon + 1.0,
    sampleCount,
    elevations,
    minElevationM: Number.isFinite(minElev) ? minElev : 0,
    maxElevationM: Number.isFinite(maxElev) ? maxElev : 0,
    voidCount,
  };
}

  } finally {

  }

  console.log('  ALL 14 MULTI-TILE HGT MOSAIC & PATCH STREAMING TESTS PASSED CLEANLY!');

/**

 *
 * Dedicated verification suite for SRTM HGT elevation file support:
 * 1. Dimension and byte length validation (SRTM3 1201×1201, SRTM1 3601×3601, rejection of corrupt/truncated sizes).
 * 2. Tile naming and georeferencing ([NS]\d{2}[EW]\d{3}, hemisphere offsets, Cartesian bounding boxes).
 * 3. Big-endian Int16 decoding and standard SRTM void (-32768) mapping to NaN.
 * 4. TerrainEngine custom DEM integration: coverage bounds, bilinear elevation queries, void-masking interpolation, and Fresnel clearance checks.
 * 5. SimulationWorkerManager LOAD_CUSTOM_DEM execution: authoritative state update, hillshade generation, node altitude resampling, and 3D mesh export.
 * 6. Backward compatibility: default Ladakh DEM metadata preservation and PNG heightmap workflow integrity.

function assert(condition: boolean, message: string): void {
  if (!condition) {
    throw new Error(`Assertion failed: ${message}`);
  }
}

function assertClose(actual: number, expected: number, tol = 1e-4, msg = ''): void {
  const diff = Math.abs(actual - expected);
  if (diff > tol) {
    throw new Error(`Assertion failed: expected ${expected} ± ${tol}, got ${actual}. ${msg}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Milestone 3B.2D — Historical Profile Integration Test Suite
 *
 * Verifies:
 *  1. Ring-buffer capacity, ordering, and strict FIFO eviction.
 *  2. Exact frame/time/node/profile correspondence across frames.
 *  3. Historical profile immutability (frozen snapshots, no external mutations).
 *  4. Live state remaining unchanged during scrubbing (zero mutation of worker).
 *  5. Paused-versus-running state restoration when entering and leaving history.
 *  6. Node selector behavior and identity locking in historical mode.
 *  7. LIVE return and non-interference with profile freshness serials.
 *  8. Eviction detection and clamping when an inspected frame falls off the buffer.
 *  9. Boundary conditions: empty, single-frame, oldest, and newest frame queries.
 * 10. Independent preservation of terrain-LOS vs obstacle-blockage flags.
 * 11. DEM isolation and empirically bounded memory growth (< 4 MB for 600 frames).
 * 12. Viewport compatibility (LinkProfileViewportState zoom/pan seamlessly operates on historical records).
 */

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {
  createHistoricalRecordSnapshot,
  estimateRecordMemoryBytes,
  type HistoricalFrameRecord,
  SimulationHistoryBuffer,
  SimulationHistoryController,
} from '../ui/simulationHistory';
import { buildLinkProfile, type LinkProfile } from '../core/linkProfile';
import { SimulationWorkerManager } from '../worker/simWorker';
import { TerrainEngine } from '../core/terrain';
import { LinkProfileViewportState } from '../ui/linkProfileViewport';

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Helpers & Mock Data Builders
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function createMockProfile(options: {
  frameIndex: number;
  simTimeS: number;
  nodeId: number;
  isLos: boolean;
  obstacleBlocked: boolean;
  diffractionLossDb?: number;
  obstacleId?: string;
}): LinkProfile {
  return buildLinkProfile({
    selectedGroundNodeId: options.nodeId,
    nodeName: `S${options.nodeId}`,
    frameIndex: options.frameIndex,
    simulationTimeS: options.simTimeS,
    groundNodePositionMslM: [options.nodeId * 1000, 2000, 1200],
    acnPositionMslM: [25000, 30000, 5000],
    wavelengthM: 0.03,
    effectiveEarthRadiusM: 8500000,
    fresnelFraction: 0.6,
    sampleCount: 64,
    obstruction: {
      minClearanceM: options.isLos ? 42.5 : -15.0,
      fresnelRadiusM: 14.2,
      diffractionLossDb: options.diffractionLossDb ?? (options.isLos ? 0.0 : 35.0),
      isLos: options.isLos,
      obstacleBlocked: options.obstacleBlocked,
      obstacleIntersections: options.obstacleBlocked ? [{
        obstacleId: options.obstacleId ?? 'obs_alpha',
        entryFraction: 0.4,
        exitFraction: 0.6,
        penetrationM: 6000,
      }] : [],
    },
    getTerrainElevationMslM: () => 1200,
    computeEarthBulgeM: TerrainEngine.computeEarthBulge,
  });
}

function createMockRecord(options: {
  frameIndex: number;
  simTimeS: number;
  nodeId: number;
  isLos: boolean;
  obstacleBlocked: boolean;
  profileSerial?: number;
  diffractionLossDb?: number;
  obstacleId?: string;
}): HistoricalFrameRecord {
  const profile = createMockProfile(options);
  return createHistoricalRecordSnapshot({
    frameIndex: options.frameIndex,
    simulationTimeS: options.simTimeS,
    selectedNodeId: options.nodeId,
    nodeName: `S${options.nodeId}`,
    profileSerial: options.profileSerial ?? options.frameIndex,
    groundNodePositionMslM: [options.nodeId * 1000, 2000, 1200],
    acnPositionMslM: [25000, 30000, 5000],
    profile,
    obstruction: {
      terrainIsLos: options.isLos,
      obstacleBlocked: options.obstacleBlocked,
      minClearanceM: profile.terrainMinimumClearanceM,
      diffractionLossDb: profile.diffractionLossDb,
      primaryBlockedObstacleId: options.obstacleBlocked ? 'obs_alpha' : null,
      terrainStatusText: options.isLos ? 'PRISTINE LINE-OF-SIGHT' : 'TOTAL OCCLUSION',
      terrainBadgeClass: options.isLos ? 'badge-emerald' : 'badge-crimson',
      obstacleStatusText: options.obstacleBlocked ? 'OBSTACLE BLOCKED: obs_alpha' : 'OBSTACLES: CLEAR',
      obstacleBadgeClass: options.obstacleBlocked ? 'badge-crimson' : 'badge-emerald',
    },
    linkBudget: {
      modcodName: 'QPSK 3/4',
      snrDb: options.isLos && !options.obstacleBlocked ? 28.5 : -5.0,
      spectralEfficiencyBpsHz: 1.49,
      slantRangeKm: 39.0,
      fsplDb: 142.3,
      diffractionLossDb: profile.diffractionLossDb,
      rxPowerDbm: -78.5,
      earthBulgeM: 117.0,
      gaseousLossDb: 0.45,
    },
  });
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Test 1 — Ring-buffer capacity, ordering, and strict FIFO eviction
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
{
  const capacity = 10;
  const buffer = new SimulationHistoryBuffer(capacity);
  assert.equal(buffer.size, 0);

  // Push 10 frames
  for (let i = 1; i <= 10; i++) {
    buffer.push(createMockRecord({ frameIndex: i, simTimeS: i * 0.02, nodeId: 4, isLos: true, obstacleBlocked: false }));
  }
  assert.equal(buffer.size, 10);
  assert.equal(buffer.getOldest()?.frameIndex, 1);
  assert.equal(buffer.getNewest()?.frameIndex, 10);

  // Push 5 more frames (frames 11..15) -> frames 1..5 should be evicted
  for (let i = 11; i <= 15; i++) {
    buffer.push(createMockRecord({ frameIndex: i, simTimeS: i * 0.02, nodeId: 4, isLos: true, obstacleBlocked: false }));
  }
  assert.equal(buffer.size, 10, 'size remains clamped to capacity');
  assert.equal(buffer.getOldest()?.frameIndex, 6, 'oldest frame is now 6');
  assert.equal(buffer.getNewest()?.frameIndex, 15, 'newest frame is now 15');

  // Verify evicted frames are reported as evicted and return null
  for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
    assert.equal(buffer.isEvicted(i), true, `frame ${i} is recognized as evicted`);
    assert.equal(buffer.getByFrameIndex(i), null, `evicted frame ${i} returns null`);
  }

  // Verify kept frames are intact and retrievable
  for (let i = 6; i <= 15; i++) {
    assert.equal(buffer.isEvicted(i), false);
    const rec = buffer.getByFrameIndex(i);
    assert.ok(rec !== null, `frame ${i} found`);
    assert.equal(rec.frameIndex, i);
  }

  console.log('PASS Test 1 — Ring-buffer capacity, ordering, and strict FIFO eviction');
}

{

  buffer.push(createMockRecord({ frameIndex: 101, simTimeS: 2.02, nodeId: 4, isLos: false, obstacleBlocked: false, diffractionLossDb: 28.0 }));

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Test 3 — Historical profile immutability (frozen snapshots, no external mutations)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
{
  const rec = createMockRecord({ frameIndex: 50, simTimeS: 1.0, nodeId: 4, isLos: true, obstacleBlocked: false });

  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(rec), 'record envelope is frozen');
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(rec.profile), 'profile is frozen');
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(rec.profile.samples), 'samples array is frozen');
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(rec.profile.obstacleIntervals), 'intervals array is frozen');
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(rec.groundNodePositionMslM), 'ground node pos array is frozen');
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(rec.acnPositionMslM), 'acn pos array is frozen');

  // Verify mutations fail in strict mode
  assert.throws(() => {
    (rec as any).frameIndex = 999;
  }, /Cannot assign to read only property/);

  assert.throws(() => {
    (rec.profile as any).terrainIsLos = false;
  }, /Cannot assign to read only property/);

  assert.throws(() => {
    (rec.profile.samples as any).push({} as any);
  }, /Cannot add property/);

  console.log('PASS Test 3 — Historical profile immutability (frozen snapshots, no external mutations)');
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Test 4 — Live state remaining unchanged during scrubbing (zero mutation of worker)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
{
  const sim = new SimulationWorkerManager();
  sim.isPaused = true;

  // Run 10 ticks to generate telemetry state
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    sim.tickSimulation();
  }

  const baselineTime = sim.simTimeS;
  const baselineFrame = sim.frameIndex;
  const baselineQueueBits = sim.nodesTac.map(n => n.queue.getTotalBacklogBits());
  const baselineMetrics = { ...sim.metrics };

  // Set up history controller and populate with records
  const buffer = new SimulationHistoryBuffer(600);
  for (let i = 1; i <= sim.frameIndex; i++) {
    buffer.push(createMockRecord({ frameIndex: i, simTimeS: i * 0.02, nodeId: 4, isLos: true, obstacleBlocked: false }));
  }
  const controller = new SimulationHistoryController(buffer);

  // Scrub across historical frames
  controller.enterHistorical(5, false);
  controller.scrubTo(2);
  controller.scrubTo(7);
  controller.scrubTo(1);
  controller.scrubTo(10);

  // Invariant check: Worker state must be 100% untouched
  assert.equal(sim.simTimeS, baselineTime, 'simTimeS not altered by history scrubbing');
  assert.equal(sim.frameIndex, baselineFrame, 'frameIndex not altered');
  assert.deepEqual(sim.nodesTac.map(n => n.queue.getTotalBacklogBits()), baselineQueueBits, 'queues not altered');
  assert.deepEqual(sim.metrics, baselineMetrics, 'KPI accumulators not altered');

  console.log('PASS Test 4 — Live state remaining unchanged during scrubbing (zero mutation of worker)');
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Test 5 — Paused-versus-running state restoration when entering and leaving history
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
{
  const buffer = new SimulationHistoryBuffer(100);
  for (let i = 1; i <= 20; i++) {
    buffer.push(createMockRecord({ frameIndex: i, simTimeS: i * 0.02, nodeId: 4, isLos: true, obstacleBlocked: false }));
  }

  // Case A: Simulation was RUNNING when user scrubbed into history
  {
    const controller = new SimulationHistoryController(buffer);
    const entered = controller.enterHistorical(10, true /* was running */);
    assert.equal(entered.shouldPause, true, 'controller instructs caller to pause running sim');
    assert.equal(controller.isInspecting, true);
    assert.equal(controller.wasRunningBefore, true);

    // User inspects frames
    controller.scrubTo(5);

    // Returning to LIVE should resume simulation
    const exited = controller.exitHistorical();
    assert.equal(exited.shouldResume, true, 'controller instructs caller to resume running sim');
    assert.equal(controller.isInspecting, false);
  }

  // Case B: Simulation was ALREADY PAUSED when user scrubbed into history
  {
    const controller = new SimulationHistoryController(buffer);
    const entered = controller.enterHistorical(10, false /* was already paused */);
    assert.equal(entered.shouldPause, false, 'no pause required if already paused');
    assert.equal(controller.isInspecting, true);
    assert.equal(controller.wasRunningBefore, false);

    // User inspects frames
    controller.scrubTo(8);

    // Returning to LIVE should keep simulation paused
    const exited = controller.exitHistorical();
    assert.equal(exited.shouldResume, false, 'controller instructs caller to keep simulation paused');
    assert.equal(controller.isInspecting, false);
  }

  console.log('PASS Test 5 — Paused-versus-running state restoration when entering and leaving history');
}

  assert.equal(r2?.profile.selectedGroundNodeId, 2);
