  padding-bottom: 6px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.map-node-details .detail-grid span:nth-child(even) {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  text-align: right;
  color: var(--text);
}
.map-node-details .detail-grid span:nth-child(odd) {
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.map-node-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 5px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.map-node-actions button {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* Responsive accommodations for 1280x800 and 1024x768 */
@media (max-width: 1280px) {
  .topbar {
    padding: 4px 10px;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .brand b {
    font-size: 12.5px;
  }
  .rail {
    width: 76px;
  }
  .nav-tab {
    padding: 9px 2px;
    font-size: 9.5px;
  }
  .nav-tab svg {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
  }
  .pane {
    padding: 14px 16px 28px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .topbar .seg[aria-label="Interface help"] {
    display: none;
  }
  .rail {
    width: 68px;
    padding: 8px 3px;
  }
  .nav-tab {
    font-size: 9px;
    padding: 8px 1px;
    gap: 3px;
  }
  .nav-tab svg {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
  }
}
</style>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="./frontend/c2-console-theme.css">
</head>
<body>

<header class="topbar">
  <div class="brand"><span class="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true"></span><div><b>X-Band Digital Twin</b><small>Air-to-ground network simulator</small></div></div>
  <div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Simulation transport">
    <button id="btn-pause" onclick="togglePause()" title="Pause or resume (Space)">PAUSE</button>
    <button id="btn-step" onclick="stepSim()" title="Advance one 20 ms frame (.)">STEP ⏭</button>
    <span class="sep"></span>
    <div class="sim-speed-ctrl" role="group" aria-label="Simulation speed controller">
      <span id="sim-speed-readout" class="sim-speed-readout" title="Selected simulation target speed">1.0×</span>
      <span id="sim-achieved-readout" class="sim-speed-achieved" title="Achieved simulation rate" style="display:none;"></span>
      <input type="range" id="sim-speed-slider" class="sim-speed-slider" min="0.1" max="10" step="0.05" value="1.0" aria-label="Simulation speed slider" title="Adjust simulation speed (0.1× – 10×)" oninput="onSpeedSliderInput(this.value)">
      <input type="number" id="sim-speed-input" class="sim-speed-input" min="0.1" max="10" step="0.05" value="1.0" aria-label="Simulation speed numeric entry" title="Direct speed multiplier (0.1× – 10×)" onchange="onSpeedNumInput(this.value)" oninput="onSpeedNumInput(this.value)">
      <div class="sim-speed-presets" role="group" aria-label="Speed presets">
        <button type="button" id="spd-05" class="spd-preset-btn" onclick="setSpeed(0.5)" title="0.5× speed">0.5×</button>
        <button type="button" id="spd-10" class="spd-preset-btn active" onclick="setSpeed(1.0)" title="1× speed (real-time)">1×</button>
        <button type="button" id="spd-20" class="spd-preset-btn" onclick="setSpeed(2.0)" title="2× speed">2×</button>
        <button type="button" id="spd-50" class="spd-preset-btn" onclick="setSpeed(5.0)" title="5× speed">5×</button>
        <button type="button" id="spd-100" class="spd-preset-btn" onclick="setSpeed(10.0)" title="10× speed">10×</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <span class="sep"></span>
    <button class="btn-danger" onclick="resetSim()" title="Restart the simulation">RESET</button>
  </div>
  <div class="clock"><span id="clock-display">T+00:00.0s</span><span id="frame-display" class="muted">#0</span></div>
  <button id="btn-spatial-lock" type="button" aria-pressed="false" onclick="toggleSpatialLock()" title="Prevent spatial scenario edits in the simulation worker">Spatial lock: OFF</button>
  <div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Interface help">
    <button id="btn-expert" type="button" aria-pressed="false" title="Open every collapsed section">Expert view</button>
    <button id="btn-help" type="button" title="Show the quick tour">Help</button>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="shell">
<nav class="rail" role="tablist" aria-label="Workspaces">
  <button class="nav-tab active" id="tab-btn-overview" onclick="switchMainTab('tab-overview')" title="Overview (1)"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3"/></svg>Overview</button>
  <button class="nav-tab" id="tab-btn-scheduler" onclick="switchMainTab('tab-scheduler')" title="Scheduler (2)"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h10M4 18h13"/></svg>Scheduler</button>
  <button class="nav-tab" id="tab-btn-network" onclick="switchMainTab('tab-network')" title="Network Performance (3)"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 18V8M10 18V4M16 18v-7M22 18H2"/></svg>Network<br>Performance</button>
  <button class="nav-tab" id="tab-btn-registration" onclick="switchMainTab('tab-registration')" title="Registration"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="m8 12 2.5 2.5L16 9"/></svg>Registration</button>
  <button class="nav-tab" id="tab-btn-terrain" onclick="switchMainTab('tab-terrain')" title="Terrain &amp; RF (4)"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 19l6-10 4 6 3-4 5 8z"/></svg>Terrain &amp; RF</button>
  <button class="nav-tab" id="tab-btn-terminal" onclick="switchMainTab('tab-terminal')" title="Terminals (5)"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="4" y="5" width="16" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M8 20h8M12 16v4"/></svg>Terminals</button>
  <button class="nav-tab" id="tab-btn-doc" onclick="switchMainTab('tab-doc')" title="Research &amp; Docs (6)"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 3h9l4 4v14H6z"/><path d="M9 12h7M9 16h7"/></svg>Research &amp; Docs</button>
</nav>

<main class="main-viewport" id="main-workspace" style="--map-width:44%">
  <aside class="persistent-map-panel" id="persistent-map-panel" aria-label="Persistent terrain and network map">
    <div class="persistent-map-mount" id="persistent-map-mount"></div>
  </aside>
  <div class="map-resize-handle" id="map-resize-handle" role="separator" aria-label="Resize map and workspace" aria-orientation="vertical" tabindex="0" title="Drag to resize"></div>
  <section class="detail-viewport" id="detail-viewport" aria-label="Selected workspace">

  <!-- ===== OVERVIEW ===== -->
  <section class="tab-content active" id="tab-overview">
    <div class="overview-layout">
      <div class="radar-stage">
        <div class="stage-toolbar">
          <div class="stage-title">Live map <span class="badge-sub">stays visible in every view</span></div>
          <div class="tool-group">
            <span class="tool-label">View</span>
            <div class="seg" id="view-mode-toggle">
              <button id="btnView2D" class="active" onclick="setStageViewMode('2d')" title="2D Tactical Radar Map">2D Map</button>
              <button id="btnView3D" onclick="setStageViewMode('3d')" title="3D Tactical Terrain View">3D Terrain</button>
            </div>
            <span class="tool-label">Map</span>
            <div class="seg" id="map-mode-toggle">
              <button id="btnMapRadar" class="active" type="button" title="Existing radar terrain map">Radar</button>
              <button id="btnMapLibre" type="button" title="Geographic MapLibre map">MapLibre</button>
            </div>
            <span class="tool-label" id="label-mesh-res" style="display:none">Mesh</span>
            <div class="seg" id="mesh-res-toggle" style="display:none">
              <button id="btnRes512" class="active" onclick="setTerrainMeshResolution('native512')" title="Native 512×512 DEM (High Fidelity)">512 Native</button>
              <button id="btnRes256" onclick="setTerrainMeshResolution('balanced256')" title="256×256 Endpoint-Preserving Bilinear Mesh (Reduced Resolution)">256 Reduced</button>
            </div>
            <span class="tool-label">Terrain</span>
            <div class="seg">
              <button id="btnRealTerrain" class="active" onclick="setTerrainMode('real')" title="Real satellite elevation data">Satellite</button>
              <button id="btnSynthTerrain" onclick="setTerrainMode('synthetic')" title="Generated fractal terrain">Synthetic</button>
              <button id="btnUploadTerrain" onclick="openUploadModal()" title="Upload a heightmap (.png, .jpg)">Upload…</button>
            </div>
            <span class="tool-label">Range</span>
            <div class="seg">
              <button id="zoom-30" onclick="setRadarRange(30000)">30 km</button>
              <button id="zoom-60" class="active" onclick="setRadarRange(60000)">60 km</button>
              <button id="zoom-100" onclick="setRadarRange(100000)">100 km</button>
              <button id="zoom-200" onclick="setRadarRange(200000)">200 km</button>
              <button onclick="centerMapOnACN()" title="Re-center on the airborne relay">Center</button>
              <button id="obstacle-map-tool" type="button" aria-pressed="false" title="Select and move obstacle drafts on the map">Obstacle tool: OFF</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="radar-stage-body">
        <div class="radar-canvas-container" id="radar-container" style="cursor:grab">
          <canvas id="radar-canvas" aria-label="Live terrain and ground terminal network map"></canvas>
          <div id="maplibre-stage" class="maplibre-stage" aria-label="Geographic MapLibre simulation map">
            <div id="maplibre-map" style="position:absolute;inset:0"></div>
            <div id="maplibre-info" class="maplibre-info">Click ACN or a ground node for telemetry.</div>
            <div id="maplibre-status" class="maplibre-status">MapLibre map is not initialized.</div>
          </div>
          <div id="map-node-tooltip" class="map-node-tooltip" role="tooltip" aria-live="polite"></div>
        <button id="terrain-toolbox-toggle-btn" class="terrain-toolbox-toggle-btn" type="button" title="Terrain Toolbox" aria-label="Terrain Toolbox" aria-expanded="false">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="13" height="13" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M14.7 6.3a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.4l1.6 1.6a1 1 0 0 0 1.4 0l3.77-3.77a6 6 0 0 1-7.94 7.94l-6.91 6.91a2.12 2.12 0 0 1-3-3l6.91-6.91a6 6 0 0 1 7.94-7.94l-3.76 3.76z"/>
          </svg>
          <span>Terrain Toolbox</span>
        </button>
        <div id="terrain-toolbox-panel" class="terrain-toolbox-panel is-collapsed" aria-label="Terrain toolbox">
          <div class="terrain-toolbox-row">
            <strong>Terrain Toolbox</strong>
            <button id="terrain-fit-btn" type="button" title="Fit active terrain bounds">Best-fit</button>
            <button id="terrain-zoom-out-btn" type="button" title="Zoom out">−</button>
            <button id="terrain-zoom-in-btn" type="button" title="Zoom in">+</button>
            <button id="terrain-toolbox-close-btn" class="btn-close-toolbox" type="button" title="Collapse Terrain Toolbox" aria-label="Collapse Terrain Toolbox">×</button>
          </div>
          <div class="terrain-toolbox-row">
            <button id="terrain-measure-btn" type="button">Measure distance</button>
            <button id="terrain-measure-clear-btn" type="button">Clear measure</button>
          </div>
          <div class="terrain-toolbox-row">
            <button id="terrain-region-btn" type="button">Draw region</button>
            <button id="terrain-region-finish-btn" type="button" disabled>Finish</button>
            <button id="terrain-region-cancel-btn" type="button" disabled>Cancel</button>
          </div>
          <div id="terrain-toolbox-status" class="terrain-toolbox-status">Tools ready. Coordinates remain geographic.</div>
          <div id="terrain-toolbox-regions" class="terrain-toolbox-list" aria-label="Drawn regions"></div>
        </div>
        <div id="radar-cursor-hud" class="radar-cursor-hud is-idle" aria-label="Geographic cursor coordinates and terrain elevation" title="Move cursor over map to inspect coordinates">
            <span style="color:#64748b;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;"><span style="width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#475569;"></span>CURSOR: OUTSIDE RADAR MAP</span>
          </div>
          <div id="three-stage-container" class="three-stage-container" style="display:none;position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;z-index:2;" aria-hidden="true">
            <canvas id="three-canvas" aria-label="3D Tactical Terrain View"></canvas>
            <div class="three-hud-overlay" style="position:absolute;bottom:14px;left:14px;pointer-events:none;z-index:4;">
              <span id="three-terrain-badge" class="kpi-badge badge-cyan" style="font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:0.04em;background:rgba(15,23,42,0.88);border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.35);padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">
                <span id="three-terrain-dot" style="width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#38bdf8;box-shadow:0 0 6px #38bdf8;"></span>
                <span id="three-terrain-status-text">3D TERRAIN — NATIVE 512×512</span>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="map-legend" aria-label="Map legend">
            <span><i class="legend-line conn"></i>Connected</span>
            <span><i class="legend-line deg"></i>Degraded</span>
            <span><i class="legend-line blk-t"></i>Blocked (terrain)</span>
            <span><i class="legend-line blk-o"></i>Blocked (obstacle)</span>
            <span><i class="legend-line out"></i>Outage</span>
            <span><i class="legend-square"></i>Airborne relay</span>
            <span>◎ Selected terminal</span>
            <span style="color:#38bdf8">▸▸ Uplink (UL: Node → ACN)</span>
            <span style="color:#f8fafc">◂◂ Downlink (DL: ACN → Node)</span>
            <span style="color:#38bdf8"><b>TX / RX</b> Active</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside id="map-node-details" class="map-node-details is-empty" aria-label="Selected ground node details">
          <div class="map-node-header">
            <span class="sec-title">Selected Node</span>
            <button type="button" class="btn-close-inspector" id="btn-close-node-details" title="Close inspector" aria-label="Close inspector">×</button>
          </div>
          <div id="map-node-detail-content" class="map-node-empty">No ground node selected. Select a marker or choose a terminal from Node Inventory.</div>
          <div class="map-node-actions"><button type="button" data-map-action="edit">Edit / rename</button><button type="button" data-map-action="move">Move on map</button><button type="button" data-map-action="focus">Focus</button><button type="button" data-map-action="performance">Performance</button><button type="button" data-map-action="delete" class="btn-danger">Delete</button></div>
          <div id="map-node-action-status" class="detail-sub" aria-live="polite"></div>
        </aside>
        </div>
        <div class="situation-strip"><strong>What's happening</strong><span id="overview-narrative">Simulation active on dedicated WebWorker thread. Evaluating 50 Hz multi-class telemetry...</span></div>
      </div>

      <aside class="pane overview-sidebar">
        <div class="pane-head"><h2>Mission overview</h2></div>
        <p class="lede">Start a scenario, watch the map, then check whether dynamic scheduling beats the static baseline.</p>

        <div class="welcome" id="welcome">
          <div>
            <strong>New here? A 30-second tour</strong>
            <p class="muted">The map on the left shows the relay aircraft and 16 ground terminals. Link colors show which terminals the aircraft can currently hear.</p>
            <ol>
              <li>Press <b>Run Kargil corridor transit</b> below.</li>
              <li>Watch terminal S4 turn amber, then red, as a ridge blocks its link.</li>
              <li>Compare Tac-TAD with the static baseline under <b>How is it performing?</b></li>
            </ol>
            <small>Shortcuts: 1–5 switch views, Space pauses, . steps one frame.</small>
          </div>
          <button type="button" id="welcome-dismiss">Got it</button>
        </div>

        <div class="sec">
          <div class="sec-title">Scenario</div>
          <div class="sec-sub">Pick a situation to simulate. The mode switch changes which scheduler drives the map.</div>
          <div class="run-row">
            <button class="primary" onclick="runKargilScenario()">Run Kargil corridor transit</button>
            <button onclick="loadPreset('PRESET_16_NODES')">16-Node Patrol</button>
            <button onclick="loadPreset('PRESET_ACN_ONLY')">ACN Only (0 Nodes)</button>
            <button onclick="loadPreset('PRESET_AMBUSH')">Platoon ambush</button>
            <button onclick="loadPreset('PRESET_MONSOON')">Monsoon, 35 mm/h</button>
            <button onclick="loadPreset('PRESET_RESET')">Reset theater</button>
            <button id="scheduler-quick-toggle" onclick="toggleActiveScheduler()" title="Switch between Tac-TAD (dynamic) and Static scheduling">Mode: Tac-TAD</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <details class="trajectory-editor" open>
          <summary><strong>Flight-path editor</strong> <small id="trajectory-commit-label" class="muted">Worker configuration</small></summary>
          <div style="margin-top:9px">
            <label for="trajectory-mode">Trajectory mode</label>
            <select id="trajectory-mode" aria-label="Trajectory mode">
              <option value="ellipse">Ellipse</option>
              <option value="waypoints">Closed waypoint route</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div style="margin-top:10px;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02)">
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:4px">
              <label for="traj-speed-mps" style="font-weight:600;color:var(--text);margin:0">Physical flight speed (m/s)</label>
              <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Current: <b id="traj-current-speed" style="color:var(--cyan)">60.0 m/s</b></span>
            </div>
            <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 80px;gap:8px;align-items:center">
              <input type="range" id="traj-speed-slider" min="0" max="300" step="1" value="60" aria-label="UAV physical flight speed slider">
              <input type="number" id="traj-speed-mps" min="0" max="1000" step="1" value="60" aria-label="UAV physical flight speed input">
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px">
              <span>0 m/s (Hover)</span>
              <span>Nominal: 60 m/s</span>
              <span>Max: 300 m/s</span>
            </div>
            <p style="font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 0;line-height:1.3">
              <em>Physical flight speed controls actual UAV orbit progression (continuous kinematics with bounded acceleration/deceleration). Distinct from visual playback speed (0.1×–1.0×).</em>
            </p>
            <div style="margin-top:8px">
              <label for="traj-altitude-msl">UAV altitude MSL (m)</label>
              <input id="traj-altitude-msl" type="number" step="50" min="1000" max="15000" value="5000" aria-label="UAV altitude MSL">
            </div>
          </div>
          <div id="ellipse-editor">
            <div class="editor-grid">
              <label>Center X (m)<input id="traj-center-x" type="number" step="any"></label>
              <label>Center Y (m)<input id="traj-center-y" type="number" step="any"></label>
              <label>Semi-major axis (m)<input id="traj-axis-a" type="number" step="any" min="0.001" max="600000"></label>
              <label>Semi-minor axis (m)<input id="traj-axis-b" type="number" step="any" min="0.001" max="600000"></label>
              <label>Rotation (&deg;)<input id="traj-rotation" type="number" step="any" min="-360" max="360"></label>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div id="waypoint-editor" hidden>
            <p class="muted" style="font-size:11px;margin-top:8px">Closed route · drag markers or select one to edit local X/Y metres. Ground nodes take priority when map targets overlap; use the waypoint list for covered markers. Add places a point with a map click. Amber line is a draft preview; Apply uses the worker curve.</p>
            <div id="waypoint-list" class="waypoint-list" role="group" aria-label="Select waypoint"></div>
            <div class="editor-grid">
              <label>Selected X (m)<input id="traj-waypoint-x" type="number" step="any"></label>
              <label>Selected Y (m)<input id="traj-waypoint-y" type="number" step="any"></label>
            </div>
            <div class="editor-actions">
              <button type="button" id="trajectory-add-point">Add waypoint</button>
              <button type="button" id="trajectory-place-point">Place on map</button>
              <button type="button" id="trajectory-remove-point" class="btn-danger">Remove selected</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="editor-actions">
            <button type="button" id="trajectory-apply" class="primary">Apply to simulation</button>
            <button type="button" id="trajectory-cancel">Cancel draft</button>
          </div>
          <div id="trajectory-editor-message" class="editor-message" role="status" aria-live="polite">Edits are previews until applied.</div>
        </details>

        <details class="obstacle-editor">
          <summary><strong>Obstacle editor</strong> <small id="obstacle-commit-label" class="muted">Worker-confirmed set · 0 / 128</small></summary>
          <p class="muted" style="font-size:11px;margin:8px 0">Plan-view footprints only. The worker uses terrain elevation for physical obstruction. Select mode lets you drag centers; Place mode adds the selected shape at a map click.</p>
          <div class="editor-grid">
            <label for="obstacle-shape">Shape</label>
            <select id="obstacle-shape" aria-label="New obstacle shape">
              <option value="cuboid">Cuboid</option><option value="cone">Cone</option><option value="pyramid">Pyramid</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="editor-actions">
            <button type="button" id="obstacle-add">Add at map center</button>
            <button type="button" id="obstacle-place">Place on map</button>
            <button type="button" id="obstacle-select-mode">Select / move</button>
          </div>
          <div id="obstacle-list" class="obstacle-list" role="group" aria-label="Select obstacle"></div>
          <div class="editor-grid">
            <label for="obstacle-x">Center X (m)<input id="obstacle-x" type="number" step="any"></label>
            <label for="obstacle-y">Center Y (m)<input id="obstacle-y" type="number" step="any"></label>
            <label id="obstacle-width-label" for="obstacle-width">Width (m)<input id="obstacle-width" type="number" step="any"></label>
            <label id="obstacle-depth-label" for="obstacle-depth">Depth (m)<input id="obstacle-depth" type="number" step="any"></label>
            <label id="obstacle-radius-label" for="obstacle-radius" hidden>Radius (m)<input id="obstacle-radius" type="number" step="any"></label>
            <label for="obstacle-height">Height (m)<input id="obstacle-height" type="number" step="any"></label>
            <label id="obstacle-rotation-label" for="obstacle-rotation">Rotation (&deg;)<input id="obstacle-rotation" type="number" step="any"></label>
          </div>
          <div class="editor-actions">
            <button type="button" id="obstacle-delete" class="btn-danger">Delete selected</button>
            <button type="button" id="obstacle-apply" class="primary">Apply obstacle set</button>
            <button type="button" id="obstacle-cancel">Cancel draft</button>
          </div>
          <div id="obstacle-editor-message" class="obstacle-message" role="status" aria-live="polite">Obstacle edits are previews until applied.</div>
          <div id="obstacle-obstruction-summary" class="muted" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
          <div id="obstacle-lock-note" class="muted" aria-live="polite"></div>
        </details>

        <div class="sec">
          <div class="sec-title">How is it performing?</div>
          <div class="sec-sub">Tac-TAD (dynamic) shown large, static baseline beside it.</div>
          <div class="metric">
            <div class="metric-top"><span class="metric-name">Data delivered</span><span id="kpi-gain-badge" class="kpi-badge badge-cyan">+1.00× GAIN</span></div>
            <div class="metric-main"><span class="metric-val" id="kpi-tac-tx">0.00 Mb</span><span class="metric-base" id="kpi-stat-tx">Base: 0.00 Mb</span></div>
            <div class="metric-foot"><span>Total received, exact-fit delivery</span><span id="kpi-tac-rate">0.00 Mbps</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="metric">
            <div class="metric-top"><span class="metric-name">Airtime wasted on blocked links</span><span id="kpi-waste-saved-badge" class="kpi-badge badge-emerald">0.0% SAVED</span></div>
            <div class="metric-main"><span class="metric-val c-ok" id="kpi-tac-waste">0.0%</span><span class="metric-base" id="kpi-stat-waste">Static: 0.0%</span></div>
            <div class="metric-foot"><span>Slots spent transmitting into rock</span><span id="kpi-waste-mb">0.00 Mb reclaimed</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="metric">
            <div class="metric-top"><span class="metric-name">Packets lost</span><span id="kpi-drop-reduc-badge" class="kpi-badge badge-emerald">0% FEWER</span></div>
            <div class="metric-main"><span class="metric-val" id="kpi-tac-drop">0 (0.0%)</span><span class="metric-base" id="kpi-stat-drop">Static: 0 (0.0%)</span></div>
            <div class="metric-foot"><span>Packets that expired in queues</span><span id="kpi-util-stat">Uplink Util: 0.0%</span></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <details class="more" open data-adv>
          <summary>Inspect a terminal<small>Pick any of the 16 ground terminals</small><span id="overview-state-badge" class="kpi-badge badge-neutral">UNKNOWN</span></summary>
          <div class="more-body">
            <select id="quickNodeSelect" onchange="onTargetNodeChange(this.value)" aria-label="Target terminal">
              <option value="4" selected>Node 4: S4 - Recon Patrol (Occlusion Target)</option>
            </select>
            <div class="agl-control-wrap" style="margin:6px 0 8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px">
              <label for="quick-node-agl-input" style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)">Antenna AGL (m)</label>
              <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
                <input type="number" id="quick-node-agl-input" min="0" max="1000" step="0.5" value="2.0"
                       style="width:75px;padding:3px 6px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;background:#0f1522;border:1px solid #1e2633;color:#fff;border-radius:4px"
                       onchange="onNodeAglChange(this.value)" aria-label="Antenna height above ground level">
                <span id="quick-node-agl-feedback" class="muted" style="font-size:11px"></span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stats">
              <div class="stat"><span>Range</span><b id="glance-slant">--</b></div>
              <div class="stat"><span>Signal-to-noise</span><b id="glance-snr">--</b></div>
              <div class="stat"><span>Data rate</span><b id="glance-rate">--</b></div>
            </div>
            <div class="actions">
              <button type="button" class="link-btn" onclick="switchMainTab('tab-terminal')">Inspect queues and traffic →</button>
              <button type="button" class="link-btn" onclick="switchMainTab('tab-terrain')">Inspect radio link →</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </details>

        <details class="more" data-adv>
          <summary>Trend and change log<small>Recent delivered data and what changed</small></summary>
          <div class="more-body">
            <div class="overview-trend-chart-wrap"><canvas id="overview-goodput-canvas" aria-label="Rolling delivered goodput trend"></canvas></div>
            <div class="overview-trend-footer"><span class="muted">Sampled while this page is open.</span><span id="overview-trend-sample-count" class="mono muted">0 samples</span></div>
            <ol id="overview-event-list" class="overview-event-list" aria-live="polite"><li class="overview-event-empty">Waiting for observable simulation changes…</li></ol>
          </div>
        </details>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== SCHEDULER ===== -->
  <section class="tab-content" id="tab-scheduler">
    <div class="analysis-context" data-context-view="scheduler"><div><span class="context-kicker">Live</span></div><div class="context-meta"><span>Target <b data-context-node>Syncing…</b></span><span>Simulation <b data-context-time>--</b></span><span>Frame <b data-context-frame>--</b></span><span>Mode <b data-context-mode>--</b></span></div></div>
    <div class="pane scheduler-layout">
      <div class="pane-head"><h2>Scheduler</h2></div>
      <p class="lede">Every 20 ms the aircraft divides airtime among terminals. Static TDMA gives each a fixed slice; Tac-TAD resizes slices to demand and skips blocked links.</p>

      <!-- Historical Timeline Scrubber Panel for Scheduler -->
      <div class="panel timeline-scrubber-panel" id="sched-history-panel" aria-label="Scheduler performance historical timeline scrubber">
        <div class="timeline-scrubber-bar">
          <div class="timeline-scrubber-controls">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
              <button type="button" id="btn-sched-history-live" class="btn-live active" title="Return to live simulation (or press Live)">● LIVE</button>
              <span id="sched-history-mode-pill" class="kpi-badge badge-emerald">LIVE STREAM</span>
              <span id="sched-history-target-pill" class="badge-sub">Selected Terminal</span>
            </div>
            <div id="sched-history-current-pos" class="history-current-pos"><b>T+0.00s</b> <small>(#0)</small></div>
          </div>
          <div class="timeline-scrubber-track-wrap">
            <input type="range" id="sched-history-scrubber" min="0" max="0" value="0" step="1" aria-label="Scheduler timeline scrubber" disabled>
          </div>
          <div class="timeline-scrubber-meta">
            <span id="sched-history-span-oldest" class="muted">T+0.0s (#0)</span>
            <span class="muted" style="font-size:10px">60-SECOND ROLLING HISTORY (3,000 FRAMES) · SCHEDULER INSPECTION</span>
            <span id="sched-history-span-newest" class="muted">T+0.0s (#0)</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="sched-history-eviction-warning" class="history-banner warning" style="display:none">
          ⚠️ Selected historical frame was evicted from the 60s buffer. Showing oldest available frame.
        </div>
        <div id="sched-spatial-revision-warning" class="history-banner warning" style="display:none"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- Historical Performance Trend Charts Panel -->
      <div class="panel" id="sched-charts-panel">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <span class="sec-title">Historical performance trends</span>
          <span class="badge-sub">60-second rolling buffer (3,000 frames)</span>
        </div>
        <div class="sched-charts-grid">
          <div class="sched-chart-card">
            <div class="sched-chart-head">
              <span>Uplink airtime utilization (%)</span>
              <b id="chart-util-val" class="c-acc">--</b>
            </div>
            <div class="sched-chart-canvas-wrap">
              <canvas id="sched-chart-utilization" aria-label="Historical airtime utilization chart"></canvas>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="sched-chart-card">
            <div class="sched-chart-head">
              <span id="chart-backlog-label">Queue backlog (KB) &amp; drops</span>
              <b id="chart-backlog-val" class="c-acc">--</b>
            </div>
            <div class="sched-chart-canvas-wrap">
              <canvas id="sched-chart-backlog" aria-label="Historical queue backlog and packet drops chart"></canvas>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Selected Historical Frame Snapshot Panel -->
      <div class="panel" id="sched-snapshot-panel" style="display:none">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <span class="sec-title">Historical performance snapshot</span>
          <span id="sched-snapshot-badge" class="kpi-badge badge-amber">HISTORICAL #0</span>
        </div>
        <div class="inspector-grid">
          <div class="inspector-metric">
            <span>Simulation Time</span>
            <strong id="snap-time">T+0.00s (#0)</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="inspector-metric">
            <span>Scheduler Mode</span>
            <strong id="snap-mode">Tac-TAD</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="inspector-metric">
            <span>Airtime Utilization</span>
            <strong id="snap-util">0.0%</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="inspector-metric">
            <span>Frame Goodput (Exact 20ms)</span>
            <strong id="snap-goodput">--</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="inspector-metric">
            <span>Frame Drops (Delay / Oflw)</span>
            <strong id="snap-drops">0 pkts</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="inspector-metric">
            <span>Terminal Backlog (Selected)</span>
            <strong id="snap-backlog">--</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="inspector-metric">
            <span>Cumulative Goodput (Session)</span>
            <strong id="snap-cum-goodput">--</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="inspector-metric">
            <span>Cumulative Drops (Session)</span>
            <strong id="snap-cum-drops">--</strong>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="panel waterfall-card">
        <div class="panel-head"><span class="sec-title">Superframe timeline (20 ms, 50 Hz)</span></div>
        <div class="legend">
          <span><i style="background:#38bdf8"></i>C2 signaling</span><span><i style="background:#10b981"></i>Voice (PTT)</span><span><i style="background:#f59e0b"></i>Video</span><span><i style="background:#fb923c"></i>Photo/data</span><span><i style="background:#ef4444"></i>Wasted on severed link</span><span><i style="background:rgba(16,185,129,0.25);border:1px dashed #34d399"></i>Reclaimed airtime</span><span><i style="background:#ef4444"></i>Overlap conflict</span><span><i style="background:#1f2937;outline:1px solid var(--line2)"></i>Headroom</span>
        </div>
        <div class="waterfall-canvas-container"><canvas id="waterfall-canvas"></canvas></div>
      </div>
      <div class="panel" id="allocation-inspector">
        <div class="panel-head"><span class="sec-title">Allocation for the selected terminal</span><span class="badge-sub">current frame</span></div>
        <div class="inspector-grid">
          <div class="inspector-metric"><span>Terminal</span><strong id="alloc-node-label">Selected Terminal</strong></div>
          <div class="inspector-metric"><span>Airtime</span><strong id="alloc-airtime">--</strong></div>
          <div class="inspector-metric"><span>Segments</span><strong id="alloc-segments">--</strong></div>
        </div>
        <p class="inspector-footnote" id="alloc-inspector-note">Waiting for current-frame scheduler allocations. This panel reports only allocation fields supplied by worker telemetry.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="panel table-card">
        <div class="panel-head"><span class="sec-title">Cumulative benchmark: static vs Tac-TAD</span><span class="badge-sub">this session</span></div>
        <div class="table-scroll"><table class="data-table">
          <thead><tr><th style="width:34%">Metric</th><th>Static TDMA</th><th class="c-acc">Tac-TAD (ours)</th><th class="c-ok">Advantage</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr><td>Total delivered goodput</td><td id="tbl-stat-tx">0.00 Mb</td><td id="tbl-tac-tx" class="c-acc">0.00 Mb</td><td id="tbl-tx-gain" class="c-ok">+1.00×</td></tr>
            <tr><td>Hard-shadow slot allocation waste</td><td id="tbl-stat-waste" class="c-bad">0.0%</td><td id="tbl-tac-waste" class="c-ok">0.0%</td><td id="tbl-waste-saved" class="c-ok">0.0% saved</td></tr>
            <tr><td>Concluded packets dropped</td><td id="tbl-stat-drops">0 (0.0%)</td><td id="tbl-tac-drops" class="c-ok">0 (0.0%)</td><td id="tbl-drop-reduc" class="c-ok">0% fewer</td></tr>
            <tr><td>Active uplink frame utilization</td><td id="tbl-stat-util">100.0%</td><td id="tbl-tac-util">0.0%</td><td class="muted">Adaptive sizing</td></tr>
            <tr><td id="tbl-backlog-label">Selected terminal queue backlog</td><td id="tbl-n4-stat">--</td><td id="tbl-n4-tac">--</td><td id="tbl-n4-status">--</td></tr>
            <tr><td>Rolling goodput (P50) <small class="muted" style="font-size:10.5px">· 4s / 200 superframes</small></td><td id="tbl-p50-stat">--</td><td id="tbl-p50-tac">--</td><td id="tbl-p50-gain">--</td></tr>
            <tr><td>Rolling goodput (P95) <small class="muted" style="font-size:10.5px">· 4s / 200 superframes</small></td><td id="tbl-p95-stat">--</td><td id="tbl-p95-tac">--</td><td id="tbl-p95-gain">--</td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table></div>
        <p class="inspector-footnote">Statistical specification (M7.3): P50/P95 rolling goodput statistics evaluate actual delivered payload bits over a rolling window of 200 completed superframes (4.0 seconds) using nearest-rank percentiles. Exploratory UI telemetry: values are differences between successive cumulative-goodput readings, not guaranteed one-per-frame samples. At least 20 non-negative increments are required. This session window resets on page reload and is not a controlled benchmark.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== NETWORK PERFORMANCE ===== -->
  <section class="tab-content" id="tab-network">
    <div class="analysis-context" data-context-view="network"><div><span class="context-kicker">Live</span></div><div class="context-meta"><span>Simulation <b data-context-time>--</b></span><span>Frame <b data-context-frame>--</b></span></div></div>
    <div class="pane network-layout">
      <div class="pane-head"><h2>Network Performance Dashboard</h2></div>
      <p class="lede">Compare authoritative link quality, achieved delivery rate, and successfully delivered payload over simulation time. Invalid or disconnected links are excluded from link-quality aggregates.</p>
      <div class="network-dashboard-grid">
        <div class="panel network-dashboard-controls">
          <div class="panel-head"><span class="sec-title">Dashboard view</span><span id="network-dashboard-state" class="kpi-badge badge-emerald">LIVE</span></div>
          <label>View
            <select id="network-view-mode" aria-label="Network dashboard view">
              <option value="individual">Individual nodes</option>
              <option value="aggregate">Combined network</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>Nodes to compare
            <select id="network-node-select" multiple aria-label="Nodes to compare"></select>
          </label>
          <div class="network-metrics-toggles" aria-label="Toggle metrics">
            <label><input type="checkbox" id="network-show-snr" checked> Link quality (SNR)</label>
            <label><input type="checkbox" id="network-show-rate" checked> Achieved data rate</label>
            <label><input type="checkbox" id="network-show-transferred" checked> Data transferred</label>
          </div>
          <label>Time range
            <select id="network-time-range" aria-label="Network chart time range">
              <option value="10">Last 10 seconds</option>
              <option value="30" selected>Last 30 seconds</option>
              <option value="60">Last 60 seconds</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <div class="network-control-actions">
            <button type="button" id="network-pause" class="btn">Pause graph updates</button>
            <button type="button" id="network-clear" class="btn">Clear history</button>
          </div>
          <div id="network-dashboard-empty" class="network-chart-status">Waiting for ground-node telemetry…</div>
          <p class="inspector-footnote">SNR average is the arithmetic mean of valid connected nodes; minimum SNR is shown separately. Rate uses delivered payload rate, not link capacity. Transferred data is accumulated from positive worker-reported delivered-byte deltas.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="network-chart-grid">
          <div class="network-chart-card" id="network-individual-card"><div class="network-chart-head"><span>Selected node history</span><b id="network-individual-value">--</b></div><canvas id="network-individual-chart" aria-label="Per-node network performance chart"></canvas></div>
          <div class="network-chart-card" id="network-aggregate-card" style="display:none"><div class="network-chart-head"><span>Combined network history</span><b id="network-aggregate-value">--</b></div><canvas id="network-aggregate-chart" aria-label="Aggregate network performance chart"></canvas></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="tab-content" id="tab-registration">
    <div class="analysis-context"><div><span class="context-kicker">Live · Worker state</span></div><div class="context-meta"><span>Simulation <b id="registration-sim-time">--</b></span></div></div>
    <div class="pane"><div class="pane-head"><h2>Ground Node Registration</h2></div>
      <p class="lede">Association is an explicit simulation abstraction: the ACN accepts requests immediately when a node is created. RF link validity and data transmission remain separate.</p>
      <div class="registration-summary" id="registration-summary"></div>
      <div class="panel table-card"><div class="panel-head"><span class="sec-title">Node lifecycle</span></div><div class="table-scroll"><table class="data-table" id="registration-table"><thead><tr><th>Node</th><th>State</th><th>Requested</th><th>Completed</th><th>Elapsed</th><th>RF link</th><th>Communication eligible</th></tr></thead><tbody></tbody></table></div><div id="registration-empty" class="network-chart-status">No ground nodes. Add a node to begin registration.</div></div>
      <div class="panel table-card" style="margin-top:12px"><div class="panel-head"><span class="sec-title">Recent lifecycle events · simulation time</span></div><div class="table-scroll"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>Time</th><th>Node</th><th>Event</th></tr></thead><tbody id="registration-events"></tbody></table></div></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== TERRAIN & RF ===== -->
  <section class="tab-content" id="tab-terrain">
    <div class="analysis-context" data-context-view="rf"><div><span class="context-kicker">Live</span></div><div class="context-meta"><span>Target <b data-context-node>Syncing…</b></span><span>Simulation <b data-context-time>--</b></span><span>Frame <b data-context-frame>--</b></span><span>Link <b data-context-link>--</b></span></div></div>
    <div class="pane terrain-layout">
      <div class="pane-head"><h2>Terrain &amp; RF</h2></div>
      <p class="lede">See what stands between the aircraft and the selected terminal, then follow the signal through the link budget. Sliders change the simulation live.</p>

      <!-- Historical Timeline Scrubber Panel -->
      <div class="panel timeline-scrubber-panel" id="profile-history-panel" aria-label="Terrain and RF historical timeline scrubber">
        <div class="timeline-scrubber-bar">
          <div class="timeline-scrubber-controls">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
              <button type="button" id="btn-history-live" class="btn-live active" title="Return to live simulation (or press Live)">● LIVE</button>
              <span id="history-mode-pill" class="kpi-badge badge-emerald">LIVE STREAM</span>
              <span id="history-target-pill" class="badge-sub">Node 4</span>
            </div>
            <div id="history-current-pos" class="history-current-pos"><b>T+0.00s</b> <small>(#0)</small></div>
          </div>
          <div class="timeline-scrubber-track-wrap">
            <input type="range" id="profile-history-scrubber" min="0" max="0" value="0" step="1" aria-label="Simulation timeline scrubber" disabled>
          </div>
          <div class="timeline-scrubber-meta">
            <span id="history-span-oldest" class="muted">T+0.0s (#0)</span>
            <span class="muted" style="font-size:10px">60-SECOND ROLLING HISTORY (3,000 FRAMES) · MAIN MAP REMAINS LIVE</span>
            <span id="history-span-newest" class="muted">T+0.0s (#0)</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="history-eviction-warning" class="history-banner warning" style="display:none">
          ⚠️ Selected historical frame was evicted from the 60s buffer. Showing oldest available frame.
        </div>
        <div id="history-spatial-revision-warning" class="history-banner warning" style="display:none"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- Terrain Path Profile Section (Feature 6A) -->
      <div class="panel" id="terrain-profile-panel" style="margin-bottom:14px">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <div>
            <span class="sec-title">Terrain path profile</span>
            <span id="terrain-node-label" class="badge-sub">Node 4</span>
            <span id="terrain-zoom-label" class="badge-sub">1.0×</span>
          </div>
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap">
            <div class="seg" id="terrain-view-toggle" role="toolbar" aria-label="Terrain profile view mode">
              <button type="button" id="btn-terrain-view-profile" class="active" title="Terrain elevation cross-section profile">Profile</button>
              <button type="button" id="btn-terrain-view-top" title="Top-down terrain path corridor plan view">Top view</button>
              <button type="button" id="btn-terrain-view-rf-top" title="Top-down RF link and Fresnel zone clearance view">RF top view</button>
            </div>
            <div class="seg" role="toolbar" aria-label="Terrain profile zoom controls">
              <button type="button" id="btn-terrain-zoom-in" title="Zoom in (+)" aria-label="Zoom in">+</button>
              <button type="button" id="btn-terrain-zoom-out" title="Zoom out (-)" aria-label="Zoom out">−</button>
              <button type="button" id="btn-terrain-reset-fit" title="Reset view (Fit)" aria-label="Reset terrain view to fit">Fit</button>
            </div>
            <span id="terrain-clearance-badge" class="kpi-badge badge-neutral">CLEARANCE: --</span>
            <span id="terrain-crest-badge" class="kpi-badge badge-neutral">PEAK: --</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="fresnel-canvas-box"><canvas id="terrain-canvas" aria-label="Terrain path profile and top view canvas"></canvas></div>
      </div>
      <div class="cols">
        <div class="panel">
          <div class="panel-head"><span class="sec-title">Link budget (DVB-S2X)</span><span id="link-modcod-tag" class="kpi-badge badge-neutral">--</span></div>
          <div class="group-title">Result</div>
          <div class="facts">
            <div class="form-row"><span>Net channel SNR</span><b id="lb-snr">--</b></div>
            <div class="form-row"><span>Spectral efficiency</span><b id="lb-se">--</b></div>
            <div class="form-row"><span>Received power (P<sub>rx</sub>)</span><b id="lb-prx">--</b></div>
            <div class="form-row"><span>Noise floor (P<sub>noise</sub>)</span><b id="lb-pnoise">--</b></div>
          </div>
          <div class="group-title">Geometry</div>
          <div class="facts">
            <div class="form-row"><span>Slant range (d<sub>3D</sub>)</span><b id="lb-slant">--</b></div>
            <div class="form-row"><span>4/3 Earth bulge (&Delta;h)</span><b id="lb-bulge">--</b></div>
          </div>
          <div class="group-title">Losses</div>
          <div class="facts">
            <div class="form-row"><span>Free-space loss (FSPL)</span><b id="lb-fspl">--</b></div>
            <div class="form-row"><span>Diffraction loss</span><b id="lb-diff">--</b></div>
            <div class="form-row"><span>Gaseous loss (P.676)</span><b id="lb-gas">--</b></div>
            <div class="form-row"><span>Rain loss (P.838)</span><b id="lb-rain">--</b></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="panel">
          <div class="panel-head"><span class="sec-title">Radio and weather settings</span><span class="badge-sub">applies live</span></div>
          <div class="slider"><div class="form-row"><span>Carrier frequency</span><b id="lbl-freq">8.0 GHz</b></div><input type="range" id="param-freq" min="7.0" max="12.0" step="0.1" value="8.0" oninput="onParamChange()" aria-label="Carrier frequency"></div>
          <div class="slider"><div class="form-row"><span>Channel bandwidth</span><b id="lbl-bw">1.0 MHz</b></div><input type="range" id="param-bw" min="0.1" max="50.0" step="0.1" value="1.0" oninput="onBandwidthParamChange()" aria-label="Channel bandwidth"></div>
          <div class="slider"><div class="form-row"><span>Rain rate</span><b id="lbl-rain">0.0 mm/h</b></div><input type="range" id="param-rain" min="0" max="50" step="1" value="0" oninput="onParamChange()" aria-label="Rain rate"></div>
          <div class="slider"><div class="form-row"><span>Aircraft altitude (MSL)</span><b id="lbl-alt">5000 m</b></div><input type="range" id="param-alt" min="3000" max="8000" step="100" value="5000" oninput="onParamChange()" aria-label="Aircraft altitude"></div>
          <div class="slider"><div class="form-row"><span>Coverage radius</span><b id="lbl-cov">35 km</b></div><input type="range" id="param-cov" min="10" max="150" step="1" value="35" oninput="onCoverageParamChange()" aria-label="Coverage radius"></div>
          <div class="slider" style="margin-top:10px">
            <div class="form-row"><span>Target terminal AGL</span><b id="lbl-terrain-node-agl">2.0 m</b></div>
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-top:4px">
              <span class="muted" style="font-size:11px">Antenna above ground</span>
              <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
                <input type="number" id="terrain-node-agl-input" min="0" max="1000" step="0.5" value="2.0"
                       style="width:75px;padding:3px 6px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;background:#0f1522;border:1px solid #1e2633;color:#fff;border-radius:4px"
                       onchange="onNodeAglChange(this.value)" aria-label="Target terminal antenna height above ground level">
                <span id="terrain-node-agl-feedback" class="muted" style="font-size:11px"></span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== TERMINALS ===== -->
  <section class="tab-content" id="tab-terminal">
    <div class="analysis-context" data-context-view="terminal"><div><span class="context-kicker">Live</span></div><div class="context-meta"><span>Target <b data-context-node>Syncing…</b></span><span>Simulation <b data-context-time>--</b></span><span>Frame <b data-context-frame>--</b></span><span>Link <b data-context-link>--</b></span></div></div>
    <div class="pane terminal-layout">
      <div class="pane-head"><h2>Terminals</h2></div>
      <p class="lede">Choose a terminal, inspect queues, monitor communication flows, and track authoritative data transfer statistics across the aerial constellation.</p>
      <div class="terminal-subnav-bar">
        <button id="btn-subtab-inventory" class="btn active" type="button" onclick="switchTerminalSubtab('inventory')">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="13" height="13" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" stroke-width="2" style="vertical-align:middle;margin-right:5px;"><rect x="4" y="5" width="16" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M8 20h8M12 16v4"/></svg>
          Terminal Inventory &amp; Queues
        </button>
        <button id="btn-subtab-traffic" class="btn" type="button" onclick="switchTerminalSubtab('traffic')">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="13" height="13" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" stroke-width="2" style="vertical-align:middle;margin-right:5px;"><path d="M22 12h-4l-3 9L9 3l-3 9H2"/></svg>
          Network Traffic &amp; Flow Inventory
        </button>
      </div>
      <div id="terminal-subtab-view-inventory" class="terminal-subtab-view">
      <div class="cols">
        <div class="panel">
          <div class="panel-head"><span class="sec-title">Queues and traffic</span><span id="term-state-pill" class="kpi-badge badge-neutral">UNKNOWN</span></div>
          <input id="terminal-search" class="terminal-search" type="search" placeholder="Search by node ID, callsign or role…" aria-label="Search terminals" oninput="filterTerminalOptions(this.value)">
          <select id="termNodeSelect" onchange="onTargetNodeChange(this.value)" aria-label="Terminal">
            <option value="4" selected>Node 4: S4 - Recon Patrol (Occlusion Target)</option>
          </select>
          <div class="agl-control-wrap" style="margin:8px 0 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px">
            <label for="node-agl-input" style="font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)">Antenna AGL (m)</label>
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
              <input type="number" id="node-agl-input" min="0" max="1000" step="0.5" value="2.0"
                     style="width:80px;padding:3px 6px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;background:#0f1522;border:1px solid #1e2633;color:#fff;border-radius:4px"
                     onchange="onNodeAglChange(this.value)" aria-label="Antenna height above ground level">
              <span id="node-agl-feedback" class="muted" style="font-size:11px"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div id="terminal-search-status" class="muted" aria-live="polite" style="font-size:11px;margin:6px 0 14px">Search all available terminals</div>
          <div class="q-track-wrap"><label>5QI 69 <span class="muted">C2</span></label><div class="track-bg"><div id="qbar-69" class="track-fill" style="background:#38bdf8;width:0%"></div></div><output id="qval-69">0.0 KB</output></div>
          <div class="q-track-wrap"><label>5QI 65 <span class="muted">Voice</span></label><div class="track-bg"><div id="qbar-65" class="track-fill" style="background:var(--ok);width:0%"></div></div><output id="qval-65">0.0 KB</output></div>
          <div class="q-track-wrap"><label>5QI 67 <span class="muted">Video</span></label><div class="track-bg"><div id="qbar-67" class="track-fill" style="background:var(--warn);width:0%"></div></div><output id="qval-67">0.0 KB</output></div>
          <div class="q-track-wrap"><label>5QI 70 <span class="muted">Photo</span></label><div class="track-bg"><div id="qbar-70" class="track-fill" style="background:#fb923c;width:0%"></div></div><output id="qval-70">0 / 2000 KB</output></div>
          <div class="group-title" style="margin-top:16px">Inject traffic at the selected terminal</div>
          <div class="traffic-actions">
            <button class="btn-danger" onclick="injectTraffic('sos')">SOS alert (C2)</button>
            <button onclick="injectTraffic('voice')">Voice PTT (5QI 65)</button>
            <button onclick="injectTraffic('video')">Video burst (5QI 67)</button>
            <button onclick="injectTraffic('photo')">2 MB photo (5QI 70)</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="panel">
          <div class="panel-head"><span class="sec-title">Upload and acknowledgement monitor</span><button onclick="clearTransfer()" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:11px">Dismiss</button></div>
          <div id="transfer-card-container">
            <div class="transfer-monitor">
              <div class="transfer-header"><strong id="tx-type-lbl" class="c-acc">IDLE - Standby</strong><span id="tx-status-badge" class="kpi-badge badge-cyan">STANDBY</span></div>
              <div class="track-bg"><div id="tx-progress-bar" class="track-fill" style="background:var(--accent);width:0%"></div></div>
              <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)"><span id="tx-bytes-lbl">0.00 / 0.00 MB</span><span id="tx-eta-lbl">ETA: --</span></div>
              <p id="tx-msg-lbl" style="font-size:12px">Select a ground terminal and inject traffic to verify transmission state transitions.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="group-title" style="margin-top:16px">How blocked links are handled</div>
          <p class="muted" style="font-size:12px">When terrain cuts line of sight, the terminal stops radiating and its buffers stay queued. Tac-TAD detects the blockage 3.0 s ahead and raises priority (&Phi;<sub>evac</sub>) to flush queues to 0 KB before cutoff.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Ground-Terminal Inventory Panel -->
      <div class="panel" style="margin-top:14px">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <div>
            <span class="sec-title">Ground terminal inventory</span>
            <span id="inventory-nodes-count" class="badge-sub">16 active nodes · WGS-84 &amp; Local Cartesian</span>
          </div>
          <span id="inventory-selected-pill" class="kpi-badge badge-cyan">Selected: Node 4</span>
        </div>
        <p class="muted" style="font-size:11.5px;margin-bottom:10px">
          Coordinate reference: Local Cartesian theater projection (X/Y metres relative to DEM center 34.5°N, 76.5°E) with calibrated WGS-84 Local Equirectangular mapping (standard parallel 34.5°N; 1° lat = 110,931.5 m, 1° lon = 91,840.0 m). Hover over Lat/Lon for DMS format. Click any row to select the terminal.
        </p>
        <div class="inventory-actions-bar" style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap">
          <button id="btn-node-add" class="btn" style="padding:4px 10px;font-size:11.5px">+ Add Node</button>
          <button id="btn-node-duplicate" class="btn" style="padding:4px 10px;font-size:11.5px">Duplicate Selected</button>
          <button id="btn-node-delete" class="btn btn-danger" style="padding:4px 10px;font-size:11.5px">Delete Selected</button>
          <button id="btn-node-edit" class="btn" style="padding:4px 10px;font-size:11.5px">Edit Selected</button>
        </div>
        <div id="node-inventory-feedback" style="display:none;padding:6px 10px;margin-bottom:10px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11.5px"></div>
        <div id="node-editor-form" style="display:none;background:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:12px">
          <div style="font-weight:600;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:8px" id="node-editor-title">Configure Node</div>
          <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px">
            <div>
              <label style="display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Callsign</label>
              <input type="text" id="node-input-callsign" placeholder="e.g. S16" style="width:100%;padding:4px 6px;font-size:12px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);color:inherit;border-radius:4px" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style="display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Tactical Role</label>
              <select id="node-input-role" style="width:100%;padding:4px 6px;font-size:12px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);color:inherit;border-radius:4px">
                <option value="soldier">Soldier Terminal</option>
                <option value="mcp">Main Command Post (MCP)</option>
              </select>

      <section class="report-section panel experiment-capture" id="experiment-capture">
        <h3>Experiment capture</h3>
        <p>Record the telemetry frames this browser session receives and export the raw observations with run metadata. This is a data-capture utility, not an automated multi-seed benchmark runner; use identical scenario settings and independently controlled runs for comparative claims.</p>
        <div class="experiment-capture-grid">

        <p class="experiment-capture-caveat">Provenance limits: the current telemetry does not expose a verified random seed, all scenario parameters, or every internal per-frame event. Missing fields are explicitly recorded as unavailable; browser telemetry arrival is not assumed to equal every simulation frame. Do not treat exported observations as a controlled benchmark until run conditions and engine parity are verified.</p>
      </section>
      <header class="research-header">
        <p class="research-kicker">TECHNICAL REFERENCE · DIGITAL TWIN · TYPESCRIPT ENGINE</p>
        <h2>X-Band Aerial Communication Digital Twin</h2>
        <p class="research-subtitle">Architecture, simulation model, RF abstractions, adaptive scheduling, visualization, and verification</p>
        <div class="research-meta">
          <span>Authoritative runtime: TypeScript WebWorker</span>
          <span>Physical step: 20 ms / 50 Hz</span>
          <span>Terrain: 512 × 512 regional model</span>
        </div>
      </header>

      <aside class="research-notice">
        <strong>Scope and evidence.</strong> This is a simulation-backed digital-twin-style research platform, not a physically synchronized operational twin. The browser worker is authoritative for simulated state; the frontend visualizes published telemetry. The models are engineering abstractions and are not a claim of field validation, electromagnetic completeness, or formal standards compliance.
      </aside>

      <nav class="research-toc" aria-label="Report contents">
        <a href="#report-abstract">Overview</a><a href="#report-system">Architecture</a><a href="#report-engine">Simulation</a><a href="#report-trajectory">Flight</a><a href="#report-terrain">Terrain</a><a href="#report-rf">RF model</a><a href="#report-scheduler">TDMA</a><a href="#report-queues">Queues</a><a href="#report-visualization">Visualization</a><a href="#report-history">History</a><a href="#report-methodology">Methodology</a><a href="#report-standards">Standards</a><a href="#report-appendix">Mathematical appendix</a><a href="#report-config">Configuration</a><a href="#report-verification">Verification</a><a href="#report-limitations">Limitations</a>
      </nav>

      <section class="report-section" id="report-abstract">
        <h3>1. Project overview</h3>
        <p>The X-Band Digital Twin simulates an aerial communication node (ACN) serving sixteen registered ground nodes over a terrain-aware air-to-ground network. Ground nodes represent dismounted tactical terminals and a command-post class. Traffic is generated into QoS queues, links are evaluated from geometry and RF assumptions, and a TDMA scheduler allocates the shared uplink.</p>
        <p>The platform is intended for controlled research demonstrations of terrain-induced outages, queue behavior, link adaptation, and adaptive airtime allocation. It demonstrates a browser-hosted simulation with telemetry, map views, scheduler diagnostics, path editing, and historical inspection. It does not ingest measured aircraft telemetry, synchronize with a live network, or establish operational performance.</p>
        <div class="report-callout"><strong>Research comparison:</strong> <code>Legacy_Static_TDMA</code> assigns fixed equal uplink slots, while <code>Tac-TAD</code> adapts allocation using queue urgency, link state, and predictive terrain transitions. A fair comparison requires identical configuration, traffic, terrain, duration, and metric definitions.</div>
      </section>

      <section class="report-section" id="report-system">
        <h3>2. System architecture</h3>
        <div class="formula-card">UI controls → Worker command → simulation state → telemetry message → UI renderers<br>                                                     ↘ terrain / schedule / history views</div>
        <table class="doc-table-clean"><thead><tr><th>Layer</th><th>Responsibility</th><th>Implementation evidence</th></tr></thead><tbody>
          <tr><td>Browser shell</td><td>Controls, navigation, panels, Canvas views, experiment capture, and telemetry summaries.</td><td><code>index.html</code></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Simulation worker</td><td>Owns configuration, time progression, node state, terrain queries, link budgets, queues, and schedules.</td><td><code>src/worker/simWorker.ts</code></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Core model</td><td>Trajectory, terrain/geodesy, obstacles, RF propagation, QoS queues, schedulers, and transfer metrics.</td><td><code>src/core/*.ts</code></td></tr>
          <tr><td>UI modules</td><td>Map rendering, node inventory, data communication, path profile, and historical coordinators.</td><td><code>src/ui/*.ts</code></td></tr>
        </tbody></table>
        <p>The worker is the authority for simulated physics and scheduling. UI code sends explicit commands such as pause, resume, step, reset, and configuration updates; it consumes worker messages for rendering. Canvas drawing and historical inspection do not create an alternate physics state.</p>
        <p>The physical simulation frame is <strong>0.020 s (50 Hz)</strong>. Playback speed changes the timer cadence used to request frames; it does not change the physical timestep. A STEP command advances one physical frame.</p>
      </section>

      <section class="report-section" id="report-engine">
        <h3>3. Simulation engine</h3>
        <p>At each 20 ms frame the worker advances simulation time, evaluates the ACN trajectory, updates ground-node and predictive terrain state, evaluates terrain and obstacle geometry, computes link status and bitrate, generates or services traffic, runs the selected scheduler, and publishes telemetry. The exact internal ordering is an implementation detail of <code>SimulationWorkerManager</code>; consumers must treat the published frame as the coherent observation boundary.</p>
        <table class="doc-table-clean"><thead><tr><th>State family</th><th>Current behavior</th></tr></thead><tbody>
          <tr><td>ACN</td><td>Position, velocity, heading, altitude, coverage radius, and trajectory mode are published from the trajectory engine.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Ground nodes</td><td>Sixteen registered IDs are maintained in local Cartesian coordinates with configured ground/AGL state.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Links</td><td>Slant geometry, terrain clearance, obstacle state, losses, SNR, MODCOD, bitrate, and outage classification are evaluated per node.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Network</td><td>Traffic queues evolve, packets are dequeued according to the schedule, and goodput/waste/drop counters are emitted.</td></tr>
        </tbody></table>
      </section>

      <section class="report-section" id="report-trajectory">
        <h3>4. UAV flight and trajectory model</h3>
        <p>Ellipse mode follows a rotated, arc-length-parameterized ellipse. Waypoint mode accepts a closed route (the last point connects to the first), validates the route, builds a cubic Hermite spline with shared bounded tangents, samples it at 512 samples per segment by default, and evaluates position by arc length. The route is therefore smooth and closed, but it is not a learned or aerodynamic flight controller.</p>
        <ul>
          <li><strong>Physical speed:</strong> the configured true-air-speed target in metres per second. The default is 60 m/s.</li>
          <li><strong>Speed transitions:</strong> positive acceleration and deceleration limits bound changes when speed or mode changes.</li>
          <li><strong>Stationary hold:</strong> a speed of 0 m/s freezes trajectory progress. This is a simulation hold and must not be interpreted as fixed-wing hovering.</li>
          <li><strong>Playback speed:</strong> a UI timer multiplier that changes how quickly frames are requested, not the physical 20 ms step or the configured aircraft speed.</li>
          <li><strong>Telemetry:</strong> position and velocity provide heading through the velocity vector; altitude is configured as MSL.</li>
        </ul>
      </section>

      <section class="report-section" id="report-terrain">
        <h3>5. Terrain and geographic model</h3>
        <p>The real-terrain metadata describes a 512 × 512 point-registered Ladakh raster centered at 34.5°N, 76.5°E, spanning 33.5–35.5°N and 75.5–77.5°E. The local projection is equirectangular at the center latitude. The documented pixel scales are approximately 359.45 m in X and 434.17 m in Y; these are the source grid scales, not sub-metre terrain accuracy.</p>
        <table class="doc-table-clean"><thead><tr><th>Quantity</th><th>Implementation value</th></tr></thead><tbody>
          <tr><td>Local axes</td><td>X is east-west, Y is north-south, Z/elevation is metres above the terrain datum used by the loaded model.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Theater</td><td>Worker hillshade domain is 1,200 × 1,200 km (±600 km); real DEM metadata covers the documented geographic raster extent.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Curvature</td><td>Effective Earth radius uses <code>k = 4/3</code> and true radius 6,371,000 m.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Coverage</td><td>Terrain queries report incomplete/out-of-coverage paths explicitly; missing coverage is not silently treated as a measured elevation.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Obstruction</td><td>Sampled terrain clearance and Fresnel geometry produce diffraction/LOS state. This is geometric screening, not a full wave-propagation model.</td></tr>
        </tbody></table>
      </section>

      <section class="report-section" id="report-rf">
        <h3>6. RF propagation and link budget</h3>
        <p>The implemented link budget is a deterministic engineering approximation. Received power sums transmit power and antenna gains, then subtracts free-space path loss, terrain diffraction, gaseous loss, rain loss, cable loss, and implementation margin. Thermal noise uses <code>kBTB × 10^(NF/10)</code>; SNR is received power minus noise in dB.</p>
        <div class="formula-card">FSPL = 20 log₁₀(d) + 20 log₁₀(fc) + 20 log₁₀(4π/c)<br>Pnoise = kBT · B · 10^(NF/10)<br>SNR = Prx − Pnoise</div>
        <p>At the default 8.0 GHz carrier and 1.0 MHz bandwidth, the model uses ITU-R-inspired simplified coefficients for clear-air gas attenuation and horizontal-polarization rain attenuation, with a 10 km rain-cell cap. A discrete eight-entry DVB-S2X / 3GPP Rel-17 NTN-inspired MODCOD table maps SNR to spectral efficiency; it is an abstraction, not a conformance implementation.</p>
        <p>Obstacle intersections force outage classification but do not infer scattering or an additional electromagnetic attenuation term. Antenna patterns, multipath, interference, polarization mismatch, calibration error, and measured weather profiles are not represented.</p>
      </section>

      <section class="report-section" id="report-scheduler">
        <h3>7. TDMA scheduling algorithms</h3>
        <p>Each superframe contains a 1 ms control period, a dynamic 3–7 ms downlink window, and a nominal 16 ms uplink region. A 12 μs timing-advance guard and 200 μs minimum allocation constrain dynamic slots.</p>
        <table class="doc-table-clean"><thead><tr><th>Scheduler</th><th>Decision behavior</th></tr></thead><tbody>
          <tr><td>Static TDMA</td><td>Divides available uplink equally across registered nodes. It dequeues up to fixed-slot capacity even when a link is in outage, so payload may be counted as wasted on outage.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Tac-TAD</td><td>Deterministic heuristic scheduler. It scores urgency from QoS priority, backlog, head-of-line delay, current link quality, and predictive terrain state; it sizes allocations to eligible queued demand and reclaims severed-link airtime.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Pre-occlusion flush</td><td>Predictive look-ahead can prioritize evacuation of queued payload before a predicted hard shadow. This is a rule-based surge, not machine learning.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Output</td><td>Each allocation reports node, start, duration, timing advance, MODCOD, spectral efficiency, capacity, and whether it is a pre-occlusion flush.</td></tr>
        </tbody></table>
        <p>Tac-TAD is not a reinforcement-learning policy, neural network, trained model, or learned checkpoint. No training procedure or learned weights exist in the current implementation.</p>
      </section>

      <section class="report-section" id="report-queues">
        <h3>8. Queue, packet, and metric model</h3>
        <p>Each node uses bounded strict-priority queues for 5QI 69 Emergency C2, 65 MC PTT voice, 67 MC video, and 70 tactical photo. The default queue capacity is 400 packets with a 120-packet ceiling for 5QI 69. Lower-priority traffic is evicted first when the buffer is full; non-C2 packets are pruned when their packet delay budget expires.</p>
        <p>Queue drops are not RF failures. Overflow drops occur at admission, delay drops occur at expiry/pruning, and outage waste counts payload dequeued by a schedule but not deliverable because the link is unavailable. Goodput counts only payload dequeued while the link is usable. The UI also reports backlog, scheduled airtime, utilization, and per-frame/cumulative drop counters.</p>
      </section>

      <section class="report-section" id="report-visualization">
        <h3>9. Visualization and data communication</h3>
        <p>The Overview keeps a live 2D map visible while workspace tabs expose scheduler, terrain/RF, terminal inventory, and documentation views. Main 2D Map, Terrain Top View, RF Top View, and 3D Terrain are presentation layers over worker telemetry; they do not calculate authoritative physics.</p>
        <p>The communication view renders control/broadcast phases, uplink and downlink allocations, guard intervals, idle/reclaimed intervals, conflicts, and packet activity. A STEP request advances one physical frame, while the visual timeline may expand or annotate events for inspection. Live and historical data are kept separate so a scrubbed view does not overwrite the live simulation.</p>
        <p>The flight-path editor validates closed waypoint routes before committing them to the worker. The obstacle editor supports cuboids, cones, and pyramids with spatial locking and bounded dimensions. Obstacles intersecting a path are treated as geometric blockers; this is not a complete scattering model.</p>
      </section>

      <section class="report-section" id="report-history">
        <h3>10. History and replay semantics</h3>
        <p>The UI maintains rolling telemetry and scheduler history for inspection, including a 3,000-frame / approximately 60-second timeline where configured. Historical scrubbing selects stored snapshots; it does not rewind and deterministically re-execute the worker. Returning to LIVE resumes the current worker observation stream. Therefore, history should be described as telemetry snapshot inspection, not full deterministic replay.</p>
      </section>
